Waar complexiteit samenkomt, breng jij helderheid en richting.  

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Jij bent het boegbeeld van onze visie op stedelijke knooppunten en woningbouw. Ruimtelijke ontwikkeling binnen de stedelijke context zijn voor jou bekend gebied. Je vertegenwoordigt Movares extern waarbij je ons netwerk én gedachtengoed versterkt; 

  • Met jouw duidelijke visie stuur je multidisciplinaire teams en complexe gebiedsontwikkelingen aan, waarbij je innovatie en (technische) kennis inzet om ruimtelijke kwaliteit te vergroten; 

  • Je denkt vroeg in processen mee over vernieuwende oplossingen voor de leefomgeving en draagt jouw expertise actief over aan jongere collega’s.

Bij Movares werken we aan de stad van morgen. Aan plekken waar verdichting, mobiliteit en leefkwaliteit samenkomen. We zoeken een senior stedenbouwkundige die daar richting aan geeft: inhoudelijk sterk, ontwerpgedreven en met plezier midden in het vak. 

Als senior stedenbouwkundige bij Movares ben je een inhoudelijk trekker binnen complexe gebiedsontwikkelingen. Je werkt aan stedelijke verdichting, woningbouw en knooppunten en vertaalt maatschappelijke opgaven naar scherpe analyses, ruimtelijke concepten en overtuigende ontwerpen. Met jouw visie breng je samenhang tussen schaalniveaus, disciplines en belangen, en zorg je dat ruimtelijke kwaliteit steeds het uitgangspunt blijft. Je zit vroeg aan tafel, denkt mee over koers en strategie en ontwikkelt vernieuwende oplossingen voor de leefomgeving. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams waarin ontwerp, mobiliteit, planologie en techniek elkaar versterken. Daarbij ben je een natuurlijke sparringpartner voor collega’s: je deelt kennis, scherpt ideeën aan en begeleidt jongere stedenbouwkundigen in hun ontwikkeling. Met jouw ervaring en netwerk draag je actief bij aan de zichtbaarheid en inhoudelijke positionering van Movares in het werkveld. 

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Jij bent een initiatiefrijke en enthousiaste stedenbouwkundige met een duidelijke visie, iemand die de wereld elke dag een beetje mooier maakt. Je neemt mensen vanzelfsprekend mee in jouw visie, blijft nieuwsgierig, communiceert glashelder en weet collega’s te inspireren, te coachen en te motiveren om samen het hoogst haalbare te bereiken. Daarnaast bouw je sterke klantrelaties en ben je een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt.

Dit breng je ook mee: 

  • een afgeronde WO-opleiding Urban Design / Stedenbouw (TU of Academie voor Bouwkunst), en minimaal 10 jaar relevante werkervaring; 

  • belangstelling voor maatschappelijke opgaven zoals duurzame mobiliteit, klimaatadaptatie en energietransitie; 

  • ervaring met programma’s zoals Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, GIS en Sketchup is een pré; 

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan mooie projecten met maatschappelijke impact. Dat geeft energie en voldoening, iets wat niet in geld is uit te drukken.

Je draagt bij aan het verschil dat we samen maken voor de openbare ruimte in Nederland door te blijven groeien in je vak én als professional. Daarom krijg je in elke fase van jouw loopbaan de ruimte om jouw ontwikkeling actief vorm te geven, ondersteund door learning on the job, masterclasses en een brede leeromgeving in onze eigen Academy.


Dat is niet alles. We bieden ook goede primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Die zetten we hieronder voor je op een rij:

  •          een salaris tussen €5.500,- en €8.000,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur;

  •          de intentie om duurzaam met elkaar samen te werken, met perspectief op een vast dienstverband;

  •          een aantrekkelijk pakket van secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden inclusief fiscaal voordelige regelingen;

  •          duurzaam reizen voor je werk met een goede mobiliteitsregeling;

  •          goede faciliteiten om je werk te kunnen doen thuis of op kantoor;

  •          een moderne pensioenregeling met aandacht voor jouw toekomst;

  •          oog voor jouw persoonlijke situatie, met maatwerk in werkplek of begeleiding als dat nodig is.

​En er is méér. Want werken bij Movares betekent ook: 

  •          vertrouwen en flexibiliteit in hoe en waar je werkt, passend bij jouw team en werkzaamheden;

  •          werk dat ertoe doet: je draagt bij aan een duurzamere en schonere leefomgeving, samen met collega’s die dit belangrijk vinden;

  •          aandacht voor verbinding en plezier tijdens activiteiten met collega’s, inhoudelijk én informeel.

Jouw team bij Movares

Je versterkt het team Landschap en Stedenbouw, waar je samenwerkt met architecten en andere creatieve ruimtelijke denkers. Met meer dan 50 collega's bundelen jullie ontwerpkracht, visie en vakmanschap binnen de Movares organisatie. Dat team is volop in ontwikkeling. Daarom zoeken we senioriteit die kennis en ervaring combineert met nieuwe inzichten rondom gebiedsontwikkeling en stedelijke knooppunten.

Je werkt aan projecten die de kwaliteit van de leefomgeving verbeteren. We combineren creativiteit met technische kennis om integrale oplossingen te ontwerpen voor stedelijke en landschappelijke vraagstukken. Je komt terecht in een multidisciplinair team van ontwerpers en adviseurs, waarin intensief wordt samengewerkt met specialisten op het gebied van onder andere planologie, mobiliteit, ecologie en techniek. We zijn een hecht team waarin samenwerken en elkaar helpen vanzelfsprekend is. Kortom, je komt in een omgeving waar vakinhoudelijke uitdaging en een fijne werksfeer hand in hand gaan. Samen zorgen we voor een toekomstbestendige en inspirerende leefomgeving.

title: Managing director Energie & Leefomgeving
description:
Utrecht | Strategisch leiderschap | 38,75 uur

Maak het verschil als managing director bij Berenschot

Nederland staat voor één van de grootste transities van deze generatie. De energietransitie, de druk op de leefomgeving, netcongestie, woningbouw, stikstof, klimaatadaptatie en ruimtelijke ordening vragen om nieuwe vormen van samenwerking tussen overheid, bedrijfsleven en maatschappelijke organisaties. Al 85 jaar helpt Berenschot als toonaangevend adviesbureau opdrachtgevers om in complexiteit richting te bepalen en resultaten te realiseren. Als managing director Energie & Leefomgeving speel je hierin een sleutelrol. Je bepaalt mede de koers van onze grootste maatschappelijke adviespraktijken en draagt bij aan de toekomst van Nederland. Heb jij ervaring in een van deze domeinen in de consultancy of als leidinggevende bij een van onze opdrachtgevers? Heb jij een sterk netwerk op C-level en ben je commercieel gedreven zonder de maatschappelijke opgave uit het oog te verliezen? Dan is dit jouw kans om het verschil te maken als managing director Energie & Leefomgeving bij Berenschot.

Dit ga je doen

Als managing director en tevens lid van het mt draag je actief bij aan de (uitvoering van de) strategie van Berenschot en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de strategierealisatie en financiële prestaties van de adviesgroep Energie & Leefomgeving (E&L). Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor een van de grootste adviesgroepen binnen Berenschot met circa zeventig professionals en een substantiële omzetbijdrage aan de groep. Je leidt het E&L-managementteam met vijf teamleads en draagt bij aan de verdere positionering en groei van Berenschot in de betreffende domeinen, voortbouwend op onze sterke reputatie. Je geeft richting aan de volgende groeifase binnen energie en leefomgeving, inspelend op de veranderende markt, waarin ook digitalisering en realisatie steeds belangrijker worden. Het zwaartepunt ligt hierbij op het goed positioneren van de adviesgroep Energie & Leefomgeving bij onze klanten buiten en het intern leiden van de E&L-teams naar de volgende fase.

  • Je hebt een heldere visie op de ontwikkelingen in de energiesector en de leefomgeving. Je kent onze opdrachtgevers, begrijpt hun vraagstukken en vertaalt dit samen met je teams naar een scherpe strategische koers, met commerciële kansen buiten en een strategisch personeelsplan binnen.

  • Je ondersteunt marktteams bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe business en initieert, ontwikkelt en realiseert omvangrijke adviesopdrachten en strategische samenwerkingen.

  • Je onderhoudt en versterkt relaties op C-level binnen relevante klantsegmenten voor E&L: (netbeheerders, energieproducenten, warmtebedrijven, ministeries van EZK, IenW en LVVN, provincies en waterschappen).

  • Je bent een gezaghebbende gesprekspartner binnen het publieke debat op ten minste een van de proposities van E&L en begrijpt de context van het gehele veld, waarbinnen E&L opereert. Je vertegenwoordigt Berenschot in bestuurlijke netwerken, media, congressen en vakinhoudelijke platforms.

  • Je geeft niet alleen richting aan de groep met haar diverse teams, maar bouwt met de groep aan de volgende fase van E&L.

  • Je bent zichtbaar en benaderbaar op de werkvloer en legt verbinding. Je ondersteunt teamleads en professionals en daagt hen uit in hun ontwikkeling.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen en realiseren van een begroting, stuurt op declarabiliteit, bezettingsgraad en rendement.

Als lid van het Berenschot-mt beïnvloed je niet alleen de ontwikkeling van de adviesgroep Energie & Leefomgeving, maar draag je medeverantwoordelijkheid voor de strategische koers, groei en cultuur van Berenschot als geheel.


Dit neem je mee

Je bent een zeer ervaren en bewezen succesvolle adviseur en/of leidinggevende met een scherp strategisch inzicht en een intrinsieke motivatie om bij te dragen aan de transities waaraan Energie & Leefomgeving werkt.

De ideale kandidaat voor de functie:

  • Heeft een afgeronde universitaire masteropleiding.

  • Beschikt over minimaal vijftien jaar relevante werkervaring als adviseur, leidinggevende of eindverantwoordelijke manager binnen consultancy, overheid, energie, infrastructuur of leefomgeving en heeft affiniteit met de maatschappelijke opgaven waaraan we werken.

  • Heeft commerciële slagkracht en een stevig netwerk binnen de domeinen van de adviesgroep Energie & Leefomgeving. Je hebt aantoonbare succesvolle ervaring in het initiëren, ontwikkelen en realiseren van omvangrijke adviesopdrachten en strategische samenwerkingen.

  • Kent de dynamiek van een professional services firm, is energiek en weet kortetermijndynamiek te verbinden met een langetermijnontwikkeling.

  • Heeft innovatiekracht en is ondernemend ingesteld. Je bent een positief-kritische en strategische sparringpartner die op nieuwe zaken durft te anticiperen en vanuit helicopterview zaken verder weet te brengen.

  • Voelt zich thuis in complexe en uitdagende opdrachten op hoog bestuurlijk/ambtelijk niveau, heeft een proactieve houding, gevoel voor sociale processen en kan goed samenwerken.

  • Heeft bewezen leiderschapskwaliteiten in een professionele en bij voorkeur ook commerciële kennisomgeving. Je hebt flair, toont lef en daadkracht, en blijft daarbij in verbinding met de organisatie en betrokken opdrachtgevers.

  • Bent zichtbaar en benaderbaar voor professionals. Je weet talent aan je te binden en creëert verbinding in het E&L-managementteam en met professionals in de organisatie. Je motiveert en creëert draagvlak; niet vanuit macht maar vanuit natuurlijke verbinding.

  • Stimuleert samenwerking tussen disciplines en zoekt actief samenwerking op met collega-MD’s.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Berenschot kenmerkt zich door een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

Dit bieden we jou

Berenschot is een informele, slagvaardige organisatie met korte communicatielijnen waar er echt naar je wordt geluisterd. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. Ons inclusieve personeelsbeleid omarmt diversiteit en biedt iedereen gelijke kansen.

Je komt in een betrokken en ambitieus team, dat aan de meest relevante maatschappelijke opgaven en transities werkt in de energiesector en in de leefomgeving. Je landt in een steward owned organisatie die altijd streeft naar maatschappelijke impact. Een organisatie waarin je ruimte krijgt om te ondernemen en om zelf initiatieven te ontwikkelen.

Natuurlijk hebben we daarnaast ook uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en geweldige ontwikkelmogelijkheden:

•     Een vast jaarinkomen ligt tussen de € 135K-€ 180K, afhankelijk van ervaring.

•     Een variabele beloning (bonusregeling), afhankelijk van prestaties.

•     Een winstdelingsregeling.

•     Een representatievergoeding.

•     27 vakantiedagen.

•     Een mobiliteitsbudget waarbinnen je onder andere een auto kunt leasen.

•     Een uitstekende pensioenregeling.

•     Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.

•     Een positie in een betrokken en ambitieus team.

•     Een organisatie waarin je ruimte krijgt om te ondernemen en zelf initiatieven te ontwikkelen.

Solliciteer meteen

Wil jij ook impact maken bij Berenschot? Stuur ons dan zo snel mogelijk, maar uiterlijk 1 november 2026, jouw cv en motivatie. Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande solliciteerbutton. Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de functie, neem dan contact op met Madelon van den Hoven (hr-manager ) of Marinke Wijngaard (directeur ).

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen enkele dagen een reactie. Bij een positieve uitkomst nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega’s uit jouw team en je toekomstige manager. De gesprekken vinden plaats vanaf 9 november 2026. Als de gesprekken goed verlopen, volgt er een assessment. Blijkt daaruit dat jij een echte Berenschotter bent? Dan doen we je een concreet aanbod. Hierna heten we je graag welkom in ons team.

Denn angesichts wachsender regulatorischer Anforderungen, extremer Preisschwankungen und zunehmender Netzprobleme müssen sie einfach widerstandsfähiger werden. Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Als Logistikmitarbeiter (m/w/d) bei GALVANY sorgst du dafür, dass Material und Produkte zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort sind. Du bist das operative Rückgrat unserer Logistik, von der Warenannahme über die Kommissionierung bis zur Unterstützung der Produktion im Tagesgeschäft.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Annahme, Prüfung und fachgerechte Einlagerung von Materialien.

  • Kommissionierung von Produkten und Vorbereitung für den Versand.

  • Bereitstellung von Material, Bestandskontrolle und Übernahme allgemeiner logistischer Aufgaben.

  • Einfache handwerkliche Tätigkeiten in der Fertigung und bei der Materialvorbereitung.

  • Unterstützung der Produktionsabteilung im Tagesgeschäft.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung in Lager, Logistik oder Produktion, als Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik oder als Quereinsteiger mit praktischer Erfahrung.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, z. B. Scannern oder Warenwirtschaftssystemen.

  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens B1.

  • Staplerschein von Vorteil.

Deine Eigenschaften

  • Reliable Executor: Aufgaben werden sorgfältig, termingerecht und mit gleichbleibend hoher Qualität erledigt, auch bei hohem Betrieb.

  • Structured Worker: Bestände, Abläufe und Aufgaben werden methodisch und nachvollziehbar organisiert.

  • Hands-on Mindset: Anpacken ist selbstverständlich, praktische Aufgaben werden eigenständig und mit Sorgfalt übernommen.

  • Team Player: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion und Kollegen, konstruktiv und verlässlich.

  • Ownership: Volle Verantwortung für den eigenen Bereich, Bestände, Materialfluss und Qualität im Blick, ohne dass es jemand zweimal sagen muss.

Benefits

  • Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

What You'll Own

  • Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation

What We're Looking For

  • Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Events Growth Manager
description:
About Platform Engineering

Platform Engineering (platformengineering.org) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through PlatformCon and AgenticCon, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together thousands of platform engineers, platform leaders every year. Alongside our events, we run a university, a newsletter read by hundreds of thousands of engineers, and Weave Intelligence, our research arm.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Events Growth Marketing Manager to own registration and attendance growth across our entire events portfolio. That starts with our flagship conferences, PlatformCon and AgenticCon, the biggest conferences in the platform engineering world, which travel to San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York and Berlin, and extends to our roadshows, roundtables, workshops, House of Kube (the largest party in the cloud native world) and the satellite events we run in cities around major conferences such as AWS re:Invent, KubeCon and Google Cloud Next. Your goal is to bring platform engineering leaders into the room and keep them coming back. This is a systems and relationships role, not a one off campaign role. You’ll build the growth loops, the audience, and the repeatable playbook needed to fill these events and drive high attendance every time. You’ll report to the Head of Growth.

What you'll do

  • Own registration and attendance growth for PlatformCon and AgenticCon ticket sales, and for every other event we run, across San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York, Berlin and Amsterdam.

  • Build growth loops and long term relationships with the platform engineering community, its practitioners and its leaders, so we have an audience to pull from in every city.

  • Own our event pages on Luma and the end to end campaigns that fill them.

  • Plan campaigns designed for a high attendance rate, so the right people do not just register but actually show up.

  • Use HubSpot and Luma to build and target the right audience segments for each event.

  • Collaborate with design team to ensure high quality event pages and with content for strong copy and assets.

  • Brief and work with our performance marketing and lifecycle managers to get paid and email support behind each event.

  • Build the systems and the playbook that let us fill these events repeatedly, so the approach compounds instead of starting from scratch each time.

What success looks like

Within your first 90 days, we want you to come back to us with a proposed playbook: how we should run our in person events, and the exact workflow you would follow every time a new event brief lands, from audience to event page to campaigns to attendance. By 180 days, we want that playbook proven on live events, with a rising attendance rate and a reusable audience building in each city.

What you'll bring

  • A systems thinker who works in growth loops, not one off tactics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS marketing. Even better if you have worked somewhere whose core business is running events.

  • A track record of building and growing audiences and driving real attendance at in person events, not just registrations.

  • Strong hands on experience with CRM tools such as HubSpot for segmentation and targeting.

  • Comfort running social campaigns and briefing paid campaigns.

  • The ability to work independently with complete ownership, and to build a repeatable system rather than firefighting each event.

  • Work closely with the design team to produce strong event visuals, both for our Luma pages and website pages, so every event looks as good as it performs.

  • Comfortable with occasional travel to our event cities when an event calls for it.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Luma as an event platform.

  • Experience marketing events for a company whose primary business is events.

You do not need experience with data or automation tooling such as zapier, n8n or similar data flow systems. Our ops team supports all of that.

Why join us?

We run the biggest and most influential events in the platform engineering world. PlatformCon and AgenticCon are the flagship conferences of the entire space, and they travel to San Francisco, London, Sydney, New York and Berlin, alongside a full calendar of roadshows, executive roundtables, AI Platform Leaders events and House of Kube, the largest party in the cloud native world. These rooms bring together senior platform and engineering leaders from some of the biggest companies on the planet, including many from the S&P 500. You would own the growth of all of it end to end, with the mandate to build the audience and the playbook that make these events repeatable, and direct access to the Head of Growth and the wider leadership team.

title: Strategy Lead - Acquisition
description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Acquisition Strategy and Tech team is the integrated growth engine for iwoca in Germany. We bridge the gap between high-level commercial strategy and the technical systems that power our customer journey. By combining growth analytics, performance modeling, and full-stack engineering, we own the end-to-end acquisition funnel – from the very first touchpoint to a completed loan application. Our Core Focus:

Strategic Growth & Analytics: We serve as the central hub for our Direct Marketing and Sales channels. We translate complex data into actionable strategies, ensuring our outreach is both scalable and profitably managed.

Technical Infrastructure: We build and maintain the proprietary systems and models that drive our German operations. This includes optimizing the "User Experience" (UX) to ensure a frictionless onboarding process for small businesses.

Operational Excellence: We connect the dots between data-driven decision-making and real-world commercial impact. Our mission is to ensure every potential customer receives a clear, relevant, and rapid understanding of how iwoca can fund their business.

We are a fast-moving, cross-functional unit designed to turn strategic hypotheses into measurable results. Whether it’s refining a marketing model or shipping a new feature in the application journey, we ensure that iwoca’s expansion in the German market is backed by robust tech and a clear commercial North Star.

The role

This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, data, and technology. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will lead a high-performing, interdisciplinary team of three and own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market. Your primary objective is to co-define the growth strategy and partner closely with engineering and data teams to build the systems, onboarding journeys, and experiments that bring that strategy to life.

The scope of this role is broad and we're not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning strategy, analytics, product development, and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions.

You'll define hypotheses, lead cross-functional initiatives, and own the roadmap for how iwoca engages with German businesses. You will be accountable for measurable impact on acquisition and conversion, bringing ideas to life through rigorous commercial insight, strong customer empathy, and practical delivery. As a Lead, you will also be responsible for coaching your team and establishing the operating rhythm for this new unit.

Market and problem understanding

  • Deeply understand the German SME lending landscape, customer needs, and competitive context to sharpen our go-to-market strategy.
  • Translate market and customer insight into clearly defined product problems and prioritised commercial opportunities.
  • Inform targeting and segmentation strategies to help Marketing and Sales reach the right customers.

Product build and optimisation

  • Own the roadmap for acquisition and onboarding, working with engineers and data scientists to develop tools such as lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers, and onboarding journeys.
  • Work with marketing and sales to evolve website content, sign-up flows, and decisioning logic to increase conversion.
  • Influence future team capability by helping define priorities, roles, and processes as we scale.

Experimentation and insight

  • Design, run, and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, onboarding tools, and product flows.
  • Identify opportunities using first-principle reasoning supported by data, customer research, and funnel analysis.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of at the beginning two commercial strategy analysts and a data scientist focused on acquisition strategy and operational excellence.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives, aligning engineering, data, marketing, and commercial stakeholders around clear goals, hypotheses, and success metrics.
  • Translate high-level business goals into testable hypotheses and actionable briefs for our technical teams.
  • Help establish the operating rhythm, rituals, and roadmap processes for this new team.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Strong commercial mindset with proven experience driving go-to-market strategy and measurable acquisition growth.
  • Experience in growth strategy, revenue operations, or a highly analytical commercial role with a track record of driving tech-enabled or product-led growth.
  • Proven people management or team leadership experience, with the ability to build culture and establish operating rhythms in a newly formed team.
  • Fluency in German and strong written communication skills tailored to customer-facing environments.
  • Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools.
  • Experience working with (or a strong desire to learn about) technical models such as lead scoring, predictive targeting, or qualification logic.
  • Ability to work from first principles and thrive in ambiguity with curiosity and autonomy.

Bonus:

  • Experience in fintech, lending, B2B SaaS, or regulated products.
  • Experience working closely with engineering, product, or data science teams to ship features or models.
  • Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.
  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with ridiculous growth-mindset.

26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday.

One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp.

iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

Access to the gym membership program, €25 for either Fit711 or Urban Sports Club.

€30 contribution towards the Deutschlandticket.

Company Pension with Canada Life.

Great office locations. In Frankfurt in the middle of the city, our Berlin office is located in Prenzlauer Berg.

A paid volunteer day that gives you the opportunity to invest time to support a charity of your choice.

Corporate Benefits discounts.

’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone, including a book budget.
  • Learning German budget.
  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.
  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

The Partner Acquisition Germany team builds the partner channel through which iwoca reaches small businesses in Germany: comparison platforms and brokers, banks, payment providers, business software providers and financial advisors who offer iwoca's finance to their customers at the moment it is needed. You know how to activate networks and create warm introductions rather than relying solely on cold outreach.   • Own a portfolio of the highest-value partnership prospects in Germany, from first conversation to signed contract and live integration.

  • Lead negotiations with founders, managing directors and heads of product or partnerships at banks, payment providers, business software platforms and financial intermediaries.

  • Design the cooperation model and commercial terms for each partner so that the partnership works for both sides over years, not quarters.

  • Bring every partner to go-live with a committed internal promoter and a first concrete use case, so that your work turns into funded customers and long-term value.

  • Spend your time on relationships and deals, with a Strategy & Data Manager who builds target models, business cases and CRM automation alongside you for your prospects and partners.

  • Own your pipeline end to end and keep it transparent, so that forecasts and decisions rest on input and numbers everyone trusts.

  • Decide together with the Head of Partner Acquisition which segments and partners you pursue and where you say no.

Influence on product and strategy

  • Feed what you learn from partners directly into our partnership models, the integration roadmap and the go-to-market plan for Germany.

  • Shape the activation playbook for new partners and the handover to Key Account Management together with the Head of Business Development.

  • Represent iwoca at the industry events, trade fairs and partner roundtables that matter for SME finance in Germany.

The requirements

Essential:

  • At least five years of experience in B2B partnerships, business development or key account management in fintech, banking, payments or business software. You can show a proven track record of closing complex deals with six to twelve month sales cycles at C-Level, founder, board or head-of-department level.

  • A working understanding of how a financing product is integrated into a partner's platform: APIs, embedded finance and how a partner's customer data can be used in the application journey. You won't build integrations yourself (our engineering teams do that), but you need to lead that conversation credibly.

  • Professional fluency in German and English.

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

  • An existing network among German banks, payment providers, brokers or business software platforms.

  • Experience with lending, working capital or other financial products for small businesses.

  • Experience managing a partner pipeline in HubSpot and using data to prioritise targets.

As Senior Product Manager – Private Wealth (f/m/d) you build the product for LIQID's most demanding clients: entrepreneurs, families and executives whose relationship with us runs through a personal Relationship Manager. You design for two users at once – the client and the RM – and your mandate is twofold: make our Relationship Managers radically more effective, and design the end-to-end hybrid service, sales and relationship model for our most complex offerings. Our private clients hold portfolios that include private equity funds from KKR, EQT, CVC and Permira and venture stakes in companies like SpaceX, OpenAI, Stripe and Anduril. You make sure that advising on, investing in and living with these portfolios feels like the best of private banking – with the speed and clarity of a digital product.

What you'll do

  • End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the private client journey from introduction and first advisory meeting through onboarding, investment and long-term servicing to the next allocation. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree – net new money, share of wallet, time from advisory to investment, private markets adoption, retention, RM book capacity and cost-to-serve – and develop it further where you see sharper signals.

  • RM Enablement & Advisory Tooling: Treat Relationship Managers as users, not stakeholders. You build the tools that give them more time for advice and less for administration: a client 360 view, meeting preparation and follow-up, next-best-action signals, pipeline visibility and AI copilots that draft, summarize and document – within the requirements of MiFID II on suitability, cost transparency and record-keeping.

  • Hybrid Service & Sales Design: Blueprint the service model end-to-end: which moments are digital, which are personal, and which are both. Together with RM and Sales leadership you design seamless handovers, a shared view between client app and RM workspace, and service tiers that scale high-touch quality to more clients without diluting it.

  • Complex Offerings, Made Simple: Make sophisticated products understandable and executable: private markets with capital calls, distributions and J-curves, and the underlying funds and companies, from Cinven and Advent to Mistral and Databricks, as well as bespoke mandates, company and holding accounts, family structures and consolidated reporting across portfolios. You work closely with the Investment team, Compliance and Operations so every journey is compliant by design.

  • Discovery, Data & Experimentation: Join advisory meetings, shadow RMs and run continuous discovery with clients for whom every interaction matters. You combine qualitative depth with rigorous measurement in a small-n, high-value segment, define tracking schemas for client and RM journeys, and use AI-assisted prototyping to converge on solutions in few iteration cycles.

  • Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops. You drive adoption of what you ship inside the RM organization, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for hybrid wealth management at LIQID.

What you bring

  • Background: 7+ years in Product Management, ideally in wealth management, private banking, FinTech or another trust-driven, advice-led domain. Experience building for internal expert users such as advisors, sales or service teams alongside end clients is a strong plus.

  • Service Design & Hybrid Thinking: You think in service models, not just screens. You have designed journeys that span people, processes and software, and you know how to drive adoption and behavior change inside an organization, not only ship features to it.

  • Domain Depth & Regulatory Fluency: Solid understanding of investing and wealth management (capital markets, private markets, portfolio construction), and the ambition to build regulatory fluency in a supervised environment (MiFID II, BaFin). Experience with private market products or advisory processes is a strong plus.

  • Analytical & Technical Fluency: You define metrics before you build and attribute impact credibly, even with small samples. You are comfortable with CRM and workflow integrations, discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers, and using AI tooling to prototype and to build AI-assisted workflows.

  • Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English, with the presence to earn credibility with experienced Relationship Managers and with clients who expect the highest standard – and to represent your roadmap toward leadership.

  • Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. You want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to define what a premium hybrid private client experience looks like in an AI-native product organization.

What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget up to €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.

What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Call with Head of Product: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Take-home Assessment with live Presentation round: A take home task, followed by a 90-minute live session with two team members.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our Head of Product to discuss final alignments.

 

About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

 

LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws.

title: Product Manager
description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You own Banking Experience: the accounts at the center of customer's relationship with the bank, and the API and dashboards they use to manage them.

In this role you’re responsible for redefining what beautiful software in banking looks like. You'll define account structures that give customers powerful building blocks for their products, and craft intuitive interfaces grounded in a deep understanding of their use cases and workflows.

You report to Will, Head of Product, and work closely with Simon, our CTO. You're expected to operate with full autonomy on your team's roadmap, collaborating with design and engineering.

Your First Six Months

  • Months 1-2: Take over day-to-day ownership of the Banking Experience team - the roadmap, the ways of working, the hard decisions. Establish yourself with customers and how they use our accounts. You define and ship your first project.

  • Months 3-4: Execution mode. You're unblocking engineering daily, making hard prioritization calls, and shipping your roadmap to customers. You're proactively raising the bar across accounts, API, and dashboard by feeding what you learn from customers into the product.

  • Months 5-6: You're working with live customers on the products you've built. Deposits and number of account holders are scaling. You've moved from execution to platform mode - evolving the roadmap based on what our customers are building on top of Augustus.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You want to spend time with customers to intimately understand and then innovate on their workflows.

Du führst die ersten Interviews, lernst die Kandidat:innen kennen und stellst LIFTED vor.

description:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

  • Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events
  • Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them
  • Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading
  • Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise
  • Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible
  • Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales
  • Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models
  • Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper
  • Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems
  • Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge

No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.

What Success Looks Like

Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.

  • Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning
  • No active backlogs
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++
  • Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects
  • Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking
  • A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly

Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.

Our Culture

More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.

At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.

Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.

title: Quality Systems Lead
description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're hiring a Quality Systems Lead to own how Encord measures the quality of the human data we deliver to frontier AI labs, physical AI companies and enterprise AI teams — the standard itself, the systems that evaluate against it, and the audit function that produces the ground truth behind both. Data quality is what our customers buy. As we scale across data types — image and video, document, medical, LLM evaluation, robot teleoperation, egocentric capture — quality coverage cannot scale linearly with headcount. So this role has two halves that make each other work. You will build automated evaluation: model-assisted and LLM-based screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output. And you will build and run a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists in India, whose judgements become the labelled ground truth that trains and calibrates that automated layer. As coverage automates, the audit team moves up to the cases models can't judge and to generating gold sets for each new data type we take on. It is an unusual combination — engineering and consistent QC operations in one person — and it is the combination the job needs. You will also have an advantage your counterparts elsewhere in the industry don't: Encord owns the platform this work runs on, so the measurement you build can become native capability in the product rather than internal tooling.

 

What you'll do

  • Build automated dataset quality evaluation and root-cause detection — model-assisted and LLM-as-judge screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output

  • Hire, train, calibrate and manage a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists based in our India operation, held to inter-rater agreement and catch rate rather than volume audited

  • Turn audit output into labelled ground truth that trains and validates the automated layer, and manage the ratio of automated to manual coverage deliberately over time

  • Own the quality standard for every data type we deliver — written rubrics with worked edge cases, golden sets, and acceptance criteria agreed with the customer, alongside the Special Projects lead, before the first batch ships

  • Build scoring systems that rank annotator and reviewer performance and feed routing, staffing and offboarding decisions

  • Set the pass thresholds that certification gates on, so nobody works a project queue without having demonstrated they meet the standard

  • Report quality KPIs to leadership, and into the reporting our Special Projects leads take to customers: accuracy against client spec, inter-annotator agreement, rework rate, cost of rework, and coverage

  • Work with Project Management on remediation — you produce the measurement and the diagnosis, production owns fixing the project, and the standard stays independent of the people being measured

  • Own the unit economics of quality: cost per audited unit, and the coverage you buy per pound spent

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to bring quality measurement into Encord platform as native capability

Who we're looking for

  • You build and you operate. You'll write the evaluation pipeline, and you'll also run the weekly calibration session with ten auditors in another country

  • Your instinct on a coverage problem is to automate it — you reach for a model, a heuristic or a better sampling design before you reach for more auditors

  • Statistically literate in a practical way: sampling design, agreement statistics, and the judgement to spot a metric being optimised against rather than met

  • You can hold a calibrated standard across a distributed team you don't sit with — you know that ten uncalibrated auditors produce ten standards

  • A strong writer. Much of this job is producing rubrics a distributed workforce can follow without you in the room

  • You hold a standard under commercial pressure, and you bring the evidence that makes it stick with a delivery team or a client

  • Systems thinker: as interested in why a failure recurs across projects as in this project's defect rate

 

Experience requirements

  • 4+ years owning both technical and operational outcomes in a data, AI or service delivery environment where quality was measured rather than asserted

  • Hands-on Python and SQL. You build the analysis and the tooling rather than specify it for someone else

  • Practical experience applying models to a quality or evaluation problem — LLM-as-judge, model-assisted QA, automated evaluation, anomaly detection or classifier-based screening

  • Sampling methodology and agreement statistics (Cohen's and Fleiss' kappa, F1 against ground truth) applied to real production data

  • Experience hiring, training and managing a team, ideally an audit, review or QA team, and ideally distributed

  • Track record of building a quality framework or function, including the reporting leadership and customers run on

  • Bonus: direct experience of annotation, evaluation or model-training workflows, and of what frontier AI labs accept as evidence of quality

  • Bonus: a STEM degree, or a background in data science or research engineering

  • Bonus: multilingual delivery and linguistic quality assessment

 

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Company lunches twice a week

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

Through our subscription model, we make it easy for families to get the right bike at the right time, while keeping bikes in circulation for longer. We are a purpose-led, fast-growing business with a strong focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling.

Tasks

The Opportunity

This is a high-trust, high-exposure role for an ambitious graduate or early-career professional who wants to understand how a growing, purpose-led business really works. You will work closely with the Chief of Staff, Executive Chair and People Manager, and will regularly attend Executive Management, Senior Leadership Team and other key business meetings.

You will keep the leadership rhythm running smoothly: organising meetings, preparing information, capturing decisions, following up actions and making sure important work does not get lost between conversations. Alongside this, you will support People operations and take ownership of essential business administration, with AI as a genuine part of how you work rather than an afterthought.

The role offers unusual breadth and visibility across strategy, operations, governance, and the People function. It is a practical learning opportunity for someone who is curious, commercially minded, comfortable experimenting with AI tools, and keen to build a career in startups or scale-ups.

Purpose Of The Role

To make the Executive Chair, Chief of Staff and People Manager more effective by providing excellent coordination, preparation and follow-through. By taking ownership of recurring administration and the operating rhythm around leadership and People processes, and by using AI thoughtfully to simplify and speed up that work, you will free senior leaders to focus on strategy, decision-making and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership meetings and Executive Support

  • Coordinate diaries and meeting schedules for the Executive Chair and the SLT, resolving clashes and helping prioritise competing demands.
  • Run the administration for Executive Management, SLT and other key meetings, including forward schedules, agendas, papers, room or video arrangements and attendance.
  • Attend key meetings to take clear notes, record decisions and maintain action logs, following up with owners ahead of deadlines.
  • Coordinate the timely collection and formatting of leadership and Board materials, ensuring papers are complete, consistent and ready for review.
  • Prepare and format presentations, briefing notes, reports and other documents, using AI and digital tools to improve quality and speed, from drafting and summarising to formatting and proofing.
  • Support travel, offsites, workshops and company events, including logistics, materials and follow-up.
  • Handle correspondence and sensitive information with sound judgement, discretion and professionalism.
  • Support the planning and coordination of company events.

Business Administration & Project Coordination

  • Maintain central trackers for priorities, decisions and actions, giving leaders a reliable view of progress and overdue items.
  • Support the Chief of Staff with cross-functional projects by coordinating inputs, setting up working sessions, tracking milestones and escalating blockers.
  • Help gather and organise information for company KPIs, monthly reporting and strategic initiatives, using AI tools to speed up collation and surface what matters.
  • Provide practical support across the business, including supplier coordination, record keeping, shared filing systems and ad-hoc problem-solving.

People Coordination & Employee Experience

  • Act as a friendly, reliable first point of contact for employees on HR administrative matters.
  • Manage the People inbox, triaging and responding to routine employee queries, and escalating anything sensitive or complex.
  • Manage and maintain accurate employee records in HiBob, including new starters, leavers and employee changes.
  • Assist with recruitment administration, including scheduling interviews, liaising with candidates and hiring managers, and posting job adverts.
  • Support the coordination of new starter onboarding, including preparing onboarding materials, scheduling induction sessions, and ensuring new joiners have what they need for a smooth first day and first few weeks.
  • Collate and check payroll inputs, such as new starters, leavers, changes to pay, benefits and working patterns, ready for submission.

Using AI to Simplify People and Business Processes

  • Actively look for opportunities where AI can simplify or speed up People and business administration, from HiBob data and payroll prep to recruitment coordination and reporting.
  • Help build simple, reusable AI-supported templates and workflows for recurring tasks, such as onboarding materials, meeting notes, standard employee correspondence and report summaries.
  • Use AI tools responsibly and in line with data protection and confidentiality requirements, particularly where employee or sensitive data is involved, always applying your own judgement and checking outputs before they're used or shared.
  • Bring a curious, practical mindset to new AI tools and ways of working, and share what you learn with the wider People and Executive team.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

We are more interested in your potential, judgement and approach than in a long list of previous job titles. You may be a recent graduate or have gained early experience in administration, operations, HR, or project coordination.

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
  • Clear and confident written and verbal communicator who can adapt to different audiences.
  • Proven experience in diary management and scheduling for senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling sensitive employee data, and comfortable checking information before it goes to senior stakeholders.
  • Discreet and trustworthy, with strong judgement around confidentiality.
  • Comfortable working across both general business administration and HR administration.
  • Proactive, resourceful and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Comfortable supporting senior stakeholders, including at Executive Chair level.
  • Confident using common workplace tools, genuinely curious about AI, and keen to find practical ways to use it responsibly to simplify HR and business processes.

What You Will Gain

  • Direct exposure to executive decision-making and the practical realities of scaling a business.
  • A broad understanding of strategy, operations, governance and People processes.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI tools to real business and People workflows, not just using them, but helping shape how the team uses them.
  • Opportunities to take on increasing ownership of projects and business operations as you develop.
