title: Senior Consumer Duty Specialist
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

In this role, you will play a central part in assessing, questioning, and enhancing how customers experience Pleo. Drawing on deep regulatory knowledge, you will lead Consumer Duty initiatives, actively spot potential customer harm, examine what drives customer journeys, and ensure targeted remediation creates lasting, positive impact.

You'll need sharp analytical skills and the confidence to influence stakeholders, translating data and MI into decisive action. You will construct and manage dashboards and reporting mechanisms that illuminate emerging patterns, vulnerable customer risks, and key concerns, offering executive leadership clear visibility into operational gaps and necessary solutions.

Your contribution goes well beyond producing MI. You will conduct QA across complex complaint handling and sensitive customer interactions, manage Ombudsman cases, and speak up when evidence shows outcomes aren't meeting expectations. Collaborating across teams, you'll turn data-driven insights into practical improvements, drive projects to completion, and evaluate whether changes deliver real results for our users.

We're seeking someone who views Consumer Duty as a powerful driver of business improvement rather than a routine compliance exercise. You'll bring together technical understanding, rigorous analysis, and constructive challenge to investigate root causes, align key partners, deliver change, and prove that customer experiences are continuously getting better.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll work closely with teams across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, Technology, and other business functions.

The role will have broad exposure across the organisation, particularly when customer outcome risks or Consumer Duty-related remediation require cross-functional action.

You'll also work closely with senior stakeholders through Consumer Duty governance and reporting, helping translate detailed analysis into clear insights, risks, recommendations, and actions.

What you’ll be doing

As a Consumer Duty Specialist, you will:

  • Turn data into customer outcome insight: Build and own MI, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting that give the business a clear view of customer outcomes, trends, risks, and emerging areas of concern.

  • Own Consumer Duty reporting: Produce monthly and quarterly Consumer Duty reporting, turning complex data into a clear story for senior leadership and Board-level audiences. You'll go beyond showing what happened to explain why it matters and what we should do about it.

  • Identify customer harm: Use complaints, QA findings, customer feedback, vulnerable customer data, Ombudsman cases, and MI to identify potential customer harm, emerging risks, and systemic issues.

  • Challenge the business: Where the evidence suggests customers aren't receiving good outcomes, you'll be expected to ask difficult questions, challenge assumptions, and ensure the issue is properly understood and addressed.

  • Drive remediation and change: Work with stakeholders across the business to agree remediation plans, establish clear owners and timelines, and help drive Consumer Duty-related projects and improvements through to completion.

  • Provide complaints QA: Conduct weekly quality reviews of complaints handled by the Complaints Manager, using findings to identify quality issues, customer risks, and wider trends.

  • Manage Ombudsman activity: Act as the primary operational contact with the UK Ombudsman, managing referred complaints, responses, remedies, compensation, invoices, and related communications.

  • Leverage AI and smart automation: Spot opportunities to apply automated tools and AI to scale and streamline Consumer Duty analytics, monitoring, and workflows. You will feel empowered to test emerging tech and eliminate repetitive manual work, maintaining proper critical evaluation and human governance whenever compliance risks or customer impacts are involved.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong Consumer Duty knowledge: You understand the principles of Consumer Duty and how they translate into practical customer outcomes, particularly across complaints, customer support, vulnerable customers, and customer journeys.

  • Strong data and MI experience: You know how to take complex data, build meaningful dashboards and reporting, and identify the insights that actually matter. You're comfortable working with data rather than simply consuming reports created by others.

  • A customer outcome mindset: You're naturally curious about how customers are experiencing the business and are able to connect data, customer feedback, complaints, and operational activity to real customer outcomes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: You can spot trends, anomalies, and patterns, investigate root causes, and determine whether an issue is isolated or potentially systemic.

  • The confidence to challenge: You're comfortable questioning decisions, processes, and assumptions when the evidence suggests customers may be experiencing poor outcomes. You can challenge constructively and build relationships at the same time.

  • A bias towards action: You don't believe reporting is the end of the process. You want to understand what needs to change, bring people together, and help make it happen.

  • Project and remediation experience: You're comfortable managing actions, timelines, dependencies, stakeholders, and risks across cross-functional projects, particularly where there is a regulatory, customer, or operational outcome to deliver.

  • An AI and automation mindset: You're naturally curious about how AI and automation can make processes more efficient, improve analysis, and free up time for higher-value work. You look for sensible opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and use AI to augment your thinking, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, critical judgement, and accountability — particularly where customer outcomes or regulatory decisions are involved.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love using data to uncover things that others might not see.

  • You want your analysis to drive real change, rather than sit in a report or dashboard.

  • You enjoy asking "why?" and getting to the root cause of customer problems.

  • You're comfortable challenging the business when the evidence tells you something isn't working.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer to produce reporting without being involved in what happens afterwards.

  • You're uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or having difficult conversations when customer outcomes aren't where they should be.

  • You prefer working within a narrow functional remit rather than across multiple teams.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Build a deep understanding of our customer outcome data, existing Consumer Duty MI, complaints, vulnerable customer journeys, and current areas of risk.

  • Take ownership of key Consumer Duty dashboards and reporting, developing a clear view of the metrics and insights that matter most.

  • Establish strong relationships with stakeholders across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, and Technology.

  • Lead the analysis behind Consumer Duty reporting and help shape how customer outcomes are presented to senior stakeholders and the Board.

Over time, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Pleo measures, understands, and improves customer outcomes, helping move Consumer Duty from a regulatory obligation into a genuine driver of better customer experiences and better business decisions.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Meet the Hiring Manager: 1hr going through role in more depth.

  3. Pleo Challenge: A case study were you talk us through how you'd solve a work appropriate challenge.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we advertised this role, we received a really high volume of applications but could only select so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

description:
Head of DC Operations (H/F)

Région parisienne

Votre mission

Dans un environnement où la disponibilité et la fiabilité des infrastructures sont essentielles, Isatalent recherche un(e) Head of DC Operations pour piloter les opérations de ses data centers en région parisienne.

Rattaché(e) à la direction, vous êtes garant(e) de la performance opérationnelle, de la continuité de service et de la fiabilité des infrastructures. Vos responsabilités

Piloter la stratégie et la performance des opérations multisites

  • Élaborer une feuille de route opérationnelle à court et moyen terme, en définissant les priorités, les plans d'action et les ressources humaines et financières nécessaires.

  • Définir et harmoniser les méthodes de pilotage des activités opérationnelles sur l'ensemble des sites.

  • Consolider et faire évoluer les KPI et tableaux de bord portant notamment sur la disponibilité des infrastructures, la maintenance, la communication client et le respect des procédures.

  • Analyser les résultats, identifier les écarts de performance et piloter les actions correctives.

  • Produire un reporting structuré à destination de la direction et éclairer les décisions stratégiques.

Manager les responsables de site et accompagner la transformation

  • Encadrer et accompagner les responsables de site dans le pilotage de leurs activités et le développement de leurs compétences.

  • Apporter une expertise opérationnelle et technique permettant de challenger les choix, les priorités et les plans d'action.

  • Favoriser l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la coopération des équipes.

  • Organiser l'allocation des ressources et le suivi des plans de charge.

  • Accompagner la réorganisation du périmètre, harmoniser les pratiques et contribuer à l'intégration de nouveaux sites.

  • Travailler en transversalité avec le responsable du pôle Expertise et les autres fonctions de l'entreprise.

Garantir la fiabilité des infrastructures et maîtriser les risques

  • Garantir la disponibilité, la résilience et la continuité d'exploitation des infrastructures critiques.

  • Superviser la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire, ainsi que les travaux, extensions, rétrofits et changements réalisés en environnement exploité.

  • Reprendre et consolider la cartographie des risques opérationnels et techniques, notamment les points uniques de défaillance (SPOF) et les obsolescences critiques.

  • Hiérarchiser les risques, définir les plans de traitement, en évaluer les impacts financiers et humains et identifier les investissements nécessaires.

  • Piloter les incidents majeurs, les escalades, les analyses de causes et le suivi des actions correctives et préventives.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences de sécurité, de conformité et de continuité de service.

Développer la relation client et le partenariat avec les mainteneurs

  • Garantir le respect des engagements contractuels, des SLA et des standards de qualité attendus par les clients.

  • Renforcer la qualité de la communication opérationnelle et la confiance avec les interlocuteurs clients.

  • Développer une relation constructive et partenariale avec les mainteneurs et les prestataires.

  • Améliorer la coordination des interventions, le suivi des engagements et la qualité des prestations.

  • Identifier les axes de progrès et piloter les actions d'amélioration de la performance des partenaires.

Piloter les budgets et l'amélioration continue

  • Élaborer et suivre les budgets OPEX et CAPEX du périmètre.

  • Arbitrer les priorités de maintenance, de renouvellement et d'investissement en fonction des risques, des capacités et des engagements clients.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires, environnementales, HSE, ICPE et des référentiels ISO applicables.

  • Déployer des standards, procédures et méthodes de travail homogènes.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la performance énergétique des installations, notamment du PUE, et à la maîtrise des coûts d'exploitation.

Votre profil

Formation et expérience

  • Formation supérieure, idéalement Bac +5, de type ingénieur ou master spécialisé en génie électrique, énergétique, climatique, maintenance industrielle ou management des opérations. Un Bac +3 technique pourra être étudié au regard d'une expérience particulièrement solide.

  • Expérience significative en management de managers, en pilotage multisite ou dans une fonction de responsabilité opérationnelle comparable.

  • Expérience confirmée dans un environnement critique fonctionnant 24h/24 et 7j/7, avec de fortes exigences de disponibilité, de sécurité et de conformité.

  • Expérience en gestion d'incidents majeurs, pilotage de budgets, gestion des risques et conduite de transformations opérationnelles.

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise des enjeux d'exploitation des data centers et compréhension des architectures électriques, mécaniques, CVC, de protection incendie, de GTB/BMS et des systèmes de contrôle.

  • Maîtrise du pilotage de la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire.

Au cours des premiers mois, vous aurez notamment pour objectifs de construire une feuille de route opérationnelle claire, de consolider le pilotage par les indicateurs, de hiérarchiser les risques et de définir les moyens nécessaires à leur traitement.

description:
À propos de FPP Industries

FPP Industries poursuit son développement et souhaite aujourd’hui structurer davantage sa fonction Ressources Humaines.

Dans ce contexte, nous créons un poste de Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines à 60 %, directement rattaché à la Direction générale.

L’enjeu : construire une gestion RH à la fois fiable, structurée et humaine, capable d’accompagner durablement le développement de l’entreprise.

Pourquoi ce poste existe

Jusqu’à présent, les différents sujets RH ont été pris en charge sans fonction RH dédiée.

Avec le développement de l’entreprise, nous souhaitons désormais franchir une nouvelle étape : fiabiliser l’administration du personnel, structurer nos pratiques RH et offrir aux collaborateurs comme aux managers un interlocuteur clairement identifié.

Il s’agit donc d’une création de poste.

Vous rejoindrez une fonction qui a déjà un cadre et des responsabilités définis, mais dans laquelle de nombreux processus restent à structurer et à faire évoluer.

Votre mission

Votre mission sera de structurer, administrer et faire vivre les Ressources Humaines de FPP Industries, en garantissant une gestion fiable du quotidien tout en construisant progressivement les pratiques RH dont l’entreprise aura besoin pour poursuivre son développement.

Vous serez le référent RH opérationnel de l’entreprise et travaillerez en lien direct avec la Direction, les managers, les collaborateurs ainsi que les partenaires externes.

Vos responsabilités principales

Garantir une administration RH et une paie fiables.
Vous prenez en charge le suivi administratif des collaborateurs, de leur arrivée à leur départ : contrats et avenants, absences, congés, périodes d’essai, visites médicales, échéances et dossiers individuels. Vous collectez et contrôlez les variables de paie, établissez les bulletins de salaire et sécurisez leur remise dans les délais.

Piloter les recrutements et les intégrations.
Vous accompagnez les managers dans la définition de leurs besoins, rédigez et diffusez les offres, présélectionnez les candidatures, réalisez les premiers entretiens et coordonnez le processus jusqu’à l’intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.

Développer les compétences.
Vous identifiez les besoins avec les managers, organisez et suivez les formations et contribuez progressivement à construire une vision claire des compétences disponibles et à développer dans l’entreprise.

Accompagner les managers et les collaborateurs.
Vous devenez un interlocuteur RH accessible au quotidien. Vous accompagnez les managers dans leurs problématiques humaines, organisez les campagnes d’entretiens et contribuez à identifier suffisamment tôt les situations nécessitant une attention particulière.

Structurer et améliorer les pratiques RH.
Vous fiabilisez les données, construisez les indicateurs utiles au pilotage, formalisez les processus et proposez des améliorations concrètes pour simplifier le fonctionnement RH et l’expérience collaborateur.

Accompagner la mise en conformité liée au développement de l’entreprise.
Vous contribuerez notamment aux chantiers liés au CSE, au DUERP et à la structuration progressive de la démarche RSE, en lien avec la Direction et l’évolution de l’entreprise.

Ce que nous attendons de vous

Indispensable

Vous disposez de bases solides en administration du personnel et droit social français.

Vous êtes capable de prendre en charge la production des bulletins de salaire, tout en sachant solliciter un prestataire ou un conseil externe lorsqu’une situation nécessite une expertise technique ou réglementaire particulière.

Vous savez conduire un recrutement, accompagner une intégration et travailler avec des managers sur leurs problématiques RH quotidiennes.

Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils bureautiques et suffisamment structuré(e) pour tenir des données, documents et échéances RH avec un haut niveau de fiabilité.

La confidentialité, la rigueur et la fiabilité sont pour vous non négociables.

Votre manière de travailler

Ce poste conviendra particulièrement à une personne qui apprécie autant faire fonctionner le quotidien que construire ce qui n’existe pas encore.

Vous aimez comprendre avant d’agir, structurer, documenter et améliorer.

Vous êtes capable d’avancer de manière autonome dans votre périmètre tout en sachant identifier les décisions qui nécessitent un arbitrage de la Direction.

Vous savez écouter sans perdre votre neutralité, accompagner sans vous substituer au manager et challenger avec tact lorsqu’une situation le nécessite.

Vous êtes également à l’aise dans un environnement où la fonction RH continuera à évoluer avec le développement de l’entreprise.

Ce que nous vous offrons

Vous rejoignez FPP Industries au moment où la fonction RH se structure réellement.

Vous ne reprendrez donc pas simplement un poste existant : vous aurez l’opportunité de contribuer directement à la construction et à l’amélioration de nos pratiques RH.

Le poste offre un lien direct avec la Direction, une réelle autonomie dans l’organisation du quotidien RH et un périmètre susceptible d’évoluer progressivement avec le développement de l’entreprise et du groupe.

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne souhaitant construire une fonction utile, pragmatique et proche du terrain.

Processus de recrutement

Notre objectif est de prendre le temps de vérifier l’adéquation réciproque entre votre manière de travailler, la réalité du poste et le fonctionnement de FPP Industries.

Les différentes étapes du processus et leurs délais vous seront présentés clairement dès les premiers échanges.

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

Learn more about our coaching culture.

description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs.

Le poste est ouvert dans le fond propre d’IMT Mines Albi. Une collaboration avec le laboratoire de chimie de coordination (LCC) à Toulouse est prévue.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

A ce jour, les carburants fossiles sont encore largement utilisés dans les différents secteurs industriels et notamment pour le secteur de transport, qui sont une source importante d’émission de gaz à effet de serre. Pour réduire l’impact environnemental du secteur de transport, les carburants de synthèse jouent un rôle important, en particulier pour le transport aérien de demain. Parmi les voies de R&D étudiées à ce jour pour la production de ces carburants de synthèse, le captage du CO2 et l’hydrogénation directe de ce CO2 par de l’hydrogène obtenu par l’électrolyse de l’eau avec de l’électricité renouvelable est une voie stratégique. L'un de leurs atouts majeurs réside dans l’optimisation de la production pour minimiser le coût du produit final, et la compatibilité des carburants de synthèse avec les infrastructures et les flottes existantes.

Ce projet, qui réunit deux laboratoires (RAPSODEE à Albi, et LCC à Toulouse), vise à produire des carburants alternatifs par hydrogénation directe du CO2 via une synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch à partir de CO2 (CO2-FTS). Ce processus se décompose en deux étapes successives : (i) l'hydrogénation du CO2 en CO (réaction inverse du gaz à l'eau, ou RWGS), suivie (ii) de l'hydrogénation du CO en hydrocarbures (synthèse de Fischer-Tropsch, ou FTS). Ce projet continue la recherche récente entre les deux laboratoires sur le même sujet, en développant des systèmes catalytiques multifonctionnels assurant la conversion, en une seule étape, dans un seul réacteur et à une seule condition de température et de pression, du CO2 et H2 en carburants liquides. Une attention particulière sera accordée à l’ingénierie de la composition, de la structure et de l’environnement des sites actifs, afin d’établir des relations structure-activité et de comprendre le rôle de chaque composant métallique dans les différentes étapes réactionnelles. Cette stratégie vise à dépasser les limitations des catalyseurs conventionnels en améliorant leur activité, sélectivité, stabilité et résistance à la désactivation. Le projet contribuera ainsi au développement d’une nouvelle génération de catalyseurs multifonctionnels pour la valorisation directe et durable du CO2 en carburants et produits chimiques à valeur ajoutée.

Les missions sont les suivantes :

  •        Etat de l’art : Une étude bibliographique est prévue sur les derniers travaux publiés sur ce sujet, pour compléter le travail réalisé en début de 2026.

  •        Synthèse et caractérisation des catalyseurs multifonctionnels : des catalyseurs bimétalliques et multifonctionnels à base de fer et/ou de cobalt pour la conversion directe du CO2 en hydrocarbures par voie Fischer-Tropsch seront développés. L’objectif sera d’obtenir des matériaux présentant une synergie contrôlée entre différentes fonctions catalytiques, permettant de favoriser simultanément l’activation/hydrogénation du CO2, la formation des intermédiaires carbonés et leur transformation sélective en chaînes hydrocarbonées. Les paramètres à étudier sont : la modification des supports catalytiques par des promoteurs efficaces ; le contrôle de la taille, la forme et la composition de la phase active, le contrôle de l’équilibre entre les fonctions pour l’activation du CO2 et de l’hydrogène. Ces matériaux seront caractérisés par différentes méthodes de caractérisation conventionnelles ou avancées.

  •        Evaluation des systèmes catalytiques en CO2-FTS : Les catalyseurs synthétisés seront évalués à l’échelle laboratoire. La performance des meilleurs catalyseurs pourra être évaluée à l’échelle pilote.

  •        Valorisation des résultats : Les résultats obtenus feront l’objet de la valorisation sous forme de brevet et ensuite communiqués dans les congrès et les journaux scientifiques.

 

CAPACITE ET ATTITUDES :

Des compétences solides en catalyse hétérogène, en particulier pour la conversion du CO2 sont recherchées.

Home page
Customer Stories

Tu veux travailler sur une Data Platform qui irrigue toute une scale-up fintech — du Marketing au Produit, en passant par la Finance, le Customer Success et les sales — et qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de notre transition AI-first ? You will drive product adoption and offer high-impact paid services, positioning expansions as a natural result of client success. This, while tracking performance with clear, business-focused metrics.

  • Knowledge Base Development: You will own and champion our self-service tools (Knowledge Base, Video Academy, Automation). By making resources clear and accessible, you help our customers find quick answers independently and keep support queues manageable.

  • SaaS Experience: You bring 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Implementation or Account Management in the B2B SaaS environment.

Unlock your full potential in an inspiring and fast-paced environment. We provide the stage; you take the reins.

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation, plus an additional day off for every year of service, giving you plenty of time to rest and recharge.

  • Modern Zurich HQ: Located just a five-minute walk from Zurich HB, our centrally located office offers an inspiring work environment with local coffee, a variety of snacks and access to many lunch spots.

  • Unique Events: Events are our DNA. Beyond building great software, we truly enjoy spending time with each other - whether through spontaneous summer swims in the Limmat-river, Friday Beer um Vier drinks, our annual Global Team Event or legendary Christmas parties.

title: Senior Documentation Specialist
description:
About this position

As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. You acts as an experienced TMF specialist, working closely with Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams to provide expert guidance on document processes, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement.

Your tasks:

  • Oversee documentation handling, filing and archival activities for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities across relevant functional areas, ensuring that final documents are complete, accurate, traceable and maintained in the company document management system.

  • Perform complex quality-control reviews and provide technical oversight of QC activities completed by TMF colleagues and external partners, in accordance with applicable SOPs, the CDISC TMF Reference Model, study-specific TMF Plans and regulatory requirements.

  • Plan and conduct risk-based periodic oversight reviews of CRO and laboratory TMFs; identify quality or completeness issues, recommend remediation actions, monitor progress and escalate significant or recurring risks.

  • Lead TMF inspection-readiness activities for assigned studies and coordinate documentation support during audits and regulatory inspections; develop and coordinate documentation-related corrective and preventive actions, monitor implementation and verify effective closure.

  • Act as a TMF subject matter expert for study teams and external partners, providing practical guidance and escalating matters that require management direction or cross-functional decisions.

  • Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working.

  • Ensure assigned activities comply with company and CRO SOPs, ICH GCP, applicable regulations and relevant regulatory guidance.

  • Represent Clinical Documentation in study meetings, provide input on TMF status and quality, and follow up on agreed documentation actions, decisions and risks.

  • Prepare and deliver TMF guidance and training, and share expertise with study-team members and other TMF colleagues on compliant documentation practices.

Role requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related or other relevant discipline.

  • Minimum seven years of experience in TMF and documentation management within the pharmaceutical or CRO industry, including at least three years of experience in biotechnology or another fast-growing, dynamic environment.

  • Advanced knowledge of eTMF solutions, such as Veeva Vault Clinical, PhlexTMF or comparable platforms, together with strong working knowledge of ICH GCP, applicable regulations and the CDISC TMF Reference Model.

  • Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight.

  • Demonstrated experience leading TMF inspection-readiness activities and managing documentation-related findings and corrective and preventive actions.

  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance, influence without direct authority and build effective working relationships across functions.

  • Proactive and accountable approach, with sound judgement, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and implement pragmatic, GCP-compliant solutions.

  • Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple activities in a dynamic environment.

  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Work permit

Candidate needs to hold a Swiss work permit or be an EU citizen eligible to work in Switzerland

Your path forward

If you meet most of these requirements and bring a strong dedication to technical documentation, we encourage you to apply. You will contribute directly to our mission of advancing new medicines for patients.

title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day.

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.

How We Build

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.


What You'll Do

What You'll Do

  • Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation.

  • Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle.

  • Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details.

  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech.

  • Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    •  


Who You Are

Who You Are

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue.

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build.

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team.

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform.

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague.

Your Experience Includes

  • 5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift.

  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

  • Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better.

  • Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI.

  • Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools.

  • Ability to write unit and UI tests.

  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included.

  • A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code.


Nice to Have

Nice to Have

  • Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment.

  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

  • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS.

  • Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar.

  • Published apps on the App Store you're proud of.

  • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.

  • Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI development practices.

  • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.

  • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)


About Intero Integrity

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

The opportunity

This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.

What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.

Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here.


What you will do

Hands-on software development

•      You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data

•      You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams

•      You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform

•      You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow

•      You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure

•      You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software

•      You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection)

Mentorship & working with partners

•      You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow their technical skills

•      You lead by example in code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing

•      You work side by side with external development partners, challenging their choices and making sure the work meets a high standard

•      You help establish and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, review processes, testing strategies and release policy

•      You make sure design decisions and domain knowledge are documented and transferable, so the team can operate independently

•      You help shape a development culture where quality and continuous improvement are the norm


What you bring

Technical expertise

•      Extensive experience with C# and the .NET platform

•      Solid knowledge of software architecture, design principles and design patterns

•      Experience building web applications and REST APIs (ASP.NET)

•      Experience writing maintainable, testable, high-quality software

•      Experience with automated testing and CI/CD

•      The ability to mentor others and lift the level of a team

•      Good communication skills and the ability to clearly substantiate technical choices


A plus

•      Experience with cloud development, preferably Azure

•      Experience with machine learning and/or image recognition, and operationalising ML in production

•      Affinity with signal processing, measurement data and data streams, preferably in an industrial or technical context

•      Experience with WPF and complex desktop applications

•      Experience in a domain where software quality and reliability have direct impact (industrial automation, medical software, measurement & inspection or similar)

When do we see you as a senior?

For us, seniority goes beyond years of experience or technical skill. We are looking for someone who understands that technical choices affect the product, the organisation and our customers, and who actively takes responsibility for that.

You:

•      Form an independent view on architecture and technology

•      Think critically about requirements, assumptions and existing ways of working

•      Consciously build team knowledge: you document, explain and help colleagues grow

•      Are comfortable in an environment where not everything is fixed yet, and know how to bring structure to it

•      Actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team


What we offer

A senior role with real influence on our software products and how we build them, the chance to mentor and grow a team, and the variety of working alongside experienced external partners, in a domain where technology genuinely matters.

Working environment

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

·        Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

·        Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

·        Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

·        Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

·        Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

·        Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

·        You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·        You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

·        You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

·        Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

·        Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

·        Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

·        Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

·        Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

·        Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero

·        Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

·        Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

·        Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

·        International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

·        Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

What we offer

·        A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

·        A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

·        Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

·        Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.


Application process

1. Introductory interview with our recruiter.
2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

Heb jij diepgaande ervaring in werktuigbouwkundige installaties en wil je bijdragen aan de meest kritische en innovatieve datacenterprojecten van dit moment? Als Senior Mechanical Engineer Datacenters bij Deerns werkt je aan high-tech, schaalbare en energie-efficiënte faciliteiten die de digitale wereld draaiend houden. Jij ontwerpt de installaties die maximale betrouwbaarheid, duurzaamheid en continuïteit waarborgen precies waar de datacentersector om vraagt.

 

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Mechanical Engineer binnen onze Datacenter afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de engineering en de technische coördinatie van complexe werktuigbouwkundige installaties. Denk aan geavanceerde koelconcepten (zoals indirect/direct evaporative cooling, liquid cooling en chiller‑oplossingen), luchtbehandeling, warmte‑terugwinning, water‑ en gassystemen en klimaattechnische infrastructuur die 24/7 betrouwbaar moet functioneren.

Vanaf de eerste conceptfase denk je mee over technische strategieën en ontwerpkeuzes die aansluiten op schaalbaarheid, energie‑efficiëntie, beschikbaarheidsnormen (Tier III/) en de steeds strengere duurzaamheidsdoelen. Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines zoals elektrotechniek, bouwkunde en security en bewaakt de technische integriteit en samenhang van het totaalontwerp. Dankzij jouw senioriteit fungeer je als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, ontwerpteams en leveranciers. Je stuurt waar nodig bij, begeleidt junior en medior engineers en draagt actief bij aan kennisontwikkeling binnen het datacenterteam.
 

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Ontwerpen van mechanische gebouw gebonden systemen, waaronder HVAC (verwarming, ventilatie en airconditioning), koeling en andere Datacenter specifieke installaties.

  • Meedenken in de concept‑ en ontwerpfase en vertalen van klantwensen naar haalbare en schaalbare technische oplossingen.

  • Coördineren van ontwerpactiviteiten met andere disciplines en bewaken van planning, kwaliteit en integrale samenhang.

  • Technisch aanspreekpunt zijn voor klanten, partners, leveranciers en interne stakeholders/junioren.

  • Begeleiden van engineers binnen het project en bijdragen aan kennisontwikkeling in het team.

  • Ondersteunen bij aanbestedingen, kostenramingen en kwaliteitscontroles (zowel ontwerp als uitvoering).

 

Waar werken we aan

We hebben meegewerkt aan de bouw van diverse nieuwe datacenters in o.a. Milaan, Amsterdam. We hebben ondersteuning geboden bij het ontwerp van de mechanische, elektrische en sanitaire installaties voor de bouw. Na het ontwerp van de mechanische, elektrische en sanitaire installaties heeft Deerns toezicht gehouden op de bouwplaats om de kwaliteit van de installaties te controleren en heeft het als Commissioning manager voor de hoofdaannemer gefungeerd. Deerns heeft ook ondersteuning geboden bij de bouw om een Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED)-certificering te behalen. LEED-certificering betekent dat een gebouw gezond en zeer efficiënt is en betere milieuprestaties levert.

Het team 

Je maakt onderdeel uit van een team met circa 16 collega’s, binnen de bredere organisatie waarin je meer dan 750 collega's in verschillende sectoren zal hebben. Het Data Center team is een hecht team dat bestaat uit projectmanagers, adviseurs, mechanical- en electrical engineers. De cultuur is open, kennis gedreven en gericht op samenwerking en plezier in het werk. Bovendien werk je in een hecht, integraal projectteam waarin ieders kennis en expertise optimaal wordt benut. Dit zorgt niet alleen voor sterke samenwerking, maar ook voor persoonlijke groei. De unit Datacenters werkt voornamelijk in opdracht van Colocattie providers, banken en grote bedrijven, zowel in Nederland als internationaal. Dit zorgt ervoor dat je aan gevarieerde projecten werkt en geen dag hetzelfde is. Daarnaast werk je regelmatig samen met onze units in Engeland, Spanje en Brazilie  waardoor je onderdeel bent van een sterk internationaal netwerk.


Dit ben jij 

  • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde hbo- of wo‑opleiding in Werktuigbouwkunde, Installatietechniek of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring (bij voorkeur 5+) als Mechanical Engineer binnen complexe gebouwgebonden installaties ervaring met datacenters of mission critical omgevingen is een sterke pre.

  • Je hebt ervaring met multidisciplinaire projectomgevingen en kunt uitstekend samenwerken met collega's uit andere vakgebieden.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Je bent vaardig met MS Office, Revit, BIM360 en relevante reken- en simulatiesoftware (zoals Vabi, CFD‑tools, koellastberekeningen e.d.).

  • Je bent analytisch sterk, technisch nieuwsgierig en schakelt moeiteloos tussen detailniveau en totaaloverzicht.

  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, communiceert duidelijk en voelt je thuis in een rol waarin techniek, kwaliteit en klantcontact samenkomen.

 

Dit bieden wij 

  • Een functie van 32-40 uur per week met een bijpassend salaris. 

  • Uitdagende projecten voor toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in Nederland en internationaal. 

  • Een werkomgeving waarin innovatie en duurzaamheid dagelijks in de praktijk worden gebracht. 

  • Aandacht voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling en vitaliteit met ruime opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden, fiets- en sportregelingen, flexibele werkuren, 33 vakantiedagen en mogelijkheid tot aankopen van extra dagen. 

  • Hybride werken, waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om afwisselend thuis en op kantoor in Den Haag te werken. 

  • Een team waar samenwerking en collegialiteit voorop staan en waar we informeel met elkaar omgaan. 

  • Duurzaamheid zit in onze genen. Dit uit zich bijvoorbeeld in een mobiliteitsbeleid waar gezondheid en duurzaamheid voorop staan. Veel van onze kantoren liggen bij OV-knooppunten, fietsen wordt aangemoedigd en je reiskosten worden 100% vergoed op basis van OV. 

 

Over Deerns 
Deerns is als onafhankelijk ingenieursbureau gespecialiseerd in advies, ontwerp en uitvoeringsbegeleiding op het vlak van installatietechniek, bouwfysica, energievoorziening en duurzaamheid. Onze expertises dragen bij aan duurzame, intelligente en toekomstbestendige gebouwen die de processen van onze opdrachtgevers optimaal ondersteunen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp van de installaties en het realiseren van een goed comfort en een prettig klimaat in de meest uiteenlopende gebouwen; van kantoren, tot luchthavens en van ziekenhuizen tot datacenters. 

 

Daarnaast is Deerns benoemd als Great Place to Work!

description:

De uitdaging 
Als Teamleider Brandveiligheid bij Deerns sta jij aan het roer van een groeiend team van specialisten en geef je richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling ervan. Aan jou de uitdaging om deze groei in goede banen te leiden, het team verder uit te bouwen en te versterken zowel in omvang als in kwaliteit en positionering.

Je combineert strategisch leiderschap met inhoudelijke diepgang en bent bepalend voor de kwaliteit, koers en groei van het team. Je creëert een omgeving waarin professionals excelleren, kennis wordt gedeeld en innovatie wordt gestimuleerd.

Of het nu gaat om de nieuwbouw van een ziekenhuis, een ‘state of the art’ cleanroom, de bouw van een (houten) woontoren, of de nieuwbouw, renovatie of transformatie van een (multi-tenant) kantoorcomplex. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Ben jij een Senior Mechanical Engineer die impact wil maken in één van de meest kritische technische omgevingen? Je combineert technische diepgang met overzicht en neemt een sleutelrol in complexe projecten.

De uitdaging 

In deze rol ben jij de inhoudelijke werktuigbouwkundige spil binnen complexe luchthavenprojecten, zowel nationaal als internationaal. Je opereert midden in de luchthavenoperatie, waar veiligheid, continuïteit en kwaliteit leidend zijn. Je neemt het voortouw in het ontwikkelen van slimme, integrale installatietechnische oplossingen en adviseert opdrachtgevers op strategisch en conceptueel niveau.


Werken in een 24uurs luchthavenomgeving maakt deze rol bijzonder dynamisch en uitdagend. De complexiteit van zowel de klant als de situatie vraagt om flexibiliteit, snel schakelen en creatief denken. Juist deze afwisseling zorgt ervoor dat geen dag hetzelfde is.


Samen met multidisciplinaire projectteams geef je richting aan ontwerp en realisatie, met directe invloed op de dagelijkse operatie én de toekomstbestendigheid van luchthavens. Met jouw expertise en leiderschap til je niet alleen projecten, maar ook collega’s naar een hoger niveau.

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Je ontwerpt en adviseert zelfstandig over complexe werktuigbouwkundige installaties binnen luchthavenprojecten en vertaalt ontwerpen van schets tot technische uitwerking in AutoCAD en BIM. Je zet BIM‑structuren op en begeleidt en corrigeert junior collega’s.

  • Het inhoudelijk bijdragen aan conceptontwikkeling en het vertalen van ontwerpuitgangspunten naar haalbare en integrale oplossingen.

  • Het uitvoeren en controleren van berekeningen en het beoordelen van het werk van engineers en technici.

  • Het afstemmen met projectleiders, ontwerpers, andere disciplines en externe partijen over technische keuzes en randvoorwaarden.

  • Het signaleren van risico’s en afwijkingen in kwaliteit, planning en budget en hierover proactief schakelen binnen het projectteam.

  • Het begeleiden, coachen en inhoudelijk ondersteunen van junior engineers binnen projecten.

  • Het leveren van input voor rapportages, adviezen en offertes.

  • Het actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling en kwaliteitsverbetering binnen de afdeling Airports.

De projecten waar je trots op kunt zijn

  • We werken aan het verduurzamen van Terminal 1 & 2 van Schiphol, zo’n 40% van de gehele terminal: De huidige installaties die zorgen voor een aangenaam binnenklimaat, maken gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen. Wij werken aan het ontwerp van de nieuwe installatie, die warmte en koude opslag combineert met warmtepompen zodat Schiphol energieneutraal de toekomst tegemoet kan. De uitdaging van dit project zit met name in het toepassen van nieuwe techniek in een bestaand gebouw waar ruimte moet worden gecreëerd om alle apparatuur en leidingen goed onder te brengen en te zorgen dat elke ruimte wordt voorzien van voldoende verwarming en koeling. Dit moet zorgen voor een aangename passagiersbeleving maar ook voor het aanbieden van een prettig werkklimaat voor de medewerkers op Schiphol, rekening houdend met hun dagelijkse activiteiten.

title: Director Research & Development
description:
Purpose of the job

The Director Research & Development (R&D) leads the exploration and development of potential business and technology initiatives, from initial ideation through feasibility analysis, testing, validation and proof of concept (POC)/prototyping. For assigned initiatives, the role coordinates the full exploration phase and develops substantiated proposals for consideration and approval by the relevant governance bodies.

 

The role requires a proactive, self-motivated approach, the ability to work independently and to manage multiple subjects concurrently. Initiatives may range from joint venture (JV) model enhancements and artificial intelligence (AI) to customer experience development and new approaches to distribution.

 

KEY RESULT AREAS/ KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

Ideation and concept generation

  • Ensure that potential initiatives align with SkyTeam’s strategic goals and assess their purpose, expected value, rationale and the implications of not proceeding.
  • Ask relevant questions and gather appropriate information to support well-founded recommendations and help build consensus among member airlines.
  • Organize and facilitate ideation and brainstorming sessions.
  • Monitor developments in the transport industry and at IATA to identify emerging trends and opportunities or gaps for improving existing legacy systems.
  • Generate, collect and develop ideas and concepts in partnership with member airlines and other contributors for marketable initiatives that could become SkyTeam priorities.

 

Exploration, feasibility and concept development

  • Lead the exploration of assigned initiatives, including relevant research and data analysis, feasibility assessments, business cases, business requirements documents (BRDs) and POCs/prototypes, as appropriate.
  • Analyze business and technical challenges across different airline domains; identify and assess potential solutions and determine the most relevant product concept, design and feasibility approach.
  • Develop evidence-based recommendations, supported by tangible data and analysis, that demonstrate the potential business value of the proposed initiative.
  • Prepare proposals and supporting materials for review and approval by the relevant SkyTeam and member-airline decision-making bodies.

 

Stakeholder engagement and governance

  • Work effectively within SkyTeam’s matrix organization and collaborate with member airlines, internal teams and relevant external contributors.
  • Engage with operational and technical stakeholders, including senior decision-makers, to understand requirements, assess options and build alignment around proposed concepts.
  • Support informed decisions through clear analysis and recommendations. Strategic prioritization and formal initiative approval remain with the Executive Board (EB), Strategy Committee (StratCom) and relevant governance bodies.

 

Transition to implementation

  • Following approval, coordinate with Digital/Delivery to transfer the agreed concept, supporting analysis, business requirements and relevant POC findings for MVP development and implementation.
  • Where assigned, act as project owner or coordinate relevant project activities within the agreed governance arrangements. Accountability for implementation transfers to Digital/Delivery.
  • Budget, resource or external-partner responsibilities may be assigned depending on the approved initiative and are not standing responsibilities of the role.


Your profile

REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE

  • Strong airline-industry background, with demonstrated experience in core airline businesses such as PRM, distribution, operational research and e-sales.

  • Excellent facilitation skills, with the ability to engage and guide diverse groups towards innovative solutions.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain and present complex concepts and inspire teams.
  • Analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to evaluate complex options and communicate evidence-based recommendations.
  • Ability to work independently on multiple subjects and collaborate effectively in a multicultural matrix organization.

Responsibilities and tasks of the position are not limited to the above mentioned, and deviations can occur at any point in time as the position evolves and in concert with the manager.

title: UX Designer
description:
Of je jezelf nu UX Designer, Interaction Designer of Product Designer noemt: jij zorgt ervoor dat digitale producten en services logisch werken voor de mensen die ze gebruiken. Wat ga je doen als UX Designer bij Norday?

Bij Norday werken we aan complexe vraagstukken waarvoor niet altijd meteen duidelijk is wat de juiste oplossing is. Nieuwe technologie, veranderende verwachtingen en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen vragen organisaties om richting te kiezen én die richting concreet te maken.

Je werkt aan nieuwe digitale platforms, slimme tools, gepersonaliseerde ervaringen en nieuwe diensten. Soms ligt er al een duidelijke strategie, soms help je die samen met het team verder vormgeven. Je bent gedurende het hele proces betrokken: van het eerste vraagstuk en onderzoek tot concept, ontwerp, validatie en realisatie.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Je duikt in de context van een vraagstuk en brengt gebruikers, behoeften, doelen en knelpunten in kaart;

  • Je maakt complexe vraagstukken begrijpelijk en helpt klanten en teams om keuzes te maken;

  • Je faciliteert workshops en co-creatiesessies met klanten, gebruikers en collega’s;

  • Je bewaakt de gebruikerservaring tot het product of de service daadwerkelijk werkt;

  • heeft ervaring met complexe digitale vraagstukken en het ontwerpen van digitale producten of services;
