title: Senior People Partner
description:
Senior People Partner

Cloudscaler | London | People Team | Reports to the Chief People Officer | £55,000–£75,000

Someone has to own the People initiative that doesn’t fit neatly into anyone’s week and the case nobody else should be handling. That someone is you — not as an escalation point, but as the person who runs the day-to-day of this function.

THE MOMENT

Cloudscaler is 130 people today. We’ll be 170 by the end of this year, and roughly double again in 2027. The People function is being built in real time alongside that growth, rather than inherited from someone who left years ago.

You’ll be the first hire into the People team. For roughly your first year you’ll be the only People professional alongside the CPO, which means running the whole day-to-day of the function: the hardest casework and initiatives, and the operational core that keeps everything moving. A People Partner is planned to join later in 2027, and at that point the operational administration moves to them.

This is also a role built with room to grow. As the team expands beyond that second hire, we expect this role to take on day-to-day operational leadership of the People Partner practice, but that isn’t the shape of it on day one.

WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT

In most People teams, the senior generalist is just a People Partner with a harder case queue. Here, the difference is ownership, not just difficulty.

  • Complex casework: Rather than simply handling harder cases, you’ll own the most complex cases end to end, with no hand back.

  • People initiatives: Rather than contributing to initiatives someone else drives, you’ll own them from design through to embedding.

  • Decision-making: Rather than escalating ambiguity upward, you’ll make the sensible call and document your reasoning.

  • CPO partnership: Rather than acting in a support role to the CPO, you’ll be an operational partner they can confidently delegate to.

To be clear about the level: The CPO still designs the People strategy and the systems architecture. You own how it runs day to day, and you’re trusted to run a whole initiative, not just a case. That is a different job to People Partner, not a bigger version of the same one.

THE ROLE

You’ll sit in the People team reporting to the Chief People Officer. Three strands make up the job:

  • Casework: The employee relations situations with the most complexity or sensitivity land with you, start to finish.

  • Initiatives: When the CPO needs a piece of work owned (a policy rollout, a wellbeing programme, a piece of the reward or benefits agenda), you take it from design through to something that runs.

  • Operations: Until the People Partner joins, you’ll own payroll and benefits administration, onboarding, screening and security clearances, and keeping Rippling accurate.

When the People Partner joins, they’ll report to the CPO. You won’t manage them formally, but you’ll lead their handover, you’ll be the person they come to first, and your judgement will set the standard for how this function operates day to day.

WHERE THE ROLE STARTS AND STOPS

New roles get vague, so here is the boundary as we see it today.

Yours

  • The most complex and sensitive employee relations casework, end to end.

  • Full ownership of People initiatives, from design to embedding.

  • Acting as the CPO’s operational partner on ambiguous or cross-cutting problems.

  • Until the People Partner joins (planned for later in 2027):

    • Payroll and benefits administration, including the monthly payroll cycle in Rippling and Mintago.

    • Pre-onboarding, onboarding and probation.

    • Background screening in Zinc.

    • Security clearance coordination.

    • Rippling data quality, workflows and reporting.

    • Our working groups and committees.

  • Once the People Partner joins:

    • A structured handover of the operational core.

    • Day-to-day guidance for the People Partner.

Shared

  • Ashby, which Talent Acquisition owns. You’ll work in it from offer through to start date on every hire until the People Partner joins, and on senior hires after that.

  • Mentoring and supporting the People Partner on their casework and initiatives, once they join.

Not yours

  • Recruitment delivery, which sits with Talent Acquisition.

  • The design of the People strategy, the operating model and the systems architecture, which sit with the CPO.

  • Formal line management of the People Partner, who will report to the CPO.

THE STACK

  • Rippling: Our single source of truth. Until the People Partner joins you’ll run it day to day, including the monthly payroll cycle, data quality and workflows, and you’ll use its reporting at a level that supports whole initiatives.

  • Zinc: Background screening. You’ll run checks for every new joiner until the People Partner joins, and stay close to the senior and sensitive hires after that.

  • Ashby: Owned by Talent Acquisition. You’ll work in it from offer through to start date on the hires you’re responsible for.

  • Claude: A daily tool here. You’ll use it for casework preparation, drafting policy and communications, and pulling together the analysis behind an initiative.

  • Mintago: Our employee benefits and financial wellbeing platform (pensions, salary sacrifice and financial advice). You’ll administer it and keep enrolment accurate until the People Partner takes it on.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own the hardest casework. You’ll run our most complex and sensitive employee relations cases end to end, with the CPO there to sense-check rather than take over.

  • Own initiatives, not tasks. You’ll take a People initiative from a rough brief to something that’s running and embedded, rather than handing it back once the interesting part is done.

  • Run the operational core. Until the People Partner joins, you’ll own the monthly payroll cycle in Rippling, benefits administration including Mintago, onboarding, background screening and security clearances. Accurate, on time, and documented as you go.

  • Hand it over well. When the People Partner arrives, you’ll give them a working system and a clear handover, then stay the person they come to first and the judgement others in the function measure themselves against.

  • Partner with senior leaders. You’ll be credible with leaders on the most difficult conversations: complex change, capability, and situations without a clean playbook.

  • Use AI properly. You’ll use Claude daily to take time out of your own week, checking anything that touches a decision about a person and owning the outcome.

  • Improve what you find. You’ll spot the gaps in policy, process or practice before anyone else does, and bring the CPO a considered view on the fix, not just the problem.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 12 MONTHS

  • You’re running the most complex ER cases with confidence, and the CPO isn’t being pulled into them.

  • At least one or two People initiatives have gone from a rough brief to something genuinely embedded, owned by you.

  • Payroll, benefits, onboarding and clearances run accurately and on time, and every process is documented well enough to hand over.

  • You’ve helped shape the People Partner hire, so the handover is ready when they land.

  • Senior leaders treat you as a credible operational partner, not an escalation point.

  • You’ve made and documented sensible calls in genuinely ambiguous situations, and they’ve held up.

  • The CPO can hand you an ambiguous problem and trust it gets shaped properly.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Deep employee relations experience. You’ve run complex disciplinaries, grievances and change situations yourself, and you know exactly when to escalate and when not to. CIPD qualification, or solid progress towards it, is welcome.

  • A track record of owning initiatives. You can point to work you took from a brief to something that actually ran, not just a project you contributed to.

  • Hands-on with the operational detail. You’ve owned or closely supported a payroll cycle, benefits administration and onboarding, and you’re comfortable being accountable for their accuracy while also carrying the senior work.

  • Credible with senior leaders. You can hold your own in a difficult conversation with someone under real pressure and be listened to.

  • Comfortable operating near-autonomously. You don’t need a playbook for everything. You make a sensible call, write it down, and check it with the CPO afterwards.

  • Ready to grow into people leadership. You won’t formally manage anyone at the start, but you’ll induct and guide the People Partner when they join, and you should want to lead a team as the structure catches up.

  • Discreet and organised at volume. Complex casework and live initiatives, often at the same time. You’ll need a system, and it can’t be your memory.

THE HONEST PART

This role sits in an odd space for now: senior in scope and judgement, without a team underneath it yet. Until the People Partner joins later in 2027, you’ll also be the whole operational team, so a payroll deadline and a complex grievance can land in the same week. That eases as the function grows, but it means the authority you carry day to day has to come from the quality of your work, not a job title.

You are not designing the People strategy or the systems architecture. The CPO does that. What you get instead is real ownership of the hardest cases and the initiatives that matter, a close working relationship with the CPO, and a genuine path toward leading the People Partner practice as it grows.

This probably isn’t for you if you want a formal team from day one, or if you’d rather leave payroll and onboarding to someone else. It probably is for you if you want to prove you can run this function well enough, top to bottom, that a team gets built around you.

If that sounds like the challenge you’ve been looking for, let’s talk.

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

The Credit Risk team is part of Airwallex’s Second Line of Defence and helps the company grow responsibly as a global financial platform.
We work at the intersection of credit, FX, and counterparty risk, partnering closely with Product, Sales, Operations, Treasury, Finance, Engineering, Compliance, and Legal to enable commercial growth while protecting Airwallex from financial loss and excessive risk exposure. This is a team for analytical, commercially minded risk leaders who are energized by building scalable frameworks and practical controls across a fast-moving, multi-currency global network.

What you'll do
As a Senior Manager, Credit Risk, you will lead Airwallex's global second-line oversight of credit, FX, and counterparty risk. You will set the risk guardrails that allow the business to grow safely across merchant acquiring, charge cards, FX, treasury, settlement, and banking-partner activities. Reporting to the Senior Director, Financial Risk, you will own the global framework, risk appetite, limits, governance, and portfolio oversight for these risk areas. You will provide independent challenge to first-line decisions and act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across the business.

This role is based in London.

title: Head of Data & Intelligence
description:
Creandum's edge has always been people: the network, the judgment, the hustle. To sharpen our edge, we need to make everything those people learn compound: every meeting, every diligence process, every founder relationship feeding a shared foundation instead of evaporating into inboxes and individual heads.

You will build and own that foundation: the firm's data platform, the intelligence layer on top of it, and the governance that makes partners willing to trust it with their most sensitive work.

This is a new function, and you are its first hire. You'll start hands-on-keyboard and stay that way for the time being; but you're building an estate the firm will run on, and the mandate grows with what you prove.

You report to the Operating Partner, but work directly and independently with every member of the firm.

We believe different viewpoints drive our growth, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

What you'll own

The data platform. The firm's data architecture end to end: warehouse, ingestion from core systems (CRM, meeting transcripts, documents, email/calendar), entity resolution, and data quality. One person, one company, one deal – consistent across every source. This is foundational; everything else flows from it.

The intelligence layer. Retrieval, search & agent tooling that give everyone's AI real firm context, serving both individual workflows (bottom-up) and firm-wide platforms (top-down). Built for passive compounding: the system gets better as people work and as models improve, without depending on anyone's discipline.

Access, trust, and AI risk. The access model as structural enforcement, not instructions: who sees what, with identity, provenance, and audit. Sensitive fund and partner data protected to a standard the partnership will trust, plus the AI-specific risk judgment (injection containment, egress, tool guardrails) for everything the function ships, in collaboration with legal/regulatory counsel.

Technology strategy and the tool estate. Accountability for whether the firm's tools are the right ones: evaluation, integration, and replacement of the systems and data sources the firm runs on, in close partnership with the stakeholders who use them. Buy when buying is better; build when building is better. You have the mandate to choose, and then execute on your decision. Make sure security, compliance and budget are part of the equation.

What you'll deliver

First 6 months. A complete map of the firm's data and systems. The foundational data platform stood up. Two or three lightweight tools shipped that visibly improve how a team works. A clear, prioritized 12–18 month roadmap, authored by you and agreed with the partnership.

By 12 months. V1 of the firm's shared intelligence layer live and in daily use. The diligence process made genuinely multiplayer; firm knowledge and meeting history informing live deals instead of sitting unused. Measurable adoption, reported honestly, with failures killed as quickly as the wins are shipped.

Beyond. The roadmap is yours to define. Candidates for the frontier: productizing how the firm wins deals, network intelligence that answers "who do we know" in seconds, platform tools founders can self-serve, and operational automation across finance, events, and admin.

How you'll work

  • Builder first. You ship personally. This is not a role for someone who wants a team of ten doing the building.

  • Co-creation, not solo genius. Stakeholders across the firm (investment, platform, marketing, operations, etc.) steer, test, and tune what you build. Within a year, everyone at the firm should be able to point at something they had a hand in shaping.

  • Product discipline. Prototype, validate with real users, kill what doesn't get adopted. Usage is the metric; expect and budget for churn.

  • Scale deliberately. You start solo. As the foundation proves out, you'll orchestrate internal or external build resources and potentially grow the function. You are prepared to identify, leverage and lead exceptional talent to help achieve results.

Who you are

  • You've shipped a real data or AI product end to end (pipelines, retrieval, and the product surface) and people actually used it.

  • Deep, hands-on command of data architecture, warehousing, and governance. Fluent with embeddings, retrieval, and agents that act, not just answer.

  • You treat access control and provenance as product features, not compliance chores.

  • Low ego, high agency, energized by a blank page. Excited to tackle the unglamorous work (entity resolution, data hygiene, permissions) that everything depends on.

  • You can sit with an investor, an EA, and a founder in the same week and design for all of them. Venture experience isn't required, but you'll need to earn a front-line view of the work fast.

  • You can say "no" and "not yet" to smart, senior people and make them glad you did.

What this role is not

  • Not IT operations: endpoint, device & office infrastructure are handled by our managed IT partner.

  • Not reg compliance: policy & DORA workstreams are owned by legal, with your input on anything AI.

  • Not a reporting function: you build systems that answer questions, not dashboards on request.

Why this role

You'll have a blank page, real budget influence, direct partnership access, and a firm small enough that what you build touches everyone within weeks. The firms that figure this out will compound differently from the ones that don't. This is the seat where that happens.

We are seeking a hands-on valve expert who will serve as Pangea’s company-wide technical authority for valves. The mission is to build the internal capability to specify, design, analyse, source, test, qualify, industrialise, and continuously improve critical valves for our propulsion systems.

The first priority will be to assess and internalise selected valves used on Nereus, starting where technically and commercially justified with HTP-compatible valves. The scope can then expand to other valve families and propulsion programmes based on risk, recurring cost, lead time, supply-chain dependence, and strategic value.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with strong technical leadership. You will work closely with Fluidics and across Systems, Design, Analysis, Materials, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test, and Operations, taking decisions from first principles and carrying them through to validated hardware.

Key responsibilities

· Act as Pangea’s technical reference for valves, owning design decisions, technical reviews, risk acceptance, and the valve technology roadmap across propulsion programmes.

· Define the valve internalisation strategy and prioritise candidates using performance, safety, development risk, recurring cost, lead time, supplier dependence, and manufacturing scalability.

· Lead the initial Nereus workstream for HTP-compatible solenoid valves: capture requirements and interfaces; benchmark make-versus-buy options; select concepts; and define the development and qualification plan.

· Own the full product lifecycle—from requirements, architecture, trade-offs, detailed design, analysis, materials and sealing selection through prototyping, testing, qualification, production release, and in-service improvement.

· Develop or approve valve sizing and dynamic models covering flow capacity and pressure drop, actuation force and margin, response time, leakage, thermal effects, friction, hysteresis, fatigue, wear, contamination sensitivity, and lifetime.

· Establish verification logic, acceptance criteria, instrumentation, test matrices, and qualification evidence for nominal, off-nominal, proof, endurance, environmental, and compatibility testing.

· Ensure compatibility with HTP and, as applicable, cryogenic, high-pressure, hot, reactive, or hazardous fluids through disciplined materials, cleanliness, sealing, lubrication, and contamination-control choices.

· Resolve difficult hardware problems through structured failure investigation, test-data interpretation, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and design iteration.

· Lead technical engagement with valve, actuator, coil, seal, and manufacturing suppliers; review proposals, drawings, analyses, process controls, inspection plans, qualification evidence, deviations, and non-conformances.

· Create reusable internal standards, design rules, calculation methods, test procedures, lessons learned, and product architectures, while mentoring engineers and raising valve competence across the company.

Initial Mandate

Build a credible make-versus-buy and development plan for Nereus HTP-compatible solenoid valves, close the highest-risk knowledge gaps with analysis and testing, and leave behind a repeatable internal valve-development capability.

What you need to be successful

Education

· Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, Fluid Mechanics, or a closely related engineering discipline.

· Additional specialization in fluid systems, cryogenics, mechanical design, tribology, sealing technology, materials, or control systems would be advantageous.

Experience

· 8 to 10 years or more of relevant engineering experience, with substantial direct ownership of valve or closely related fluid-control hardware.

· Demonstrated hands-on delivery of hardware from requirements and concept selection through detailed design, test, qualification, and production support.

title: Product Frontend Engineer
description:
quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where this is going

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.

One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.

Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled.

Why this role exists

Today, quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with.

What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards.

That is the opening.

How we work

We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing.

We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high.

Tasks

What you will own

Everything on the screen:

  • The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account.
  • The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components.
  • The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device.
  • Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native.
  • The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished.

Where design ends, engineering begins.

We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed.

You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building.

You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels.

You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does.

Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works.

The Team

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action.

This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)

VAULTED AG is a Swiss deep-tech scale-up born out of research at ETH Zurich and the EMPA innovation ecosystem. We combine world-class engineering, computational design, digital fabrication, and advanced manufacturing to rethink how buildings are designed and delivered, at a time when AI, automation, and data-driven design are transforming the industry.

Our core technology is the Rippmann Floor System® (RFS), a lightweight, prefabricated structural floor system that reduces concrete use by up to 70%, steel use by up to 90%, and embodied carbon by up to 75% compared with conventional concrete slabs. After years of research and technology development, VAULTED is entering a major growth phase across Switzerland, Belgium, the UK, and the US.

Location: Dübendorf ZH, Switzerland · Start date: Q1 2027 · 100% · Reporting to the CEO

Tasks

We are hiring a Chief Operating Officer to build the operational engine that turns confirmed projects into reliable, profitable, and scalable delivery. This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines deep project and construction industry understanding with strong operational and commercial judgement, but also someone who is very hands-on and enjoys setting up the systems and processes behind our operations.

The COO takes ownership once a project is won and oversees project delivery, project management, supplier and prefabrication partnerships, operational contracting, and project economics. The role ensures that scope, timelines, quality, risks, resources, costs, and margins are transparent and actively managed, while giving project teams the structure and support they need to deliver.

A core mandate is to make VAULTED better with every project: translate project learnings into stronger processes, supplier setups, handovers, delivery standards, and feedback to engineering and R&D. The COO builds the operational capabilities required to scale across Switzerland, Belgium, the UK, and the US without adding unnecessary complexity. This is a 100% role.

  • Operational leadership & project delivery: Build and lead the operating model required to deliver VAULTED projects reliably and efficiently. Oversee the project management function, set clear execution standards, and support escalation and decision-making on active projects.
  • Project economics & controlling: Establish disciplined project controlling across budgets, costs, forecasts, changes, and margins, ensuring deviations and commercial implications are visible early and actively addressed.
  • Supplier, production & prefabrication ecosystem: Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and manage production partners, suppliers, and prefabricators across relevant markets, ensuring quality, capacity, cost competitiveness, and delivery reliability.
  • Contracting, procurement & operational risk: Shape supplier and operational contracts, procurement approaches, and partnership models that improve delivery certainty, manage risk, protect margins, and maintain strategic flexibility.
  • Cross-functional leadership & resources: Connect project management, engineering, design, R&D, commercial teams, and external partners. Create clarity on priorities, responsibilities, capacity, and trade-offs, and ensure smooth handovers from sales into execution.
  • Continuous improvement & international scaling: Turn project learnings into better processes, standards, supplier setups, and execution methods, while building operational readiness for Switzerland, Belgium, the UK, the US, and future markets.

Requirements

  • Typically 8+ years of relevant experience in project delivery, operations, construction, architecture, or prefabrication, preferably with an engineering background.
  • Proven responsibility for complex, multi-stakeholder projects or project portfolios, with the ability to oversee execution while staying close enough to intervene when needed.
  • Strong practical understanding of how construction or engineered products move from design and procurement through production, coordination, and delivery.
  • Strong commercial and financial discipline, including project budgets, cost drivers, forecasting, margins, change management, and operational risk.
  • Experience negotiating and managing suppliers, production partners, contracts, and long-term operational relationships.
  • Strong leadership skills with high empathy and high standards: able to build trust, set clear expectations, challenge constructively, make decisions, and hold teams and partners to commitments.
  • Strategic and hands-on working style: able to build scalable systems and processes while staying pragmatic, close to project realities, and comfortable solving difficult execution issues.
  • Fluency in English is required; German is a strong advantage. Based in Zurich/Dübendorf, or willing to work primarily from Dübendorf, with occasional national and international travel to project, production, and construction sites.

title: ICT System Engineer - S1 bis S5 - Mönchaltorf
description:
Entwickeln. Betreiben. Verbessern. Weiterentwickeln.

Sidmar sucht ICT System Engineers auf unterschiedlichen Kompetenzstufen (S1–S5) zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Mönchaltorf.

Ob Sie als S1 Junior ICT System Engineer am Anfang Ihrer beruflichen Laufbahn stehen oder als S5 Senior Expert über langjährige Erfahrung in komplexen ICT-Umgebungen verfügen – wir suchen engagierte Fachpersonen, die Freude an technischen Herausforderungen haben, Verantwortung übernehmen und unsere ICT-Services kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln möchten.

Unsere Kompetenzstruktur orientiert sich am Schweizer ICT-Rollenmodell (Rollen der ICT). Die Anforderungen an Fachwissen, Selbstständigkeit, Komplexität und Verantwortung steigen dabei von S1 bis S5 kontinuierlich an.

Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgaben

Abhängig von Ihrer Kompetenzstufe und Erfahrung übernehmen Sie unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:

  • Planung, Implementierung, Betrieb und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von ICT-Systemen und Infrastrukturen.
  • Administration und Betreuung von Servern, Netzwerken, Cloud- und weiteren ICT-Plattformen.
  • Analyse und Behebung von technischen Störungen und Systemproblemen.
  • Überwachung von Verfügbarkeit, Performance, Sicherheit und Kapazität der Systeme.
  • Durchführung von System-Upgrades, Migrationen, Integrationen und Konfigurationsänderungen.
  • Aufnahme, Analyse und Bewertung von Benutzer-, Geschäfts- und technischen Anforderungen sowie deren Übersetzung in geeignete ICT-Lösungen.
  • Evaluation verschiedener technischer Lösungsvarianten unter Berücksichtigung technischer, organisatorischer, sicherheitsrelevanter und wirtschaftlicher Aspekte.
  • Mitarbeit bei Systemdesign, Tests, Validierung und Implementierung.
  • Erkennen und Beurteilen technischer und operativer Risiken.
  • Erstellung und Pflege von Systemdokumentationen, Spezifikationen und technischen Anleitungen.
  • Unterstützung von Change-, Release- und Service-Management-Prozessen.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Business-Anwendern, Kunden, internen ICT-Teams und externen Dienstleistern.
  • Aktive Mitarbeit an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer ICT-Prozesse, Systeme und Services.

Auf den Kompetenzstufen S3–S5 übernehmen Sie zusätzlich Verantwortung für zunehmend komplexe Systeme und Lösungen. Dazu gehören beispielsweise Systemdesign, Architektur, Machbarkeitsanalysen, technische Bewertungen, Stakeholder-Koordination sowie die fachliche Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung anderer Engineers.

  • Bereitschaft, sich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und Wissen mit anderen zu teilen.
  • Für S3–S5: Erfahrung mit komplexen ICT-Umgebungen, Anforderungsanalyse, Lösungsdesign, technischen Bewertungen und Stakeholder-Management.

title: Business Development Manager - Market Insights (m/w/d) 90-100%
description:

Um an die entscheidenden Informationen zu gelangen, baust du Allianzen und ein tragfähiges Netzwerk mit Industrie-, Handels- und Foodservice-Partnern auf.

Deine Erkenntnisse verdichtest du zu Trendanalysen, Business Cases und Forecasts, die strategische Entscheidungen stützen. Im Marktteam tauschst du dich eng mit Produktmanagement, Technik und Verkauf aus, bringst relevante Market Insights aus den einzelnen Ländern ein und gibst damit auch Impulse für die Weiterentwicklung von Produkten und Serviceleistungen. Qualifikation

Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Lebensmitteltechnologie, Agrarwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung und bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Marktstrukturen und Trends mit. In der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit trittst du überzeugend und mit dem nötigen Durchsetzungsvermögen auf. Deutsch ist für die Zusammenarbeit am Standort Burgdorf zwingend, Englisch für das internationale Geschäft; für die nötige Präsenz vor Ort bist du idealerweise regional verankert.

Das erwartet dich bei RONDO
Herz – Tradition – Pioniergeist! Dies umschreibt die Werte von RONDO. Vertrauen schenken – gemeinsam wachsen, Wort halten und Sorge tragen, Mut haben und Neues wagen. title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
Fastned is one of Europe's leading fast-charging networks. Active across nine countries, we have spent nearly 15 years building the infrastructure, expertise and brand that define premium fast charging in Europe. What sets us apart is our focus on reliability, sustainability and the energy transition. We have been awarded “Best Charging Network” in the UK, France, Switzerland and the Netherlands, further establishing Fastned as a leading player in the field. This is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and help us accelerate our operations in the DACH region to the next level! Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution.

The role is based in our beautiful office in Cologne, where your over 50 future colleagues cannot wait to meet you!

Your role

As Senior Operations Manager DACH, you will initially focus on Germany and Switzerland while helping shape the future of operations across the wider DACH region, including Austria as the organisation expands. Germany is entering a major growth phase, with the network expected to expand significantly in the coming years. You will help design an operating model that can absorb this growth while keeping uptime above 99%, improving customer experience and managing costs and team growth responsibly.

You will have significant ownership of how operations are run in Germany and Switzerland. As the key operational point of contact for German, Swiss and future Austrian stations, you will work closely with country and central teams, as well as contractors and service providers. Your scope spans preventive maintenance of chargers and stations, station appearance and amenities, reactive maintenance, spare parts logistics, and the continuous improvement of our operations and processes. Within the broader direction set by Fastned, you will define priorities, improve the operating model and make pragmatic decisions that keep the region performing as the network grows.

Your responsibilities

Team leadership

Lead and grow the DACH field team.

  • Supervising, coaching and developing a team of five Field Engineers and a Station Manager, with a Maintenance Coordinator joining over time, ensuring they work safely, efficiently and as one strong team.

  • Managing team capacity, prioritising work and dispatching jobs in the most efficient way across the Swiss and German network.

  • Bringing structure to the team’s priorities and ways of working, helping ensure maintenance work is completed on time and the network remains safe, reliable and available for our customers.

  • Creating a strong safety culture by ensuring full compliance with Health & Safety standards and regulatory requirements, and providing a safe and caring work environment for colleagues on the road and on site.

Operational excellence

Ensure high uptime and a great station experience.

  • Being accountable for all day-to-day operations of Fastned stations in the DACH region, from chargers and systems to the overall look and feel of our sites.

  • Ensuring we maintain network uptime above 99% in your region through effective preventive maintenance plans and swift, high-quality reactive repairs.

  • Managing a network of partners responsible for maintaining and servicing our stations.

  • Supporting improvements to the customer experience and your team in the field by regularly visiting stations, performing site inspections and quality audits, with a strong focus on safety and customer experience.

  • Overseeing the handover of new stations in the DACH region from Construction to Field Operations, ensuring they meet our operational, safety and quality standards from day one.

  • Managing spare parts flows together with our Supply Chain team to optimise local stock levels, minimise downtime and ensure that engineers always have the right parts at the right time.

  • Leading and coordinating with external partners larger infrastructure works at your stations.

  • Continuously improving how we work by taking local initiatives, standardising best practices, simplifying processes and using data and insights to make better decisions.

Customer, stakeholder and partner management

  • Delivering a best-in-class customer experience by ensuring stations are always clean, safe and easy to use, with strong attention to detail across lighting, signage, landscaping, cleanliness and amenities.

  • Collaborating closely with Customer Operations and other internal teams to monitor performance, respond to incidents and ensure a smooth, end-to-end customer journey across the network.

  • Acting as the voice of DACH Operations within the leadership team and central organisations, representing operational priorities and insights.

  • Initiating, developing and maintaining strong relationships with external partners and contractors, such as electrical contractors, cleaning, landscaping and civil works providers. Providing operational input into new station designs, upgrades and local initiatives to ensure operational excellence is embedded from the outset.

You will report to our Director of Operations, based in Amsterdam. The role is based in Germany and involves regular travel across the DACH region to visit stations and team members, as well as occasional travel to our Amsterdam headquarters.

Who are we looking for?

You are a seasoned field operations leader who can both set direction and get things done on the ground. You combine a strategic mindset with strong operational experience, and you are excited to scale and professionalise Fastned’s German and Swiss operations. You think in terms of network performance, customer experience and long-term capabilities, while also being comfortable jumping into the details when needed to remove blockers for your team.

In addition, you meet most of the following criteria:

  • You have at least eight years of relevant experience in operations roles.

  • You have proven experience scaling or professionalising operations in a growing market, for example by building teams, introducing new ways of working, improving performance and enhancing customer experience.

  • You are a strong people leader who coaches and develops your team, communicates clearly and stands your ground when needed, leads by example in the field, and creates a safe, high-performance culture.

  • You combine a strategic mindset, including the ability to set a vision for DACH Operations, define priorities and align stakeholders, with hands-on senior operational experience. You are comfortable going on site, understanding technical issues and making pragmatic trade-offs.

  • You remain calm and organised under pressure, can manage multiple priorities at once and maintain a positive, can-do attitude.

  • You are a strong communicator and stakeholder manager, able to connect the needs of the German and Swiss operations with those of our central teams and influence decisions where needed.

  • You are fluent in English and German. Any additional European language is a plus.

Join us in building a better future

We work hard to change the world, but we do not forget to recognise and celebrate our successes, big and small. We value work-life balance, offer real work flexibility and have family-friendly policies in place. We have an inclusive work environment and love authentic people, so do not try to fit in because we like you for who you are!

  • A fully electric company car, with all charging expenses covered.

  • 29 days of annual leave.

  • Two Mission Days each year to support a cause you care about or contribute to our mission.

  • A company bonus plan that recognises the impact you make.

  • A Deutschlandticket covered by Fastned.

  • An annual personal development budget of €3,000, because there is always more to learn and improve.

  • Mental wellbeing support through nilo health.

  • A subsidised Urban Sports Club membership.

  • Access to women’s health experts through our partnership with Flouria.

  • A laptop and phone of your choice, with an EU-wide mobile phone plan.

  • Daily vegetarian lunches, snacks and drinks at our office locations.

  • Team events throughout the year, an annual company trip and our legendary Christmas parties.

Interested? Apply today!

We would love to have a conversation with you! Apply now, send us your CV and explain in your cover letter why you are excited about joining our mission for freedom in sustainable transportation.

We are looking forward to your application!


Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique

We are looking for one Engineering Manager to lead both teams. title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Quarzo Life construit une nouvelle génération de plateforme d’assurance vie combinant excellence opérationnelle, expérience utilisateur moderne et forte ambition technologique.

Après avoir construit notre MVP et posé les premiers standards engineering, nous renforçons aujourd’hui notre équipe technique interne autour de notre Founding Engineer / Lead Developer.

Nous recherchons un Senior Full Stack Engineer capable de prendre rapidement l’ownership de domaines fonctionnels importants de notre plateforme, d’accélérer le delivery produit et de contribuer directement à sa fiabilité en production.

Vous rejoindrez l’aventure à un moment clé : la base technique est déjà posée, le MVP est proche de sa mise en production et l’enjeu est désormais de faire évoluer rapidement la plateforme tout en renforçant sa robustesse, son observabilité, sa sécurité et sa maintenabilité.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec notre Founding Engineer / Lead Developer, qui porte la cohérence technique globale, l’architecture et la structuration progressive de l’équipe engineering, ainsi qu’avec Ferréol Robert, fondateur CPTO.

Votre rôle sera avant tout celui d’un builder avec un ownership de production : comprendre des problématiques métier complexes, concevoir des solutions simples et robustes, les développer de bout en bout, les mettre en production, puis vous assurer qu’elles fonctionnent correctement dans la durée.

Chez Quarzo Life, le travail d’un ingénieur ne s’arrête pas au merge d’une pull request : you build it, you run it.

Les compétences clés attendues incluent une solide culture technique full-stack, avec une capacité à intervenir efficacement sur plusieurs dimensions du produit (front, back, données, infrastructure et production) sans nécessairement être expert sur chacune.

Nous recherchons surtout un profil capable de prendre l’ownership d’un problème plutôt que d’exécuter une liste de tickets : comprendre le besoin, challenger la solution, construire, livrer, observer et améliorer.

Le rôle pourra évoluer avec la croissance de Quarzo Life vers davantage de responsabilités techniques selon les compétences et aspirations du candidat.

Vos missions

Product engineering & delivery

  • Concevoir et développer des fonctionnalités produit de bout en bout sur notre stack TypeScript et React.
  • Prendre progressivement l’ownership technique de plusieurs domaines fonctionnels de la plateforme.
  • Participer activement à la discovery produit et à la conception fonctionnelle.
  • Challenger les spécifications lorsque cela permet d’améliorer le produit, de réduire la complexité ou d’accélérer le delivery.
  • Livrer régulièrement des fonctionnalités utilisables en production avec un haut niveau d’autonomie.

Production, run & observabilité

La plateforme Quarzo Life porte des opérations financières et assurantielles critiques. Son exploitation quotidienne fait donc pleinement partie du rôle de l’équipe engineering. Vous participerez directement au run de la production et serez progressivement autonome sur l’exploitation des services dont vous avez la responsabilité.

Vous serez notamment amené à :

  • surveiller quotidiennement la santé des applications et services en production ;
  • analyser les logs, métriques, traces et alertes afin d’identifier rapidement les anomalies ;
  • construire et améliorer les dashboards permettant de suivre les principaux composants et flux de la plateforme ;
  • investiguer les incidents de production jusqu’à identification de leur cause racine ;
  • suivre le bon fonctionnement des principaux flux métier et techniques ;
  • participer aux déploiements et vérifier leur bon déroulement en production ;
  • contribuer aux procédures de rollback, reprise, sauvegarde et restauration ;
  • réaliser des root cause analyses et post-mortems lorsqu’un incident significatif survient ;
  • mettre en œuvre les actions correctrices permettant d’éviter la répétition des incidents ;
  • identifier les opérations manuelles fragiles ou répétitives et les automatiser ;
  • participer, à mesure que l’équipe grandit, à une organisation d’astreinte adaptée à la criticité du service.

L’objectif est que chaque Senior Engineer puisse progressivement opérer de manière autonome les services qu’il développe, sans faire du Lead Developer le point de passage systématique pour chaque incident.

Infrastructure, DevOps & reliability

Sans nécessairement être un spécialiste DevOps ou SRE, vous devez être à l’aise avec l’environnement dans lequel votre code fonctionne.

Vous contribuerez notamment à :

  • intervenir sur les pipelines CI/CD ;
  • contribuer aux pratiques Infrastructure as Code ;
  • comprendre les problématiques de networking applicatif, configuration, secrets et dépendances externes ;
  • suivre les bases de données ;
  • améliorer les procédures de déploiement et de recovery ;
  • contribuer aux sujets de continuité et reprise d’activité.

Le Founding Engineer / Lead Developer conserve la responsabilité de la cohérence globale de l’architecture et des standards de plateforme, mais chaque Senior Engineer porte la fiabilité opérationnelle de son périmètre.

Software craftsmanship & qualité

  • Adhérer et faire vivre aux valeurs de l'artisanat logiciel.
  • Produire un code lisible, testé, documenté et maintenable.
  • Contribuer à faire progresser collectivement la qualité du codebase.
  • Appliquer et enrichir les standards engineering : tests automatisés, CI/CD, documentation, observabilité et sécurité.
  • Identifier spontanément les zones de dette technique et proposer des améliorations proportionnées aux enjeux.
  • Utiliser les pratiques DDD, TDD et les principes de clean architecture, sans dogmatisme.
  • Concevoir les fonctionnalités en anticipant leur exploitation et leur diagnostic en production.
  • Considérer logs, métriques, alertes et gestion des erreurs comme faisant partie intégrante d’une fonctionnalité terminée.

Sécurité & conformité

En tant qu’assureur, Quarzo Life évolue dans un environnement particulièrement exigeant en matière de fiabilité, de sécurité et de traçabilité.

Vous contribuerez notamment à :

  • intégrer les principes de security et privacy by design dans les développements ;
  • renforcer la sécurité applicative et infrastructure ;
  • assurer la traçabilité des traitements et événements importants ;
  • participer aux chantiers techniques liés à notre trajectoire ISO 27001 ;
  • contribuer à la gestion des vulnérabilités et à la sécurisation des dépendances ;
  • prendre en compte les exigences de résilience et de continuité propres à une plateforme financière régulée.

AI-native engineering

Nous considérons les outils IA comme une nouvelle composante du métier de software engineer.

Nous attendons de nos développeurs qu’ils sachent utiliser intelligemment les assistants de développement et LLM pour accélérer leur travail tout en conservant une forte capacité de jugement sur l’architecture, le code produit et la sécurité.

Vous serez notamment amené à :

  • utiliser les outils d’AI-assisted development pour accélérer exploration, développement, tests, debugging et documentation ;
  • comprendre et challenger le code généré plutôt que de simplement l’accepter ;
  • identifier des usages IA pertinents dans notre produit et nos outils internes ;

title: Transmission Belt Reinforcement Business Development Director
description:
Aritec New Materials Group AG is a Swiss-based company specialized in fiber composite solutions for demanding industrial applications.

We are experts in synthetic fibers, treatments & fiber sizing formulations and polymer matrices. We take pride in engineering and optimizing superior solutions to the most complex industrial challenges.

At Aritec, we drive tomorrow’s industrial frontiers by innovating cost-effective and robust solutions.

Tasks

We are seeking an accomplished Transmission Belt Reinforcement Business Development Director to lead commercial growth for advanced reinforcement solutions used in industrial transmission belts (timing, power transmission, etc..). This is a senior, customer-facing role for a commercially driven technical professional who understands belt construction, reinforcement architecture, manufacturing processes, end-user performance requirements, and the evolving challenges facing belt manufacturers and end-users worldwide.

The successful candidate will bring a strong track record and industry network from a leading belt manufacturer or closely related high-performance belting business. They will use their industry credibility, technical depth, and commercial judgment to build strategic customer relationships, identify new growth opportunities, and position our reinforcement portfolio as a performance-enabling solution for next-generation belt designs.

As Business Development Director, you will work at the intersection of materials engineering, belt design, manufacturing, and commercial strategy. You will engage with global belt manufacturers, technical centers, R&D teams, purchasing organizations, and senior business leaders to advance qualification projects and convert them into durable commercial programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the global sales strategy for Aritec reinforcement portfolio in Transmission belts.
  • Build and manage senior-level relationships with major transmission-belt manufacturers, including engineering, R&D, purchasing, operations, quality, and executive leadership.
  • Manage and Expand existing customers account portfolio by identifying and prioritizing opportunities where Aritec Synthetic reinforcement technology can improve belt strength, fatigue performance, dimensional stability, heat resistance, flex life, adhesion, noise behavior, efficiency, or durability.
  • Translate customer performance requirements into clear technical and commercial value propositions.
  • Lead customer-development programs from initial technical discussion through sampling, testing, qualification, industrialization, and serial-production launch.
  • Coordinate closely with internal R&D, application engineering, operations, quality, product management, and supply-chain teams to ensure customer requirements are understood and delivered.
  • Provide informed market intelligence on belt technologies, competitive reinforcement materials, regional market dynamics, pricing trends, supply-chain risks, and emerging end-use requirements.
  • Support the development of account plans, commercial agreements, pricing strategies, forecasts, and long-term supply arrangements.
  • Represent the company at customer technical reviews, industry events, trade fairs, and relevant technical associations.
  • Establish disciplined sales reporting, opportunity qualification, forecasting, and business-review processes.
  • Mentor and develop regional sales or application-engineering colleagues as the business grows.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
  • At least 10 years of relevant commercial, technical-sales, business-development, product-management, application-engineering, or R&D experience in transmission belts, reinforced elastomer products, industrial belting, tire cord, technical textiles, fibers, or closely related applications.
  • Experience gained at a recognized transmission-belt manufacturer is strongly preferred. Candidates from leading global manufacturers of automotive and industrial transmission belts will be particularly well suited.
  • Demonstrated understanding of transmission-belt construction, including reinforcement cords or fabrics, rubber compounds, bonding systems, cover materials, belt geometry, and manufacturing processes.
  • Practical familiarity with belt types such as timing belts, synchronous belts, V-belts, multi-rib belts, variable-speed belts, flat belts, and industrial power-transmission belts.
  • Strong understanding of key reinforcement performance factors, including tensile properties, modulus, elongation, creep, fatigue, flex resistance, adhesion, thermal stability, moisture behavior, dimensional stability, and processability.
  • Established relationships within the global transmission-belt industry are highly desirable.
  • Proven ability to manage technically complex sales cycles involving testing, qualification, supply approval, and multi-site customer coordination.
  • Experience negotiating pricing, supply agreements, development agreements, technical specifications, and long-term customer programs.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including margin management, value-based selling, forecasting, market analysis, and strategic account planning.
  • Professional fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Preferred Technical Background

The ideal candidate will have direct familiarity with one or more of the following:

  • Aramid, polyester, glass, carbon, hybrid, or other high-performance reinforcement materials.
  • Cord construction, twisting, cabling, dipping, coating, or adhesion-promotion systems.
  • Rubber-to-cord and polymer-to-cord adhesion technologies.
  • Belt fatigue testing, tensile testing, dynamic testing, flex testing, endurance testing, and field-performance validation.
  • Belt-manufacturing processes, including calendering, building, molding, curing, grinding, machining, and quality-control systems.
  • Customer qualification practices and industrial quality-assurance processes.

Personal Attributes

  • Credible technical expert who can communicate effectively with both R&D engineers and senior commercial leaders.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable building business in technically demanding markets.
  • Structured and disciplined in account management, forecasting, and opportunity prioritization.
  • Skilled listener who can uncover the underlying technical and commercial drivers behind customer needs.
  • Collaborative leader who works effectively across sales, operations, R&D, quality, and supply chain.
  • Resilient and patient in managing long qualification cycles while maintaining urgency and commercial focus.
  • High integrity, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to confidentiality and ethical business conduct.

Benefits

This role offers the opportunity to shape the commercial direction of a high-value reinforcement business serving a critical industrial market. You will have the autonomy to influence strategy, engage directly with leading belt manufacturers, and help develop materials that enable more efficient, durable, lightweight, and sustainable power-transmission systems.

If you combine deep transmission-belt expertise with strategic sales leadership and a passion for solving difficult customer challenges, we invite you to apply.

title: Senior Business Analist Pensioenen
description:
Vacature: Senior Business Analist Pensioenen

Bij IG&H zoeken we ervaren Business Analisten met diepgaande kennis van pensioenen. Vanuit jouw expertise ben je in staat om samen met onze klanten te bepalen hoe zij optimaal gebruik maken van onze standaardoplossingen. Je denkt inhoudelijk mee, stuurt aan op verbetering en helpt de sector vooruit.

Jouw rol als Business Analist Pensioenen

Als Business Analist binnen het pensioendomein lever je directe impact. Je brengt je analytische vaardigheden en domeinkennis in bij digitale transformaties, de implementatie van nieuwe IT-systemen en de voorbereiding op de Wet toekomst pensioenen.
Je werkt technologieonafhankelijk en fungeert als schakel tussen business en IT. Samen met collega’s uit disciplines als low-code development, system configuration en organisatieverandering draag je bij aan duurzame oplossingen.

Je helpt klanten hun behoeften scherp te krijgen, specificeert heldere requirements en bouwt mee aan onze modelgedreven werkwijze en pensioenontologie. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega’s en draag je bij aan de verdere professionalisering van ons team.

Hoe onderscheidt IG&H zich als consultancy binnen pensioenen?

IG&H combineert diepgaande sectorkennis met technologie en uitvoering. Binnen de pensioensector helpen ze organisaties bij de transitie naar het nieuwe pensioenstelsel, met klantgerichte oplossingen en slimme digitalisering. Als toonaangevend Mendix-partner bouwen ze snel schaalbare applicaties, zoals via het AllVida-platform – een toekomstbestendig systeem voor pensioenuitvoerders. Dankzij hun geïntegreerde aanpak van strategie, technologie en delivery is IG&H een betrouwbare partner voor duurzame transformatie.

Jij brengt mee:

  • Meer dan 5 jaar ervaring in de pensioensector

  • Ervaring met de analyse van pensioenproducten en -diensten

  • Vermogen om complexe vraagstukken te ontrafelen en helder te communiceren

  • Affiniteit met modelleren en specificeren van requirements

  • Sterke samenwerking met klanten en stakeholders

  • Enthousiasme om je verder te ontwikkelen op het snijvlak van business en IT

  • Professionele beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

Ons Business Engineering team: 

Business Engineering maakt deel uit van onze Technology afdeling, die verantwoordelijk is voor het implementeren van technologische veranderingen in een digitale wereld. Het doel van Business Engineering is om onze klanten te helpen bij het realiseren van grote technologische transformatiedoelen. Als Business Engineers weten we dat de kloof tussen business en IT alleen te overbruggen is door diep de inhoud in te duiken en problemen tot in detail te begrijpen.  

Het team bestaat uit 70 ambitieuze collega’s met diverse vanuit verschillende disciplines, zoals: Business Analysts, UX/UI Designers, Application Designers, Agile Facilitators en Program Managers. Ons team bestaat uit een mix van starters en zeer ervaren business engineers. 

Waarom IG&H? 

IG&H transformeert toonaangevende bedrijven in de gezondheidszorg, retail en financiële sectoren. Samen met onze wereldklasse technologiepartners helpen we onze klanten vooruit te komen en relevant te blijven, met inzichtelijk advies, geweldig ontwerp en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. Onze uitzonderlijke resultaten komen voort uit het succesvol afstemmen van mensen, bedrijfsvoering en technologie. Met meer dan 650 getalenteerde collega’s aan boord, mensen die veranderingen en uitdagingen echt omarmen, hebben we een unieke cultuur gecreëerd die zowel hoog durft als hoog zorgt. We trekken buitengewone mensen aan en inspireren hen om de grenzen te verleggen voor zichzelf en onze klanten.

We willen dat onze medewerkers een afspiegeling zijn van de diversiteit in de samenleving. We werken samen met een opmerkelijke mix van talenten, persoonlijkheden en culturen. IG&H is trots een werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt. We geven om individualiteit, maar het belangrijkste is dat we trots zijn op onze collectieve prestaties en een geweldige werkplek.

title: Senior Proces Consultant
description:

Met jouw passie voor data, procesmanagement en veranderen, zet je jezelf in om klanten te helpen en hun verwachtingen te overtreffen. Als zelfstandig organisatieadviseur weet je de stem van de klant om te zetten in een strak en efficiënt ingerichte procesorganisatie. Je streeft ernaar het beste uit jezelf te halen en hebt een duidelijke visie op ons vakgebied, die je graag deelt. Dit doe je door het schrijven van blogs of whitepapers, het geven van presentaties, en het verzorgen van trainingen.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bespreekt vanuit jouw rol als consultant vraagstukken en verwachtingen van de klant en vertaalt deze naar efficiënte en innovatieve oplossingen;

  • Je vertaalt strategie naar goed ingerichte processen doormiddel van digitalisering;

  • Je creëert een optimale digitale procesomgeving voor diverse organisaties;

  • Je vertaalt data naar processen en voert verbeteringen door om daarmee organisatiedoelstellingen te realiseren;

  • Je zorgt voor transparantie en duurzaamheid in procesmanagement;

  • Je levert een bijdrage aan de continue ontwikkeling van MLC als hét bureau op het gebied van Digitale Procestransformatie.

Waarom werken voor MLC?

Als Senior Proces Consultant draag je bij aan de digitale transformatie van toonaangevende organisaties. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf professioneel verder te ontwikkelen en een positieve impact te hebben op zowel klanten als collega's. Daarnaast mag je het volgende van ons verwachten:

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en een mentor die je helpt bij je zowel je persoonlijke als professionele ontwikkeling;

  • Een uitdagende en actieve rol in een team waarbij hard werken en inspirerende en betrokken collega’s altijd voor je klaar staan;

  • Veel gezelligheid en sociale activiteiten met collega’s, zoals tijdens het jaarlijkse skiweekend, kerstdiner, BBQ en kennisconferenties;

  • Een marktconform salaris, flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid van hybride werken;

  • Een goede winstdeling aan het einde van het jaar;

  • Een ruime mobiliteitsvergoeding die je kunt inzetten voor een leaseauto, OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding;

  • 28 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. een 40-urige werkweek) en extra vrije ‘loyaliteitsdagen’ als je langer dan 3 jaar bij ons werkt.


Wat neem jij mee?

Je bent sociaal, resultaatgericht en een goede luisteraar, met het vermogen om helder en bondig te communiceren. Je hebt sterke presentatievaardigheden en de ambitie om in de schijnwerpers te staan. Daarnaast ben je analytisch, tactisch en commercieel sterk, waardoor je situaties snel kunt inschatten. Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een hbo-diploma of academische studie afgerond. Denk aan (Technische) Bedrijfskunde en Organisatiewetenschappen;

  • Zo’n 5 à 10 jaar werkervaring in een proces-gerelateerde werkomgeving;

  • Gedegen kennis van Continu Verbeteren, Lean/ Six Sigma, Business Process Management, en klantreizen;

  • Kennis en ervaring op het gebied van agile werken;

  • Een sterk gevoel voor en affiniteit met de digitale transitie die ons vakgebied nieuwe kansen biedt;

  • Beschikking over een groeiend en actueel netwerk en vindt het leuk om op commercieel vlak een bijdrage te leveren.

Over MLC

MLC in Utrecht heeft al 40 jaar een sterke en unieke cultuur, die wij omschrijven als sociaal ondernemend. Wij transformeren organisaties naar een optimale digitale procesomgeving, waarbij de mens centraal staat.

In een optimale digitale procesomgeving is het primaire proces zo efficiënt mogelijk ingericht om Operational Excellence te bereiken. Daarnaast draagt iedere medewerker actief bij aan de behoeften van de klant. Transparantie en duurzaamheid zijn voor ons essentieel om aan te tonen dat wij als organisatie daadwerkelijk In Control zijn.

Bij MLC krijg je de kans om deel uit te maken van een gedreven team dat streeft naar innovatie en continue verbetering. Samen bouwen we aan een toekomst waarin zowel organisaties als medewerkers floreren.

Bij MLC werken ongeveer 60 'procesdenkers'. Als consultant werk je in teams met wisselende samenstellingen voor toonaangevende klanten in diverse branches. Onze klanten variëren van woningcorporaties en overheidsinstellingen tot zakelijke dienstverleners zoals banken, verzekeraars en energiemaatschappijen.

Je werkt vaak samen met onze klanten aan meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd, wat betekent dat je meestal op locatie bij de klant te vinden bent om projecten tot een succes te maken.


Stap binnen bij MLC

Ben jij de proactieve en resultaatgerichte professional die wij zoeken?

Reageer dan via onderstaande button op de vacature van senior proces consultant bij MLC, dan laten we je zo snel mogelijk weten of jij degene bent die we zoeken.

Neem contact op met onze office manager Samira van Baak als je nog vragen hebt over deze vacature. Zij is te bereiken via 030 20 40 910.


Na jouw sollicitatie

Om er zeker van te zijn dat we bij elkaar passen, leren we je graag in 2 of 3 gesprekken beter kennen. De eerste gesprekken heb je met directe collega’s, waarna je een gesprek zult hebben met onze Managing Director. Zijn wij en ben jij overtuigd? Dan volgt een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek, waarin we jou een aanbod doen.

We doorbreken silo’s en brengen consultingvaardigheden samen met diepgaande expertise in data, technologie en organisatieverandering om organisaties succesvol te transformeren. Wil jij hierin de lead nemen als Data Engineer? 

We zijn op zoek naar een Data Engineer om datagedreven producten te ontwerpen, te bouwen en een nieuwe databackbone te creëren voor onze data science-projecten. De Data Engineer zal de lead nemen om onze klanten naar het volgende niveau van datahandling en data-automatiseringsmogelijkheden te brengen. Verder zal je (technische) leiderschapsvaardigheden, ervaring en visie toepassen om efficiënte datatoepassingen te creëren.  

Wij zoeken iemand die:  

  • De lead neemt in het ontwerpen en bouwen van herbruikbare datamodellen en -oplossingen. 

  • Datapijplijnen ontwikkelt, inclusief ETL-processen, en data lakes en data warehouses opzet. 

  • Analysemethoden operationaliseert en toepast in de praktijk. 

  • De benodigde cloudinfrastructuur inricht en beheert. 

  • Gewend is om te werken in een commercieel gerichte en/of consulting organisatie. 

  • Graag werkt in een teamsetting met collega’s met verschillende vaardigheden. 

  • Zich thuis voelt in een omgeving met zeer gemotiveerde mensen die zich richten op het leveren van de hoogste kwaliteit aan klanten. 

 

Over het Data & AI team 

Wij helpen onze klanten innoveren en gebruikmaken van de nieuwste data- en AI-technologie. Het Data & AI-team bestaat uit 30 data-experts (Data Scientisten, Analisten en Consultants) die nauw samenwerken met de 30 engineers in ons Technology-team en nog eens 20 datawetenschappers bij de zusterbedrijven van IG&H. Het team levert data science en analytische projecten en heeft in de afgelopen twee jaar meer dan 40 (Gen)AI-projecten gerealiseerd voor onze klanten in Retail, Financial Services en Health.


Wat breng je mee:

  • Jij hebt een BSc of MSc diploma in een technisch veld, zoals Data Science, Computer Science, Fysica of Engineering. 

  • Jij hebt 2 tot 6 jaar werkervaring

  • Jij beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. 

  • Jij hebt een engineering mindset, een passie voor data en datatechnologie, en een ambitie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. 

  • Jij hebt ruime ervaring met SQL, Python en data processing frameworks en pakketten zoals PySpark en Pandas. 

  • Jij hebt ervaring met Databricks, Snowflake of vergelijkbare dataplatformtechnologien.

  • Jij bent bekend met het ontwerpen en bouwen van deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions. 

  • Jij hebt ervaring met werken volgens DevOps-methodologieën.

  • Werken bij een Great Place to Work met een prettige sfeer en enthousiaste collega's die je ondersteunen;

IG&H transformeert toonaangevende bedrijven in de gezondheidszorg, retail en financiële sectoren. Samen met onze wereldklasse technologiepartners helpen we onze klanten vooruit te komen en relevant te blijven, met inzichtelijk advies, geweldig ontwerp en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. title: Senior Information Security Officer (ISO)
description:
Wil jij zorgorganisaties helpen om informatiebeveiliging structureel en praktisch op orde te brengen? Werk je graag op het snijvlak van IT, processen en dagelijkse praktijk, en vind je het belangrijk dat informatiebeveiliging niet alleen een norm is, maar daadwerkelijk wordt toegepast? Dan is deze rol als Information Security Officer (ISO) iets voor jou.

 

Als ISO ben je verantwoordelijk voor het operationeel bewaken en verbeteren van informatiebeveiliging bij klanten van Beter Healthcare. Je vertaalt risico’s en beveiligingsmaatregelen naar concrete acties en zorgt ervoor dat deze effectief worden toegepast. Je werkt nauw samen met IT, privacy, management en de business om informatiebeveiliging integraal in de dagelijkse praktijk te verankeren.

 

Je beweegt je comfortabel tussen analyse en uitvoering: van risico-inventarisaties en beleid tot het ondersteunen bij audits en het vergroten van bewustwording binnen de organisatie. Je bent een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor informatiebeveiliging en weet overzicht te houden in een dynamische omgeving.

 

Wat jij gaat doen

  • Uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en vertalen van risico’s naar passende beheersmaatregelen;

  • Ondersteunen bij audits en certificeringstrajecten (bijvoorbeeld ISO 27001 en/of NEN-normen);

  • Monitoren van de naleving van informatiebeveiligingsmaatregelen en hierover rapporteren aan de CISO;

  • Vergroten van security awareness binnen de organisatie, onder andere door voorlichting en kennisdeling;

  • Adviseren en ondersteunen van teams bij praktische informatiebeveiligingsvraagstukken.

 

Elke opdracht is anders, dat vraagt om flexibiliteit en nieuwsgierigheid. Je werkt op verschillende locaties bij de klant door heel Nederland, soms vanuit huis, en soms op een van onze kantoorlocaties. Je krijgt de ruimte om je werk op een manier in te richten die past bij jou én de organisatie.

description:

Als Senior Business Analist Schade combineer je jouw inhoudelijke expertise met de kracht van strategie, technologie, data en AI. Je werkt samen met verzekeraars, product owners, consultants en softwareontwikkelaars aan oplossingen die het schadevak daadwerkelijk verbeteren.

Waarom deze rol belangrijk is?

De Nederlandse verzekeringsmarkt is volop in beweging. Verzekeraars staan voor de uitdaging om schadeprocessen efficiënter, klantgerichter en toekomstbestendiger in te richten. Digitalisering, data en AI bieden daarbij grote kansen, maar alleen als technologie aansluit op de dagelijkse praktijk van schadebehandeling.

In de praktijk gaat het onder andere om vraagstukken rondom:

  • optimalisatie van het schadeproces van eerste melding tot uitkering;

  • toepassing van data en AI in schadeprocessen;

  • inrichting van toekomstbestendige processen en systemen;

  • het slimmer ondersteunen van schadebehandelaars bij complexe dossiers.

IG&H werkt samen met toonaangevende verzekeraars aan deze vraagstukken. Als Senior Business Analist Schade ben jij de verbindende factor tussen de praktijk van schadebehandeling en de technologie die deze praktijk toekomstbestendig maakt.

In deze rol werk je aan uiteenlopende opdrachten bij verzekeraars en opereer je op het snijvlak van business, processen en IT. Je gebruikt jouw ervaring uit de schadepraktijk om complexe vraagstukken te doorgronden en te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen.

  • Complexe inhoud begrijpelijk maken voor verschillende doelgroepen.

  • Creëren van draagvlak voor nieuwe processen, werkwijzen en technologische oplossingen.

  • Bijdragen aan thought leadership binnen het schadevak.

  • Samen met collega's verder bouwen aan de positie van IG&H binnen de schadeverzekeringsmarkt.

  • Diepgaande kennis van schadeprocessen en de dagelijkse praktijk van schadebehandeling.

  • Affiniteit met procesverbetering, digitalisering en innovatie.

  • Een goed begrip van de mogelijkheden van technologie, data en AI binnen het schadevak.

  • Het vermogen om praktijkproblemen te vertalen naar concrete en werkbare oplossingen.

Opleiding & vaardigheden

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding.

  • Sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • Je bent in staat om verschillende belangen en perspectieven samen te brengen.

IG&H transformeert leidende organisaties in finance, health en retail met een unieke combinatie van strategie, design, analytics en technologie. Met meer dan 750 collega’s creëren wij duurzame impact door mensen, processen en technologie op een ongeëvenaarde manier te verbinden.
