title: Senior Quality Engineer - Checkout & Payments (m/w/d)
description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Als Senior Quality Engineer – Checkout & Payments trägst du dazu bei, zuverlässige Zahlungsabläufe über Shopware, Shopware Payments und externe Systeme hinweg sicherzustellen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf praxisnahen Integrationstests, Testautomatisierung und Release-Validierung: Du prüfst, ob Kund:innen einen Kauf erfolgreich abschließen können, Bestell- und Zahlungsstatus korrekt sind und Fehler sowie Wiederholungsversuche sicher verarbeitet werden.

Du wirst Teil des Bereichs Quality Operations innerhalb von Delivery Excellence und arbeitest eng mit den Teams Checkout & Payments, dem Produktmanagement und weiteren Quality Engineers zusammen. Du bringst Qualität früh in die Feature-Planung ein, überführst Produktrisiken in ausführbare Tests, untersuchst Fehler und gibst klare Empfehlungen zur Release-Bereitschaft. Die Position ist eine Senior-Engineering-Rolle ohne Führungsverantwortung. Du entwickelst das bestehende Framework für Abnahmetests und die CI-Infrastruktur weiter, statt eine separate Testorganisation aufzubauen.


  • Risikobasierte Testabdeckung definieren und umsetzen. Arbeite mit Product und Engineering zusammen, um kritische Abläufe für Händler:innen und Kund:innen, die vorhandene Testabdeckung und Lücken zu identifizieren. Stimme für jedes Entwicklungspaket einen klar abgegrenzten Testumfang ab und begleite ihn durch Umsetzung, Review und Validierung.

  • Automatisierte Tests entwickeln und pflegen. Nutze TypeScript, Playwright sowie API- und Integrationstests, um das Verhalten im Storefront, in Shopware, im Payments-Service und an den Schnittstellen zu Zahlungsanbietern zu prüfen. Wähle die passende Testebene, statt jede Prüfung in einem Browser-Test abzubilden.

  • Zahlungsergebnisse prüfen, nicht nur das UI-Verhalten. Kontrolliere Bestellerstellung, Zahlungsstatus, Beträge und Währungen. Ergänze die Testabdeckung entsprechend dem Produktrisiko um relevante Szenarien zu Stornierung, Einzug, Rückerstattung, Webhooks und Wiederherstellung.

  • Integrationsfehler gemeinsam mit Entwickler:innen bewerten. Prüfe bei Bedarf Authentifizierung, Mandantentrennung, wiederholte Anfragen, Idempotenz und asynchrone Statusänderungen. Stelle sicher, dass Fehler weder doppelte Zahlungen noch inkonsistente Bestellungen verursachen.

  • Testergebnisse für die Auslieferung nutzbar machen. Integriere und pflege Produkttests gemeinsam mit Engineering und Product Operations in der CI. Verbessere Testdaten, Wiederholbarkeit und Diagnosemöglichkeiten. Unterscheide zwischen Produktfehlern, Problemen bei Zahlungsanbietern oder Umgebungen und instabilen Tests.

  • Releases und Kompatibilität validieren. Prüfe relevante Release-Artefakte, Upgrades und unterstützte Konfigurationen im bestehenden Release-Prozess. Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Vorfällen in Regressionstests und konkrete Verbesserungen.

  • Eine klare QA-Empfehlung kommunizieren. Erläutere gegenüber Product und Engineering den geprüften Umfang, die Ergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken, Blocker und nächsten Schritte. Sprich Prioritätskonflikte frühzeitig an und begleite offene Punkte bis zu ihrer Lösung, einer vereinbarten Übergabe oder einer klaren Entscheidung.

  • Verantwortung und Wissen teilen. Prüfe Testcode, arbeite mit Kolleg:innen im Pairing und verbessere gemeinsam nutzbare Fixtures und Dokumentation. Stimme dich mit anderen Quality Engineers ab, damit die Testabdeckung von mehreren Personen gepflegt und unterstützt werden kann.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Pflege automatisierter Tests für produktive Software, einschließlich API- und Integrationstests sowie End-to-End-Tests.

  • Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in TypeScript oder JavaScript und praktische Erfahrung mit Playwright oder einem vergleichbaren Framework. Du kannst sicher in einer Playwright-basierten Codebasis arbeiten.

  • Erfahrung mit CI-Pipelines, Git, Code-Reviews, reproduzierbaren Testumgebungen und der Fehlersuche mithilfe von Logs, Traces und Anwendungscode.

  • Verständnis von HTTP-APIs, Authentifizierung, asynchroner Verarbeitung und Zustandsübergängen – einschließlich der Frage, wie sich Fehler- und Wiederholungsverhalten testen lässt.

  • Die Fähigkeit, unklare Produktanforderungen in testbare Szenarien zu übersetzen, nach Risiko zu priorisieren und sinnvolle Arbeitsschritte umzusetzen – und bei Bedarf Unterstützung einzuholen.

  • Eine kooperative Haltung: Du arbeitest gern im Team, lernst neugierig von anderen und gibst dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung gern weiter.

  • Klare mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikation auf Englisch sowie Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Entwickler:innen und Produktkolleg:innen zu Qualitätsrisiken und Release-Entscheidungen.

Von Vorteil:

Erfahrung mit Zahlungsanbietern, E-Commerce oder Finanztransaktionen ist hilfreich. Ebenso willkommen sind Kenntnisse in PHP/Symfony, Shopware, API-Vertragstests auf OpenAPI-Basis, containerisierten Umgebungen oder mandantenfähigen Services. Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Entwicklungs- und Testwerkzeugen ist ebenfalls willkommen, sofern die Ergebnisse eigenständig geprüft und verifiziert werden.

Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Karrierewege und Perspektiven. Du musst nicht in jedem der genannten Bereiche Erfahrung mitbringen, um dich zu bewerben. Kenntnisse in Shopware oder PayPal sind keine Voraussetzung.

Woran Erfolg gemessen wird:

Deine ersten Prioritäten legst du während des Onboardings gemeinsam mit Product, Engineering und dem Quality-Engineering-Team fest. Dazu gehören:

  • Eine aktuelle Übersicht der kritischen Payments-Abläufe, der bestehenden Testabdeckung und der wichtigsten Lücken – mit klar zugeordneten Umsetzungsverantwortlichkeiten.

  • Ein erster Kauf- und Zahlungsablauf, der zuverlässig in der CI oder innerhalb eines vereinbarten Release-Gates ausgeführt wird, das Bestell- und Zahlungsergebnis prüft und aussagekräftige Hinweise bei Fehlern liefert.

About the Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal.   • Work closely with People Business Partners and Employee Relations & Compliance, sharing local trends, recurring issues and emerging risks to inform broader people decisions and improvements.

  • Employees and managers get fast, consistent, local support without having to wait on anyone

  • Every case you run is well documented and would stand up to close scrutiny

  • Handoffs are clean and immediate, and nothing formal or legally sensitive stays with you longer than it should

  • Patterns you spot locally, such as a recurring issue or a risk building in one team, are raised early with both Employee Relations & Compliance and the relevant People Partner, before they become bigger problems

  • You're a trusted, visible presence in your market: the person people choose to go to, not a channel they're told to use

title: Product Engineer / Builder
description:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy.

More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

 

What you'll do

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Talk to customers, build across the whole stack, and ship to production. Turn what AI can do today into features that procurement and engineering teams use every day. You’re done when it drives revenue, not when it’s merged. Don’t wait for a PRD.

 

What we mean by Builder

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles.

A Builder takes a messy, unclear problem and owns it from start to finish. That goes for business problems, not just customer problems. You decide what’s worth doing, make the case for it, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When something works, you share it so everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

 

How we build - The Tacto Engineer

Builder is the what. The Tacto Engineer is the how. It’s our engineering practice and the bar we hold each other to.
Wear the customer’s shoes. Ship fast, finish fully. Sweat the details. Get 1% better every week. No lone wolves. Use AI as leverage, not a crutch.
Read the full version at en.tacto.ai/engineering. If it reads like the way you already work, you’ll fit in here.

 

Who we're looking for

Hungry, creative, AI pilled engineers at every level of seniority who care more about the result than the craft.

  • You have your own ideas and act on them, whether that’s something you started, a side project, or a feature nobody asked for that turned out to matter.

  • You’ve shipped real production software in a modern product team. Experience with B2B SaaS or data products is a plus.

  • You work in Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents every day, and you’ve built something with them that wouldn’t exist otherwise.

  • You go deep in modern Python (FastAPI, async, SQL) or TypeScript/React/Next.js, and you’re happy to work anywhere in the stack.

  • You’ve built AI features into a product, or you’re obsessively learning how.

  • You want to be in a room full of people who are fired up about what they’re building.

 

Stack

Python, FastAPI, Postgres, and ClickHouse on the backend. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Storybook on the frontend. GitHub, Linear, and Figma for everything around it. For AI, whatever ships fastest.

 

How we work

We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes, not hours. Trust is high and feedback is direct.
Competitive salary and meaningful equity. 26 + 4 vacation days, Wellpass fitness membership, JobRad bike leasing, company pension plan, and a childcare (Kita) subsidy.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Senior Cloud Security Engineer (m/w/d) – Azure & AWS

AJAT GmbH · Köln · Vollzeit · Festanstellung · Vor Ort

Gestalte sichere Cloud-Umgebungen mit uns

Du hast Azure- und AWS-Umgebungen selbst abgesichert, setzt Zero-Trust-Prinzipien praktisch um und arbeitest sicher mit Microsoft Intune und PowerShell? Du möchtest technische Verantwortung übernehmen und dein Wissen in ein Team einbringen?

Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

AJAT ist ein IT-Unternehmen aus Köln mit Schwerpunkten in IT-Services, System Engineering und Cybersecurity. Für unsere Kundenprojekte suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die Sicherheitsanforderungen versteht, technisch umsetzt und Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar dokumentiert.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Azure und AWS absichern: Du analysierst bestehende Cloud-Umgebungen, erkennst Sicherheitsrisiken und setzt geeignete Maßnahmen für Identitäten, Berechtigungen, Netzwerke, Workloads und Daten um.

  • Identitäten und privilegierte Zugriffe schützen: Du entwickelst nachvollziehbare Berechtigungskonzepte und setzt sie beispielsweise mit Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management sowie AWS IAM und Rollen um.

  • Zero Trust praktisch umsetzen: Du verbindest die Prüfung von Identitäten und Gerätezuständen mit minimal erforderlichen Berechtigungen und klar definierten Zugriffsregeln.

  • Endgeräte mit Microsoft Intune absichern: Du konfigurierst Sicherheits- und Compliance-Richtlinien, analysierst Fehler und führst Änderungen kontrolliert ein.

  • Mit PowerShell automatisieren: Du entwickelst wartbare Skripte für Prüfungen, Konfigurationen und wiederkehrende Aufgaben – mit sicherer Authentifizierung, Fehlerbehandlung und nachvollziehbarer Protokollierung.

  • Sicherheitsbefunde bearbeiten: Du bewertest Fehlkonfigurationen und Auffälligkeiten, priorisierst Maßnahmen und überprüfst deren Wirksamkeit.

  • Mit Kunden und Team zusammenarbeiten: Du erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, stimmst Änderungen ab und erstellst Dokumentationen, mit denen andere zuverlässig weiterarbeiten können.

Deine Qualifikation

Du erfüllst einen der folgenden beiden Wege:

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, IT-Sicherheit oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung sowie mehr als fünf Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung.

  • Eine abgeschlossene IT-Berufsausbildung, beispielsweise als Fachinformatiker/in für Systemintegration, sowie mindestens acht Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung.

Zusätzlich bringst du mit:

  • Sehr gute, praktisch nachgewiesene Kenntnisse in Azure und AWS. Du hast produktive Umgebungen selbst betreut und abgesichert und kannst deinen eigenen Beitrag anhand konkreter Projekte erläutern.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune und PowerShell.

  • Ein sicheres Verständnis von Identitäts- und Berechtigungsmanagement, Netzwerksicherheit, Protokollierung und dem Schutz sensibler Daten.

  • Erfahrung darin, Sicherheitsänderungen zu planen, zu testen, einzuführen und bei Bedarf kontrolliert zurückzunehmen.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau, da du technische Kundengespräche führst, Entscheidungen im Team abstimmst und Dokumentationen auf Deutsch erstellst.

  • Die Möglichkeit, die Tätigkeit zum vereinbarten Arbeitsbeginn vor Ort in Köln auszuüben.

  • Die Berechtigung, zum Arbeitsbeginn die ausgeschriebene Beschäftigung in Deutschland auszuüben.

So arbeitest du

Du übernimmst Verantwortung und sprichst Risiken oder offene Fragen frühzeitig an. Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit, gibst Wissen weiter und nimmst fachliches Feedback konstruktiv auf.

Bei Änderungen berücksichtigst du Sicherheit, Betriebsfähigkeit und die Menschen, die anschließend mit der Lösung arbeiten. Auch unter Zeitdruck bleibst du strukturiert und stimmst dich zuverlässig mit anderen ab.

Darüber freuen wir uns zusätzlich

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, beispielsweise Terraform oder Bicep.

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Sicherheitsplattformen und der Auswertung von Sicherheitsmeldungen.

  • Erfahrung in Kundenprojekten eines IT-Dienstleisters.

  • Aktuelle Microsoft- oder AWS-Zertifizierungen als ergänzender Qualifikationsnachweis.

Was dich bei AJAT erwartet

  • Technische Verantwortung in Cloud- und Security-Projekten.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit einem Team aus IT- und Security-Fachkräften.

  • Direkter Austausch mit Kunden und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen mitzugestalten.

  • Raum, wiederverwendbare Sicherheitsstandards, Automatisierungen und Dokumentationen aufzubauen.

Deine Bewerbung

Bewirb dich direkt über diese Anzeige mit deinem Lebenslauf und einem kurzen Überblick über zwei relevante Projekte – möglichst eines mit Azure und eines mit AWS. Beschreibe dabei jeweils deine eigene Aufgabe und die von dir umgesetzten Sicherheitsmaßnahmen.

Nenne uns außerdem deinen möglichen Eintrittstermin. Ein ausführliches Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich und deine praktische Erfahrung kennenzulernen.

From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

  • Fluent English & French is a prerequisite

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

  • Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

(Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development (Railway Power & PPAs)

Our mission for you

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk - and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, Flex - combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings - all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast - the market window is open and we intend to own it.

About trawa

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

We're looking for a (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development (Railway Power & PPAs) to own an important part of our energy value chain. You'll report directly to our Energy Operations Manager with close collaboration with the COO and Trading Team. You'll shape the product that makes European industry competitive again - and you'll do it at pace. This role is based in Berlin. trawa is an "office first" company, which means you will work from the office typically five days per week.

The Team

You'll join our Energy Operations team, which owns the energy side of our business - from sourcing and portfolio management to making sure our customers' energy products work in practice. You'll work hand in hand with our Trading Team as well as with Sales, Pricing, Product and Tech. You start without direct reports, but with a clear mandate: build and grow the business areas you own.

What you'll do

As (Senior) Associate – Energy Markets & Business Development, you combine a strong analytical mind with business building:

Build our railway power business: A significant share of our customers comes from the railway power (Bahnstrom) segment. You take ownership of this segment from a trading and energy perspective - you understand its specific market setup, improve how we forecast, source, price and supply railway power, and make us the go-to partner for these customers. You dig into how we currently predict our railway customers' energy demand and find ways to make these forecasts more accurate. You also build partnerships with IT service providers from the railway industry and with infrastructure operators.

Lead international railway expansion: You drive the expansion of our railway power offering into further European countries - you analyse market structures, regulation and commercial potential, and contribute your findings into a concrete go-to-market plan.

Expand our long-term product offering: Our customers buy long-term products from us, such as PPAs and Future/Forwards products. You develop our offering so we can provide more and better-fitting products to our customers.

Architect of the long-term trading process: You centralise and streamline the end-to-end process from pricing and offer creation to actual trade execution across Sales, Pricing, Trading and Operations - making it faster, more robust and scalable, and ultimately enabling a better product for our customers.

Bridge between trading and business: You work closely with our quant trading and data science team and turn their models and insights into processes and systems that work across teams and markets - so that pricing, risk and market insights reliably translate into better decisions and products for our customers.

Who we are looking for

Strong quantitative skills: You think analytically, feel at home with numbers and data and can confidently challenge quantitative results - without having to be a quant or developer yourself. Ideally, you have a degree in a quantitative or business field (e.g. economics, engineering, industrial engineering, business administration).

Business acumen & venture mindset: You think commercially, enjoy building new business areas from scratch and prioritise by impact.

Interest in energy markets & trading: You are fascinated by how energy markets work - from wholesale and forward markets to PPAs, hedging and pricing - and want to dive deep into them. First exposure to these topics is a strong plus.

Hungry & ambitious: You want to grow fast, take on responsibility early and set high standards for yourself. You don't wait for instructions - you find answers, push topics forward and enjoy a steep learning curve.

High ownership & structured execution: You drive topics end-to-end, align stakeholders across departments and turn ideas into scalable processes with tangible business impact.

Communication: You speak German at native level and very good English, and you translate confidently between commercial, quantitative and operational perspectives.

90 Day Goals

After 6 Weeks (Onboarding):

  • You have understood trawa's business, product and energy value chain in detail and got to know all relevant internal and external stakeholders.

  • You understand our railway power customers, their contracts, how we currently forecast their energy demand and how we source, price and supply their energy.

  • You have mapped our current long-term trading process - from pricing and offer creation to trade execution - and identified the key pain points.

Month 3 (Ramp-Up):

  • You are the go-to person for trading and energy questions in the railway power segment, have implemented first improvements and developed a concept for improving our demand forecasts for railway customers.

  • You have delivered a first assessment of potential expansion markets for railway power, including a recommendation on which country to tackle first, and have identified and approached first potential partners among railway IT service providers and infrastructure operators.

  • You have designed a target process for our long-term trading, started its implementation and proposed first additions to our long-term product offering.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • Work experience in a high-paced environment, e.g. a start-up, scale-up or consulting.

  • Experience in energy markets - especially in energy trading, origination or pricing - or in financial trading markets.

  • Knowledge of the German energy market and/or the railway power (16.7 Hz traction power) market.

  • An affinity for AI-powered tools and automation to make processes faster and smarter.

Why us?

Impact: European SMEs spend between €150k and €10M per year on electricity — most are overpaying and locked into outdated procurement. Your product will directly change how thousands of companies buy, manage, and use energy. The impact is measurable, the market is massive, and the timing is now.

The Role: You build business areas at the intersection of trading, energy and venture development - with direct impact on our revenue, our product offering and our expansion across Europe.

Responsibility & Support: You own real business areas from day one - backed by our Energy Operations Manager, the COO and an experienced Trading Team who help you ramp up quickly and grow into the role.

Ownership: We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

Learning & Growth: We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You'll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

Diversity and Inclusion: We're an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we're family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Package & Benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

Job title: Applied ML Technical Lead, Defence

Location: London; full in-office working as default

Start date: ASAP

Reports to: CEO

Clearance: Must be eligible to hold UK Security Vetting Clearance SC or above (no prior clearance required)

Application Deadline: 08/11/26 at 23:59 UK Time

Help put frontier AI to work in Defence

Cosine is a UK AI lab building models, applications and training infrastructure for mission-critical organisations.

We build coding agents that work across real software systems, specialised Lumen models, AI-native security products and the infrastructure needed to deploy advanced AI in demanding environments. Our customers include some of the world's largest enterprises, including organisations operating behind strict security, regulatory and technical constraints.

We're also training Lumen Sovereign, the first frontier large language model trained in the UK, with the support of the UK Government.

We're now looking for an Applied ML Technical Lead to help develop and deploy advanced AI capabilities for organisations operating in UK Defence and national security.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will work across machine learning development, deployment and customer-facing technical delivery. You may spend part of your time training and evaluating models on complex sensor data, and part of your time working with Defence stakeholders to understand operational needs, shape priorities and guide delivery.

You will not be expected to act as a traditional project manager. Instead, you will own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML work, coordinating the people and decisions needed to turn promising research into useful operational capability.

___________________________________________________________________________

What you'll do

  • Build ML capabilities for real Defence problems

  • Design, build, train and evaluate machine learning models for challenging applied Defence and national security use cases.

  • Work on problems involving complex sensor data, signal processing, pattern recognition, classification and multimodal intelligence.

  • Develop and improve model architectures, training pipelines, evaluation frameworks and inference systems.

  • Work with real-world and synthetic datasets to improve model accuracy, robustness and generalisation.

  • Translate research prototypes into reliable, deployable capabilities that operate within demanding technical and security constraints.

  • Work closely with Cosine's ML research and engineering teams while taking direct ownership of technical outcomes.

Lead technical delivery from prototype to deployment

  • Own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML projects.

  • Turn operational objectives into concrete technical goals, experiments, milestones and success measures.

  • Coordinate work across ML researchers, software engineers, infrastructure teams and external stakeholders.

  • Identify technical dependencies, delivery risks and blockers, and help drive them to resolution.

  • Establish clear evaluation criteria and demonstrate progress through measurable improvements and working capabilities.

  • Balance hands-on engineering with the planning and coordination needed to keep complex technical work moving.

Work directly with Defence customers

  • Engage with technical and operational stakeholders across the UK Defence and national security ecosystem.

  • Understand operational challenges and identify where machine learning can make a meaningful difference.

  • Translate customer requirements and constraints into technical objectives, datasets, experiments and delivery plans.

  • Present technical progress, demonstrate working capabilities and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Build trusted relationships with Defence stakeholders and act as a credible technical counterpart.

  • Help customers understand the practical considerations of integrating and deploying ML systems in their existing environments.

Turn research into operational capability

  • Help deploy ML models into real-world environments, including secure, on-premise and resource-constrained systems.

  • Work on model optimisation, inference performance, integration and reliability.

  • Develop robust approaches to evaluation, validation and continuous model improvement.

  • Understand data availability, access requirements, security restrictions and deployment constraints.

  • Establish feedback loops between operational users and Cosine's engineering teams.

  • Ensure that what we build is not only technically impressive, but genuinely useful to the people relying on it.

___________________________________________________________________________

What we’re looking for

You'll probably have a background in applied machine learning, ML engineering, research engineering or a similarly technical role, along with experience taking ownership of complex technical work.

You should be comfortable:

  • Writing production-quality Python and working with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch.

  • Building, training, fine-tuning and evaluating machine learning models.

  • Working with complex datasets, designing experiments and interpreting model performance.

  • Understanding the trade-offs between model performance, compute requirements, latency and deployment constraints.

  • Working with engineering infrastructure, including Git, containers, Linux and GPU compute.

  • Taking technical ownership of projects with multiple stakeholders, uncertain requirements and evolving priorities.

  • Communicating technical concepts clearly to researchers, engineers, senior stakeholders and operational users.

  • Moving between model development, customer discussions and delivery planning without losing technical depth.

  • Making sound technical judgements, prioritising effectively and finding practical solutions when the path forward is unclear.

  • You don't need to have worked in Defence before. You do need to be excited by the opportunity to apply advanced ML to difficult, consequential real-world problems.

Nice to have

  • Existing UK security clearance, such as SC or DV, or previous experience working in secure Defence environments.

  • Experience with signal processing, time-series data, sensor fusion, representation learning or machine learning applied to complex real-world datasets.

  • Experience with foundation models, multimodal learning or advanced model training and post-training techniques.

  • Experience deploying ML models to edge devices or constrained compute environments.

  • Familiarity with UK Defence procurement, technical assurance or the national security landscape.

  • Experience leading technical workstreams or working as a technical lead on customer-facing ML projects.

___________________________________________________________________________

What success looks like

In your first three months, we would expect you to:

  • Become the technical lead for a major applied Defence ML programme, with responsibility for its day-to-day technical progress.

  • Build strong working relationships with Cosine's ML researchers, engineers and key Defence customer stakeholders.

  • Develop a clear understanding of the existing models, datasets, technical architecture and operational objectives.

  • Establish a focused delivery plan with clear priorities, milestones, ownership and success measures.

  • Make meaningful hands-on contributions to model development, evaluation or deployment.

  • Identify and begin addressing the most important technical and operational blockers.

  • Demonstrate tangible progress to customer stakeholders and build confidence in Cosine's ability to deliver.

  • Longer term, you'll help take advanced ML capabilities from promising prototypes into operational use, while shaping how Cosine builds and delivers applied AI for Defence and other mission-critical organisations.

___________________________________________________________________________

Why this role matters

Some of the most important applications of AI won't be found in consumer products. They'll be in environments where information is incomplete, systems are complex, security matters and the consequences of getting things wrong are significant.

Cosine is working to bring frontier machine learning into those environments.

Doing that requires more than good models. It requires people who can understand an operational problem, build something that works, make good technical decisions, coordinate the work needed to deliver it and stay close to the customer until it creates real value.

You'll have unusual proximity to cutting-edge ML research, senior Defence stakeholders and the operational challenges that will shape the next generation of AI capabilities.

This role will suit someone who is technically strong enough to build, organised enough to lead technical delivery and curious enough to engage directly with the people using the technology.

If you enjoy being close to the research, close to customers and personally accountable for turning ambitious technology into something real, come and work with us.

Come help make frontier AI useful where it matters most.

We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and ways of thinking, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace.

We encourage applications from anyone who meets the role requirements, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the hiring process, we’re happy to discuss them.

Compensation, Benefits & Ways of Working

We’re an in-office team, five days a week, by design. We believe the work we’re doing benefits from being together, collaborating closely, and building shared context.

title: Strategic Account Manager (UK)
description:

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

  • Self-directed: brings solutions, not just problems

Nice to Have: Bonus, not required.

  • Experience at a native AI technology company

  • Comfort with API integrations, conversation flow design, and business intelligence tools

Not a Fit If:

  • You want a fixed playbook and clear SOPs before you start

  • You'd rather support the commercial conversation than own it

  • You need close oversight rather than working independently with your deployment strategist as your main partner

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. title: Robotics Software Engineer
description:
Build the next generation of autonomous construction robotics

At MESH, we develop autonomous robotic systems that automate end-to-end rebar construction. Bridging digital design and physical automation, our multidisciplinary team transforms advanced robotics research into robust, production-ready industrial systems deployed globally.

Tasks

Role description

We are looking for a Robotics Software Engineer to develop and productize software across the full robotics stack from perception and motion planning to control and system integration. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working across subsystem boundaries. You will take ownership of the engineering work required to turn promising research and algorithms into robust and mature capabilities that can be deployed and maintained in real-world robotic systems.

What You Will Work On

You will contribute across the full robotics software stack, including:

  • Perception: 2D/3D sensing, point-cloud processing, object and feature detection, pose estimation, calibration.
  • Motion Planning: collision checking, trajectory generation and optimization, kinematics, robot/world modeling, and integration of planning algorithms.
  • Robot Control: integration with industrial robot controllers, HAL layers, trajectory execution, real-time or near-real-time control interfaces, state monitoring, and coordination of multi-robotic systems.
  • System Integration: connecting robotics SW, application logic, hardware, and external systems into reliable end-to-end robotic applications.
  • Robotics Infrastructure: reusable software components, interfaces, configuration, logging, diagnostics, testing, simulation, and deployment infrastructure.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, test, and maintain robotics software primarily in C++ and Python.
  • Develop and integrate components across the full robotics SW stack.
  • Take algorithms and prototypes and mature them into reliable software components.
  • Build automated tests, simulation-based tests, hardware-in-the-loop tests, and system-level validation where appropriate.
  • Work with industrial robots, sensors, cameras, external axes, and other automation hardware.
  • Develop clean interfaces between robotics algorithms, hardware drivers, application software, and higher-level systems.
  • Diagnose complex problems that span software, algorithms, networking, robot controllers, sensors, and hardware.
  • Improve observability through structured logging, diagnostics, error reporting, and system health monitoring.
  • Support deployment, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validation of robotic systems.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • Masters degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong software engineering skills in C++, with working knowledge of Python.
  • Experience developing software for robotic or other complex hardware systems.
  • Good understanding of several areas of robotics, such as, motion and trajectory planning, robot control, vision, sensor and robot calibration.
  • Experience with robotics middleware such as ROS/ROS2 or similar
  • Comfortable working with Linux and modern software development workflows using Git, code reviews, build systems, debugging tools, and automated testing.
  • Ability to debug problems across multiple layers of a robotic system rather than treating individual components in isolation.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, modularity, interfaces, and maintainability.

Experience in one or more of the following would be an advantage:

  • 3D perception using point clouds, depth cameras, stereo systems.
  • Libraries such as Eigen, PCL, OpenCV, or similar.
  • Collision detection, robot/world modeling, trajectory optimization, or numerical optimization.
  • Real-time or high-performance robot communication and control.
  • Profiling, performance optimization, concurrency, and multithreaded C++.
  • Deploying and supporting robotic systems outside a controlled R&D environment.
  • CI/CD and automated testing for robotics software.
  • Experience working with industrial robotic arms such as ABB

We do not expect you to be an expert in every part of the robotics stack. We are looking for strong software engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more robotics areas, and the ability and interest to work across subsystem boundaries.

Eligibility

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Switzerland or be eligible to obtain the required Swiss work authorization without employer-sponsored visa support.

Why Join MESH?

At MESH, you will work on robotics problems where advanced R&D meets real-world industrial deployment. Our goal is not only to develop new robotics capabilities, but to turn them into systems that solve challenging problems in real world deployments.

  • You will have opportunities to work across the full robotics SW stack including system integration, and the software architecture connecting them rather than being restricted to a narrow subsystem.
  • You will work directly on the engineering challenges that take robotics from promising prototypes to robust, repeatable, and deployable solutions.
  • Solve challenging real-world robotics problems. Work with industrial robots, 3D vision systems, complex environments, and applications where conventional automation approaches reach their limits.
  • See your work operate on real hardware. Develop software that moves beyond simulation and demos and becomes part of robotic systems deployed in real production environments.
  • Have impact across the system. As part of a small, multidisciplinary engineering team, you will work closely across robotics, software, and hardware, with the opportunity to influence both technical decisions and how our robotics platform evolves.

description:
About MESH

MESH is automating rebar fabrication and construction processes using robotics and software. Our mission is to bring modern robotics and industrial-grade automation to one of the most fragmented and under-invested industries, enabling faster, safer, and more precise construction through systems that integrate seamlessly into existing workflows.

We design and deploy robotic solutions that operate in harsh, real-world production environments — not labs or demos. Our work spans mechanical systems, robotics, software, and industrial automation, with a strong focus on robustness, simplicity, and deployability.

MESH is based in Switzerland, with in-house workshops and robot testing facilities. We work closely with partners across the construction and machinery ecosystem and regularly test our systems in production and on-site environments. We value close collaboration and hands-on engineering and primarily work on-site with our hardware.

About the Role

As Robotics Product Engineer, you'll own the products Mesh has already brought to market — starting with Actuate and Node systems — which are running today in customer deployments. Your job is to keep them working well, get better at what they do, and grow them into their full potential in the field.

You'll sit at the intersection of software, hardware, and the customer floor. You're comfortable writing production Python, but just as comfortable being on-site (virtually or in person) with a customer's robotic cell, watching how a workflow actually behaves, and figuring out why it's not performing the way it should.

This is a role for someone who wants their work to matter to customers running Mesh products right now, and who gets satisfaction from taking a live system from "working" to "working well."

Tasks

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for customer deployments of Mesh Actuate, Mesh Node, and future shipped products
  • Monitor deployed systems, diagnose issues, identify root causes across the software/hardware stack and provide remote support
  • Design and implement improvements to robotic workflows — cycle time, reliability, error handling, edge-case behavior — based on real deployment data and customer feedback
  • Write and ship production Python code that improves product performance and stability
  • Work directly with industrial robot integrations, understanding both the software control layer and the physical/mechanical constraints of the cell
  • Translate patterns you see across multiple deployments into product or platform improvements, not just one-off fixes
  • Build tooling, monitoring, and diagnostics that make it faster to understand what's happening in a live deployment
  • Partner with customer-facing teams to prioritize the improvements that matter most
  • Feed structured learnings back to the R&D organization when deployment experience should inform future product decisions
  • Support with the deployment of our robotic systems.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ Years professional working experience, either software engineering experience, with strong Python skills applied to real production systems or experience working with industrial robots or robotic systems in a shipping product context — you understand programming them, integrating them, and where they break
  • A background that includes shipping hardware and/or software robotic products, not just prototyping them
  • Strong analytical and diagnostic instincts — you can look at a misbehaving system and reason through where in the stack (mechanical, electrical, control, software) the problem actually lives
  • Solid understanding of the tradeoffs and constraints between hardware and software, and how to work within them rather than around them
  • Familiarity with the data flow between ERP/MES systems and the factory floor; you know how to talk to a client’s IT department.
  • Comfort working directly with customers and deployed systems, including troubleshooting issues that aren't fully reproducible in a lab
  • An engineering background (formal or equivalent experience) that gives you the fundamentals to reason about mechanical and electrical systems, not just code
  • Self-direction — this role often means identifying the improvement that matters most, not waiting to be assigned one
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites.
  • Working proficiency in English; German and/or French is a strong plus

Nice to Have

  • Experience with a specific industrial robot platform or manufacturer's SDK/control interface
  • Familiarity with fleet monitoring, telemetry, or observability tooling for distributed hardware
  • Experience being the engineering liaison for enterprise or industrial customers

At MESH, you are a foundational builder, not just an employee. We offer a high-growth environment where your work directly transforms one of the world's most essential industries. Beyond a competitive salary, we provide a comprehensive Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), ensuring you share in the long-term success and ownership of the company. Join us in Switzerland to turn ambitious robotics R&D into the industrial standard of tomorrow.

title: Senior QA Engineer - Berlin
description:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

Purpose of the role

As our Senior QA Engineer, you'll look after the quality of ra.co, our iOS and Android apps, and RA Scan, the app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll work across five product teams. Each team writes and runs its own tests. You'll help them do it well, keep the automated test suites healthy, and test the riskiest releases yourself.

Some of what we ship carries real risk: payments, checkout, and getting people into venues on the night. Other changes are a line of copy. You'll help us tell the two apart and test each one accordingly. We use AI tools across development, and you'll help the teams use them to write better tests, faster.

Key responsibilities

  • Keep the web end-to-end test suite healthy: fix flaky tests, add coverage for new features, and make sure a failing suite gets fixed quickly
  • Grow automated testing for our iOS and Android apps and RA Scan with the app developers, so mobile tests run on every change
  • Test high-risk releases yourself, such as payments and checkout, including edge cases and what happens when things fail
  • Review the test plans teams write, and help them improve
  • Use AI tools to write and maintain tests, help developers do the same, and check what the tools produce
  • Brief our external testing partner and review the results they send back
  • Report bugs clearly, and follow them through with developers and product managers
  • Track a few simple measures, such as bugs that reach production and how reliable the automated tests are

We’re looking for

  • Several years in QA or test engineering, typically four or more, testing web and mobile products
  • Hands-on test automation: you've built and maintained automated tests that run in CI, for web (for example Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and ideally mobile. We use XCUITest on iOS and Espresso with Kotlin on Android
  • Enough coding to write and fix tests alongside developers, in a language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin or Swift
  • You can test APIs and check data with SQL
  • Good judgement about risk: what to test deeply, what lightly, and what not at all
  • You've used AI tools in your testing work, and know where they help and where they don't
  • Clear writing: bug reports and test plans other people can act on

If you meet most of these but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. Nobody arrives with all of it, and we'll help you grow into the rest.

Nice to have

  • CircleCI or a similar CI tool
  • Working with an external testing partner
  • Payments, checkout or ticketing systems
  • Testing apps used at live events, with poor networks
  • Test management tools such as Qase or TestRail

What we offer you

  • Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
  • Matched pension, or 401k for US staff.
  • Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
  • Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch.
  • Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about.
  • A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity).
  • Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community).

More about RA

We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis.

Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it.

RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge.

We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Our values

  • Electronic music is art.
  • We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music.
  • We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community.
  • We honour the past, present and future of electronic music.
  • We use innovation to empower the community.
  • We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit.
  • We're always front left.

title: Interim Senior BI Analyst (All Genders)
description:
Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment. Shiftmove exists to make this simple.

We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets. Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place.

About the role:

We are looking for an experienced Interim Senior BI Analyst to join us on an initial three-month contract, with the option to extend for a further three months.

As we integrate two acquired French businesses into our group, we need to bring their data into our standard reporting while transforming how our executive team accesses and uses business intelligence. Our existing Tableau dashboards have evolved over time, and we see an opportunity to make them clearer, more consistent and more actionable.

Reporting to our VP of Operations, Data & BI, you will work closely with the executive team, Head of FP&A, RevOps and Data Engineering. You will take ownership of rebuilding our executive reporting, responding to daily analytical requests and ensuring that acquired-company data is accurately reflected in group-wide reporting.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical BI skills with commercial acumen, sound analytical judgement and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when the data tells a different story.

What You'll Do

  • Rebuild executive reporting: Audit our existing Tableau dashboards and the underlying business logic. Decide which dashboards to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire, and rebuild the priority dashboards so executives can quickly understand performance and make informed decisions
  • Establish consistent metrics: Document and align metric definitions to ensure that business performance is measured consistently across dashboards, teams and entities
  • Own daily ad hoc reporting: Manage requests through our Jira-based data support queue, prioritising, scoping and delivering analyses on a daily basis. Translate ambiguous requests into clear business questions and identify recurring needs that can be addressed through standard reporting
  • Integrate acquisition data: Partner with Data Engineering as acquired-company data is migrated into Snowflake. Validate and reconcile data against source systems, build and maintain dbt models, and incorporate the data into existing Tableau dashboards so group reporting reflects all entities
  • Deliver commercial insights: Translate executive requirements into meaningful analysis of go-to-market performance, including pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention and churn
  • Partner with Finance: Work closely with the Head of FP&A to reconcile BI reporting with financial figures and establish a consistent view of business performance
  • Present findings and challenge assumptions: Communicate insights directly to the executive team, explain what the data means for the business, and challenge assumptions where the evidence supports a different conclusion
  • Enable a smooth handover: Document dashboards, data models, metric definitions and reporting processes so the permanent BI team can take ownership of the work at the end of the interim period

What You Need to Succeed

  • You bring extensive experience in BI or analytics, including at least three years working at a senior level
  • You have expert-level Tableau dashboard development skills, including experience redesigning dashboards for executive audiences
  • You have strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working with Snowflake
  • You have practical experience with dbt, including building and maintaining data models, tests and documentation
  • You understand go-to-market performance and are fluent in metrics such as pipeline, bookings, ARR, net and gross retention, and churn
  • You have a track record of translating executive requirements into analysis that informs business decisions
  • You have experience integrating acquired, migrated or otherwise disparate data sources into existing reporting environments
  • You are comfortable managing a Jira ticket queue and delivering reporting requests within daily turnaround expectations
  • You communicate exceptionally well in written and spoken English and are confident presenting to C-level stakeholders, including challenging assumptions when the data warrants it
  • You are based in Europe and available to work 35 hours per week for the duration of the contract

Nice to have:

  • French or German language skills
  • Experience in a SaaS or subscription-based business
  • Experience working with Salesforce, HubSpot or NetSuite data models
  • Experience building a semantic layer or self-service analytics capabilities for executive stakeholders
  • Experience reporting to private equity investors or preparing board-level reporting packs

What Success Looks Like

We want you to make a tangible impact from the start

  • By Day 30: Complete an audit of existing dashboards and underlying business logic, with a clear recommendation to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire each dashboard. Take ownership of the Jira queue and establish a reliable daily delivery rhythm
  • By Day 90: Have the priority executive dashboards rebuilt and in use, agree metric definitions with the Head of FP&A, and bring the first acquired-company data into standard group reporting
  • By Day 180 (if extended): Complete the rebuild of all in-scope dashboards, incorporate all migrated acquisition data into standard reporting, convert recurring ad hoc requests into standard reports, and complete the handover to the permanent BI team

Why Shiftmove

Why should you join us? At Shiftmove, you can contribute to an established, product-led company focused on delivering real value to its customers, with meaningful recurring revenue and an ambitious agenda for growth

  • Autonomy: We bring you in for your expertise and give you the ownership and space to deliver meaningful results.
  • Impact: Play a direct role in shaping executive reporting and integrating acquired businesses into a consistent, group-wide view of performance
  • Fair and equitable compensation: Interim compensation will be discussed based on your expertise, experience and geographic location
  • Dog-friendly office: Because furry coworkers make everything better! 🐶

SOUNDS LIKE YOU?

If you don't tick all the boxes but believe you can thrive in this role, we would love to hear from you.

Shiftmove is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse experiences and demographic characteristics that have nurtured unique viewpoints benefit our growth and performance. Just be yourself, and maybe you'll bring something valuable to the role we didn't initially think of.

If you need specific accommodations (tools, time, etc.) due to any special needs, and you are happy to disclose this, please let us know. We are happy to make adjustments, as support can make a decisive difference in the application process.
