Das wirst du konkret tun:

  • Das eigentliche Problem identifizieren, bevor du es löst. In quantitative und qualitative Daten eintauchen, bis du die wirkliche Frage hinter dem Auftrag findest. Sie dann verständlich und handlungsleitend machen. Ein gut formuliertes Problem ist die halbe Lösung.
  • Das Experiment aufsetzen, ehrlich lesen und entscheiden, was als nächstes kommt. Eine testbare Veränderung definieren, sie sauber instrumentieren und das Ergebnis analysieren. Dann das Gelernte nutzen, um die nächste Frage zu formulieren. Das schließt ein, auch über Tests zu berichten, die nicht funktioniert haben, und den nächsten Schritt zu gestalten.
  • KI einsetzen und dein Urteil dort einbringen, wo es zählt. KI unterstützt viele unserer ersten Entwürfe. Du wirst sie briefen, hinterfragen und die Qualität sichern – damit deine eigene Zeit für das Denken bleibt, das ein Modell nicht leisten kann.
  • Für das Weglassen argumentieren. Hinzufügen ist einfach. Du wirst mitentscheiden, was seinen Platz verdient und was entfernt werden sollte – und bereit sein, dafür einzustehen.
  • Mit Nachbar:innen sprechen. Experimente sagen dir, was passiert ist – nicht, was Menschen gebraucht hätten. Du wirst echte Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen, die das Produkt nutzen, weil man sich kein Verständnis für andere durch A/B-Tests erarbeiten kann.
  • Erfahrungen gestalten, die auf echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und echtem Nachbarschaftsleben basieren. Dein Job ist es, zu Flows und Screens beizutragen, die intuitiv nutzbar sind und ihren Platz durch messbaren Mehrwert rechtfertigen.

  • Du hast Experimente von Anfang bis Ende durchgeführt und weißt, wie du von einem zum nächsten kommst: Hypothese aufstellen, starke Varianten entwickeln, die richtigen Metriken festlegen, Ergebnisse analysieren und eine klare Entscheidung treffen – launchen, verwerfen oder iterieren.
  • Du hast technisches Know-how und Erfahrung im Aufsetzen und Auswerten von Experimenten in einem A/B-Testing-Tool sowie im Erstellen der dafür notwendigen Dashboards.
  • Du holst dir deine Zahlen selbst per SQL-Abfrage. Du arbeitest mit Rohdaten, um Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und Chancen zu identifizieren – ohne auf andere warten zu müssen.
  • Du hast statistische Grundkenntnisse. Du musst kein R beherrschen, aber du verstehst, worum es bei Bayesianischer vs. frequentistischer Statistik geht und warum man vor dem Start eines Experiments eine Power-Analyse durchführt.
  • Du präsentierst deine Arbeit klar, verteidigst deine Entscheidungen, wenn sie hinterfragt werden, und bist sicher vor einem Publikum.

Bitte schick uns ein Anschreiben, in dem du erklärst, warum diese Rolle und warum jetzt – und beschreibe mindestens ein Projekt, das du von Anfang bis Ende erläuterst: die Hypothese, was du getestet hast, das Ergebnis und was du daraus mitgenommen hast. description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.

You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

Key Responsibilities

  • Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

  • Third-party safety partnerships and integrations. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

  • Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

  • Red teaming and adversarial testing. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

  • Trust and safety reviews for new features. Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

  • Incident follow-through and continuous improvement. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub.

Your Qualifications

  • Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning;

  • Content moderation and AI guardrails: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.

  • Legal/safety work experience: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;

  • Collaborative mindset and communication: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English;

  • AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have previous legal/compliance education

  • Professional experience or interest in AI

  • Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable reviewing and discussing uncensored AI-generated content and NSFW material

We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit!

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications

⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are looking for a customer-oriented and results-driven candidate to join our Account Management Team. As a Senior Account Manager DACH at Perk, you will be actively contributing to our continued customer satisfaction as well as working to increase growth and margin within existing accounts.

Following our recent acquisition and rebranding, your role now encompasses our fully integrated Travel and Spend ecosystem. You will be responsible for a portfolio of large SMB accounts within the DACH market, helping them streamline not just their travel, but their entire expense management workflow. You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll up your sleeves, and work hard.

What You Will Do:

  • Portfolio Management: Own a portfolio of large SMB customers and develop a high level of customer engagement with influential users (Admins, Finance Directors, Travel Managers) within those accounts.

  • Strategic Consultation: Gain a deep understanding of your customers' business and show you understand and identify with their goals as an organization. You will consult them on consolidating their financial stack by leveraging Perk’s unified Travel and Spend capabilities, identifying opportunities to optimize their expense reconciliation and cost control.

  • Product Expertise: Develop a deep understanding of the Perk portfolio of products—including our core Travel platform and our new Spend management solution. You will use this knowledge to guide customers through the benefits of an all-in-one T&E solution.

  • Expansion & Growth: Actively identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities for the Spend product within your existing book of business, driving adoption of corporate cards, automated invoice processing, and expense management features.

  • Problem Solving: Identify common problems within each account—whether related to bookings or expense workflows—and develop strategies to solve each issue in a timely manner whilst also developing foolproof methods to ensure repeat issues are a thing of the past.

  • Advocacy: Be Perk’s biggest advocate within your clients and your clients' biggest advocate within Perk. You’ll be the first one to address any issues, get support from our technical teams, and educate your clients on new product features across both Travel and Spend modules.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience within an Account Management or Customer Success role, preferably managing a portfolio of B2B clients.

  • Native or near-native proficiency in German.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Experience in the Travel industry, Fintech, Expense Management, or SaaS products is highly desirable.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to explain complex integrations between travel bookings and financial reporting.

  • Customer-focused with a passion for working with people and solving financial pain points for businesses.

  • Excellent analytical abilities with fluency in Excel and data interpretation.

  • Solid analytical background to help clients visualise their T&E ROI.


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are:

  • A Trusted Collaborator: You care about collective team wins, foster transparent working relationships, and bring a straightforward, low-politics mindset to work.

  • Results-Driven: You know how to filter out noise and stay locked onto core objectives, taking full ownership of major milestones like key-account rollouts.

  • Feedback-Oriented: You view constructive feedback as a tool for growth, seeking input early, iterating fast, and sharing honest perspectives with your team.

  • A Strategic Client Partner: You naturally empathize with the financial and operational challenges our clients face, using those insights to build lasting, high-trust partnerships.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

 

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

You will be responsible for new customer growth and the efficiency of every pound spent to acquire it.

  • Own the acquisition budget and its allocation across channels, markets and campaigns against CAC, ROAS, blended MER and payback

  • Build the annual and in-season acquisition plan with finance, including new customer targets, media budgets and forecasts

  • Grow the share of high-value new customers, working with your peers in the customer team on cohort and lifetime value data

Paid media and channels

  • Own paid social across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest and Snapchat, including prospecting, retargeting and creator partnership ads

Measurement and insight

  • Measure the effect of paid media on store sales as well as online, as TALA becomes more omnichannel

  • Work with the Head of Digital Experience on tracking, attribution and server-side data, so the numbers are trusted across the business

  • Partner with finance and the data team on a single view of CAC, MER and payback

Creative and brand

New markets and growth

  • Lead paid acquisition for international market launches, from test budgets and localisation to scaling in each market

  • Support store openings, including Edinburgh, with local awareness and footfall campaigns

  • Work with the Customer team on referral, reactivation and lapsed-customer acquisition

  • Partner with the Head of Digital Experience on landing pages, conversion and SEO, so paid traffic converts

Team and agency leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop a small team of acquisition specialists

  • Decide the right mix of in-house capability and agency partners, and manage agency relationships, briefs, fees and performance

  • Manage the growth technology stack, including attribution, analytics, affiliate and creative tools, with clear return on each

  • Lead the use of AI across the growth function, building it into media buying, budget allocation, creative, analysis and reporting

  • Build the team's AI skills, with the right tools, training and clear guidelines on brand, data and privacy

  • Build a culture of experimentation, pace and ownership of results

  • Stay hands-on in the platforms and the numbers

  • Evaluate the quality of our growth: CAC, source attribution, channel performance and downstream customer value, separating headline growth from sustainable growth. 
  • Work with Risk and Anti-Fraud so fraud, abuse and economic loss are built into how we judge customers, channels and markets.

  • Diagnose where customers drop out between acquisition and activation, and which behaviours drive repeat usage, retention and lifetime value. 
  • Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer and commercial impact. 
  • Help Product Managers size opportunities and judge whether shipped features delivered the outcomes they promised. 

Influence with data

Sa recherche est orientée vers les sciences de l'atmosphère, la qualité des environnements intérieurs et les enjeux de l’efficacité énergétique et de la décarbonation. La candidate/le candidat intégrera l’un des 3 axes thématiques du CERI EE, l’axe OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosphériques).

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr et celui du CERI EE https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri

L’ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l'Energie, l'Environnement et la Santé, UMR 7515 du CNRS et de l’Université de Strasbourg) a été créé en janvier 2013 lorsque deux laboratoires, le Laboratoire des matériaux, surfaces et procédés pour la catalyse (LMSPC) et le Laboratoire d'ingénierie des polymères pour les hautes technologies (LIPHT), décident de fusionner. Lors de la fusion, les trois équipes du LIPHT et les sept équipes du LMSPC ont été structurées en trois départements de recherche : catalyse et matériaux, chimie moléculaire et analytique, ingénierie des polymères.

La transversalité des compétences présentes au sein de l’Institut permet de traiter des problématiques globales allant de la synthèse des molécules à l’élaboration de l’objet final pour des applications liées à l'Energie, l'Environnement ou la Santé. L’implication forte des équipes de l’unité dans les recherches fondamentales avec une visée applicative a permis au laboratoire de se positionner sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur et d’acquérir une renommée internationale. Les collaborations académiques tant nationales qu’internationales ont contribué aussi aux développements de nouveaux axes de recherche inexploités à l’heure actuelle. Les développements avals des recherches menées au sein de l’unité ont également permis de tisser de nombreuses collaborations avec le monde socio-économique en apportant des solutions concrètes aux différentes demandes sociétales et en développant de nouveaux procédés en adéquation avec les nouvelles législations. 

Les activités de recherche au sein de l’unité ne peuvent être menées d’une manière sereine, sans l’appui fort des pôles de soutien à la recherche, qui ont permis de fluidifier les demandes techniques et administratives. L’excellente cohésion entre ces pôles et les équipes de recherche a contribué également à mieux anticiper des problèmes éventuels et à d’optimiser le fonctionnement quotidien au sein de l’unité. En 2020, la direction de l’ICPEES a organisé le service commun technique en 3 pôles : le Pôle Caractérisation, le Pôle Ingénierie et Développement et le Pôle Chimie.

Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’ICPEES :

https://icpees.unistra.fr

Missions :

Le doctorant aura pour mission d’évaluer la dynamique des dépôts atmosphériques de pesticides à différentes échelles spatiales et temporelles en collaboration avec l’observatoire MERA (https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-mera) et les AASQA (https://www.atmo-france.org/) sur le territoire national. Dans un premier temps, il devra adapter les méthodes d’analyse de pesticides existantes en GC/MSMS et LC/MSMS dans l’équipe « CAMATES (Chimie Analytique MATériaux, Environnement Santé) » de l’ICPEES (UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA), en particulier intégrer les pesticides de la liste prioritaire de l’ANSES[1] et ceux du dispositif Pesticides coordonné par le LCSQA[2] (https://www.lcsqa.org/fr/le-dispositif-pesticides). Il aura également pour mission de déterminer la méthode technique d’extraction de ces molécules et de quantifier l’effet de matrice/interférences potentiels que peuvent générer les eaux pluviales et les dépôts secs. Pour cela, il disposera d’échantillons réels de dépôts totaux (humides et secs) qu’il dopera avec des molécules non présentes dans les échantillons et des étalons marqués.

Il aura ensuite la tâche d’analyser les échantillons de dépôts atmosphériques collectés de manière hebdomadaire pendant 1 an sur plusieurs sites d’étude et également de quantifier si la réfrigération des échantillons pendant leur stockage dans le préleveur est indispensable.

Enfin, il aura à interpréter et analyser les résultats en termes d’occurrence, de variabilité spatiale et temporelle (influence de l’activité agricole), de relation avec les conditions météorologiques (trajectoire des masses d’air) et de corrélation avec d’autres polluants atmosphériques ou des mesures de pesticides dans l’air ambiant réalisées en parallèle par les AASQA.

 

Activités :

  1.       Instrumentation pour les dépôts atmosphériques et développements analytiques (t0 – t6) -- à Douai puis Strasbourg

  •            effectuer des essais techniques pour vérifier la conformité des appareils de collecte des dépôts atmosphériques (Douai)

  •            modification de méthodes existantes en GC/MSMS et LC/MSMS (retraits/ajouts de molécules),

  •            développement MSMS des nouvelles molécules,

  •            validation de la méthode (limites de détection et de quantification, répétabilité, reproductibilité,…)

  •            choix de la méthode de préparation des échantillons (LLE, SPE, SPME, …),

  •            évaluation des interférences et de l’effet de matrice par dopage avec des étalons deutérés et des molécules de pesticides non présentes dans les échantillons (screening de la présence/absence en amont)

2.       Analyse des échantillons collectés sur le terrain (t7 – t20) – à Strasbourg

  •            gestion hebdomadaire des échantillons : réception, extraction, analyses, conditionnement des flacons

  •            traitement des résultats obtenus d’analyses : prétraitement des données, intégration des chromatogrammes, identification des composés, quantification et validation des résultats avec contrôle qualité

3.       Interprétation des résultats acquis (t21 – t28) -- à Douai

4.       Rédaction de publications, du mémoire de thèse et valorisations à l’international (t21 – t36) – à Douai

Profil du candidat : (Prérequis/ Diplôme)

description:

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. Missions

  • Conduire des travaux de recherche fondamentale et appliquée en informatique sur l’identification d’état et la détection des conditions de compétition dans les systèmes temps réel.

  • Étudier et développer des approches visant à améliorer la fiabilité et les performances des systèmes de réseaux distribués.

  • Mobiliser des modèles formels temps réel, des méthodes d’identification d’état et des stratégies de détection des conditions de compétition.

  • Contribuer au développement de nouvelles méthodes d’analyse et de vérification des systèmes temps réel.

Activités

 1. Mener des travaux de recherche sur l’identification d’état et la détection des conditions de compétition dans les systèmes temps réel

  • Participer activement et régulièrement aux réunions de l’équipe de recherche.

  • Collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe à la conduite des travaux scientifiques.

  • Modéliser des systèmes de réseaux distribués à l’aide d’automates temporisés (Timed Automata) et de machines à états finis temporisées (Timed Finite State Machines).

  • Spécifier et vérifier des propriétés temporelles, notamment les conditions de compétition, à l’aide de solveurs et d’outils de vérification formelle tels qu’UPPAAL.

  • Mettre en œuvre et évaluer des méthodes existantes de génération de séquences d’identification d’état pour les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées, notamment les séquences de synchronisation (synchronizing sequences), de détermination de l’état initial (homing sequences) et de distinction (distinguishing sequences).

  • Exploiter des techniques telles que les arbres de successeurs et les méthodes d’abstraction pour dériver des séquences d’identification d’état.

  • Concevoir de nouvelles stratégies d’identification d’état et de détection des conditions de compétition.

  • Réaliser des expérimentations, analyser les résultats et évaluer les performances des méthodes développées.

 

2. Valoriser et diffuser les résultats de recherche

  • Rédiger des articles scientifiques et contribuer à leur publication dans des revues et conférences internationales.

  • Présenter les résultats des travaux lors de conférences, séminaires, colloques et autres manifestations scientifiques.

  • Participer aux échanges scientifiques et contribuer à la diffusion des connaissances au sein de la communauté de recherche.

 

3. Contribuer aux activités d’enseignement et d’encadrement

  • Participer à l’encadrement des étudiants dans le cadre de projets de recherche, de travaux pratiques ou de projets académiques.

  • Contribuer aux activités d’enseignement en lien avec les domaines scientifiques du projet.


Formation

  • Doctorat ou PhD depuis moins de 3 ans

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables

  • Expertise scientifique : maîtriser l’analyse des systèmes temps réel réactifs et comprendre les liens entre les conditions de compétition et l’identification de l’état final.

  • Détection des conditions de compétition : maîtriser les concepts liés à la détection des conditions de compétition et à la théorie de la concurrence.

  • Vérification formelle : maîtriser les méthodes de vérification de la concurrence entre les entrées et les sorties dans les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées.

  • Identification d’état : maîtriser les concepts et les méthodes d’identification d’état, notamment les séquences de synchronisation et de distinction pour les automates temporisés et les machines à états finis temporisées.

  • Robustesse des séquences : analyser les conditions de robustesse des séquences d’identification d’état vis-à-vis des conditions de compétition.

  • Outils de vérification : utiliser des outils et solveurs de vérification formelle, notamment UPPAAL et Z3.

  • Programmation : mobiliser des compétences en programmation pour la mise en œuvre, l’expérimentation et l’évaluation des méthodes développées.

  • Langues : maîtriser l’anglais à l’écrit et à l’oral. La connaissance du français constitue un atout.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables

  • connaissance et expérience pertinente en matière de réseaux, de cloud et de systèmes distribués seraient un atout.

From day one, the ACPR will expect PFS to demonstrate clear security governance, effective oversight of critical dependencies, and credible evidence of operational resilience - with a strong security-by-design approach.

How will you contribute to the project?

You will own PFS’s security governance and overall security and resilience policy, under the direct supervision of the Chief Compliance and Risk Officer.

Your contribution is to design a risk and control framework that is proportionate to PFS’s activity and regulatory expectations, and to ensure PFS can evidence "security by design" through auditable, inspection-ready artefacts.

In practice, this includes:

  • Policy alignment: ensure consistency between PFS and Pennylane SAS security policies, leveraging the group framework where appropriate while prioritising PFS’s regulatory obligations.

  • Security by design: translate requirements into actionable standards and control expectations, embedded into product and engineering delivery.

  • Operational resilience: shape incident-management and continuity expectations, ensure they are testable, and drive evidence of effective execution.

  • Oversight of key stakeholders: establish effective oversight of Pennylane SAS and key providers, with clear expectations, monitoring and remediation follow-through.

This is a role for a technically credible security leader with strategic judgement - with the technical depth to challenge architectures, controls and evidence, and the seniority to own governance and executive reporting.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?

  • Own PFS Information Security policy: define, maintain and continuously improve PFS security governance, standards and policy set.

  • Manage the PFS risk and control framework: maintain the security risk taxonomy, control objectives, key risks/KRIs, escalation thresholds, and evidence expectations.

  • Embed security-by-design into the Product/Tech development cycle: leverage Pennylane SAS policies and existing ways of working where applicable, ensuring PFS security requirements and regulatory obligations are reflected in the delivery lifecycle, change process and go/no-go decisions, without creating unnecessary process overhead.

  • Ensure operational resilience / continuity / testing: define resilience requirements and ensure end-to-end testing and exercises produce usable evidence and tracked remediation.

  • Manage outsourcing arrangements and audits: oversee security aspects of outsourcing arrangements (intragroup and third parties), ensure auditability and follow through on findings and remediation.

  • Provide executive-level reporting: deliver clear, decision-oriented reporting on information-security posture, incidents, resilience testing and remediation to PFS management and the Supervisory Board.

KPIs / signals:

  • Policy & standards effectiveness: evidence of adoption (e.g., security requirements consistently reflected in delivery artefacts for material initiatives) and reduction of recurring “same class” issues over time.

  • Core security KRIs (within risk appetite): a small set of measurable KRIs with thresholds and owners (e.g., critical vulnerability exposure, privileged-access exceptions, key third-party risks), tracked and escalated when outside appetite.

  • Resilience testing KPIs: tests/exercises executed vs plan; % of high-severity findings remediated within agreed timelines; retest completion for failed scenarios.

  • Incident classification & remediation tracking: consistent classification, timely escalation, and tracked remediation to closure (including post-incident action closure rate).

  • Audit follow-up tracking: audit findings/actions ageing, % overdue by severity, and executive visibility on the top overdue items.

  • Threat & vulnerability landscape monitoring: regular review of the external threat/vulnerability landscape and its concrete impact on PFS priorities (what changes in controls, monitoring, or roadmap).

Ramp-up / expectations during the probation period:

  • Establish the initial PFS security governance baseline (policy set, decision rights, reporting cadence).

  • Propose and align a first set of PFS security KRIs and risk appetite thresholds (with owners and escalation path).

  • Produce a first resilience testing plan (what is tested, frequency, evidence expected) and agree success criteria.

  • Put in place an incident classification approach and a remediation tracking routine that is audit-ready.

Profile we are looking for

Must-have

  • Fintech and/or Banking experience

  • Strong experience in information security, technology risk, cyber-risk or security assurance, with ownership of complex topics.

  • Proven ability to design and run security governance and a risk/control framework with audit-ready evidence.

  • Experience working with outsourced / third-party / group-shared technology services while retaining accountability.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level reporting.

  • Professional fluency in French and English.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of payment and authentication topics (SCA, strong authentication and account recovery patterns).

  • Exposure to PCI DSS scope and payment-card security concepts.

Why is this role important for Pennylane?

From day one of licensing, PFS must be able to operate in full regulatory compliance - not only through policies, but through reliable execution: clear ownership, predictable reporting routines, auditable evidence, and effective coordination across Operations, Finance/Accounting and Compliance & Risk.

This role is critical to organise and run that regulatory function, with the ambition to progressively consolidate regulatory reporting ownership within PFS.

How will you contribute to the project?

You will help build and operate the regulatory office of Pennylane Financial Services, working across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology.

Your initial priority will be to turn PFS’s regulatory requirements into a reliable operating framework: a complete obligations inventory, clear ownership, an integrated regulatory calendar, and effective controls over regulatory reporting and evidence.

In practice, you will:

  • maintain the authoritative inventory of PFS’s regulatory obligations;

  • coordinate the regulatory-reporting portfolio and directly produce selected returns;

  • support supervisory responses and commitment tracking from day one;

  • coordinate regulatory change with Compliance, Legal and the relevant subject-matter owners; and

  • support regulatory governance through clear reporting, decision tracking and follow-through.

You will not replace the specialist accountability of Finance, the MLRO, Legal, Risk or Operations. Your role will be to make their contributions converge into a controlled, timely and inspection-ready regulatory process.

As PFS grows, you will help shape and evolve its regulatory operating model and governance arrangements.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?

  • Run the integrated regulatory calendar: coordinate contributors, dependencies and review milestones across Compliance & Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations and Technology, escalating delivery risks before deadlines are affected.

  • Coordinate regulatory reporting: oversee the end-to-end reporting portfolio and directly prepare selected returns, while ensuring specialist functions retain accountability for their underlying judgements and data.

  • Establish reporting controls: document and operate source-to-report lineage, reconciliations, variance analysis, maker-checker review, sign-offs, submission evidence, correction procedures and backup arrangements.

  • Coordinate data-quality remediation: document reporting-data issues, assign them to the accountable function, monitor resolution and escalate overdue or recurring problems.

  • Support supervisory responses and commitment tracking: maintain a reliable record of requests, responses and commitments; coordinate contributions and evidence under the direction of the ACPR relationship owner; and escalate delivery issues to PFS management.

  • Coordinate regulatory change: work with Compliance, Legal and relevant subject-matter owners to translate new requirements into impact assessments, accountable owners, implementation plans and evidence.

  • Support regulatory governance: prepare concise status reporting, maintain decision and action tracking, and ensure regulatory matters reach the appropriate management or governance forum.

  • Improve tools and processes: define practical requirements for workflow, evidence storage, reporting production and regulatory remittance, reducing manual effort without weakening controls.

Profile we are looking for

Must-have

  • Meaningful experience in a regulated financial environment, in one or more areas such as regulatory reporting, regulatory operations, prudential reporting, compliance, risk, finance, internal control or regulatory advisory.

  • Strong understanding of reporting controls and data quality, including reconciliations, source-to-report traceability, review and approval controls, exception management and auditable evidence.

  • Sound regulatory judgement: ability to understand a requirement, identify its practical implications, recognise when specialist Legal or Compliance input is needed, and translate conclusions into ownership, processes and controls.

  • Strong execution discipline, with a demonstrated ability to coordinate recurring deliverables, manage interdependencies and meet fixed deadlines reliably.

  • Ability to work effectively across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations and Technology, while preserving clear accountability between functions.

  • Ability to build structured and durable ways of working—including registers, calendars, procedures, templates and knowledge bases—in an evolving environment.

  • Clear and concise written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain issues, assumptions and required decisions to senior stakeholders.

  • Professional fluency in French and English.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience in a payment institution, electronic-money institution, financing company, bank, regulated fintech, supervisory authority or specialist advisory firm.

  • Exposure to more than one regulatory domain, such as payments, prudential reporting, statistical reporting, AML-CFT, fraud, incidents or financing activities.

  • Experience coordinating regulatory change, supervisory requests, inspections or remediation commitments.

  • Familiarity with regulatory-remittance tools, reporting-data lineage, workflow automation or evidence-management solutions.

  • Experience building or materially improving a regulatory framework in a new entity, licensing programme or operating-model transformation.

description:

Steeds meer mensen in Europa kiezen ervoor om zelfstandig te werken als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Zelfstandig werken biedt vrijheid en flexibiliteit om te bepalen wanneer, hoe en met wie je wilt werken. Het zien groeien van je eigen bedrijf kan zowel professioneel als financieel belonend zijn.
 
Zelfstandig zijn brengt echter ook onzekerheden met zich mee. De juiste verzekeringen zijn essentieel om voorbereid te zijn op de risico’s van het ondernemerschap.
 
Bij Insify bieden we transparante, flexibele en eerlijk geprijsde verzekeringen, afgestemd op de behoeften van ondernemers. Zo kunnen zij zich volledig richten op hun werk, in de wetenschap dat ze altijd op ons kunnen rekenen.
Insify verzekert duizenden klanten in heel Europa. Wij bieden betrouwbare verzekeringen zonder ingewikkeld papierwerk. Een verzekering bij Insify sluit je 100% digitaal af, vandaag geregeld is morgen verzekerd.
 
Hoe wij werken
 
Bij Insify hebben we vier kernwaarden: doorzettingsvermogen, impact, zorg en ondernemerschap. Die leggen we kort even uit:
Doorzettingsvermogen: We zijn niet bang voor uitdagingen en gaan juist door waar anderen stoppen.
Impact: We maken het verschil in het leven van onze klanten en belonen hun vertrouwen in ons. 
Zorg: Wij stellen onze klanten altijd centraal. Hun succes is ons doel.
Ondernemerschap: Innovatie zit in ons DNA. We gaan snel en we denken groot.  
 
Bij Insify word je onderdeel van een hecht team. Daarom werken we het liefst zo veel mogelijk op kantoor. Dat klinkt misschien raar voor een 100% online verzekeraar, maar wij geloven dat een sterke onderlinge band ons helpt sneller te innoveren en onze klanten nog beter te bedienen. Zo’n band is eigenlijk alleen via persoonlijk contact te realiseren.
Door regelmatig naar kantoor te komen, leren nieuwe collega’s bovendien sneller en voelen ze zich eerder thuis.
 
We begrijpen ook dat je misschien niet elke dag naar kantoor kunt komen of dat er momenten zijn dat je je focus nodig hebt. Daarom is gedeeltelijk thuiswerken in overleg mogelijk.

Binnen Insify zijn we op zoek naar een ambitieuze werkstudent rechten die op zoek is naar een betekenisvolle bijbaan naast de studie. Een rol waarin juridische kennis direct wordt toegepast, klantcontact centraal staat en waardevolle ervaring wordt opgedaan die uitstekend aansluit bij een toekomstige juridische carrière.

  • Aanspreekpunt voor klanten. Je helpt klanten die schade melden of arbeidsongeschikt zijn geraakt. Je luistert, stelt de juiste vragen en begeleidt hen door het proces.

  • Meedenken in complexe dossiers. Je ondersteunt bij lastige casussen, bijvoorbeeld rond aansprakelijkheid of bij het opstellen van reacties op bezwaren.
  • Samenwerken met Legal. Je schakelt met het juridische team bij ingewikkelde vraagstukken en werkt mee aan het verder verbeteren van interne processen
  • Een tweede of derdejaars bachelorstudent of een masterstudent Verzekeringsrecht of Nederlands Recht heeft onze voorkeur. 
  • Goede beheersing van zowel de Engels als Nederlandse taal. 
  • Beschikbaar voor minimaal 2 of 3 dagen per week voor minimaal 6 maanden;

    Concurrerende vergoeding - We willen de besten aantrekken en behouden, daarom bieden we een compensatiepakket dat daarbij past.
    Pensioenregeling - Deelname aan Insify’s pensioenplan, met 6% werkgeversbijdrage.

    25 vakantiedagen per jaar - (+ een extra dag op kerstavond als het een werkdag is!)
    Abonnement op Alleo - 50 EUR (netto) maandelijks (op te sparen) budget om uit te geven aan wat je wilt - van sportschoolabonnementen tot UberEats!

description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are looking for a customer-oriented and results-driven candidate to join our Account Management Team. As a Senior Account Manager DACH at Perk, you will be actively contributing to our continued customer satisfaction as well as working to increase growth and margin within existing accounts.

Following our recent acquisition and rebranding, your role now encompasses our fully integrated Travel and Spend ecosystem. You will be responsible for a portfolio of large SMB accounts within the DACH market, helping them streamline not just their travel, but their entire expense management workflow. You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll up your sleeves, and work hard.

What You Will Do:

  • Portfolio Management: Own a portfolio of large SMB customers and develop a high level of customer engagement with influential users (Admins, Finance Directors, Travel Managers) within those accounts.

  • Strategic Consultation: Gain a deep understanding of your customers' business and show you understand and identify with their goals as an organization. You will consult them on consolidating their financial stack by leveraging Perk’s unified Travel and Spend capabilities, identifying opportunities to optimize their expense reconciliation and cost control.

  • Product Expertise: Develop a deep understanding of the Perk portfolio of products—including our core Travel platform and our new Spend management solution. You will use this knowledge to guide customers through the benefits of an all-in-one T&E solution.

  • Expansion & Growth: Actively identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities for the Spend product within your existing book of business, driving adoption of corporate cards, automated invoice processing, and expense management features.

  • Problem Solving: Identify common problems within each account—whether related to bookings or expense workflows—and develop strategies to solve each issue in a timely manner whilst also developing foolproof methods to ensure repeat issues are a thing of the past.

  • Advocacy: Be Perk’s biggest advocate within your clients and your clients' biggest advocate within Perk. You’ll be the first one to address any issues, get support from our technical teams, and educate your clients on new product features across both Travel and Spend modules.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience within an Account Management or Customer Success role, preferably managing a portfolio of B2B clients.

  • Native or near-native proficiency in German.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Experience in the Travel industry, Fintech, Expense Management, or SaaS products is highly desirable.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to explain complex integrations between travel bookings and financial reporting.

  • Customer-focused with a passion for working with people and solving financial pain points for businesses.

  • Excellent analytical abilities with fluency in Excel and data interpretation.

  • Solid analytical background to help clients visualise their T&E ROI.


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are:

  • A Trusted Collaborator: You care about collective team wins, foster transparent working relationships, and bring a straightforward, low-politics mindset to work.

  • Results-Driven: You know how to filter out noise and stay locked onto core objectives, taking full ownership of major milestones like key-account rollouts.

  • Feedback-Oriented: You view constructive feedback as a tool for growth, seeking input early, iterating fast, and sharing honest perspectives with your team.

  • A Strategic Client Partner: You naturally empathize with the financial and operational challenges our clients face, using those insights to build lasting, high-trust partnerships.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

 

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Founding Account Executive – Benelux
description:
Your Impact

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit, a proven playbook, and now we're taking it into the rest of Europe.

Benelux is one of our first markets. The Netherlands and Belgium hold a dense base of high-tech and industrial manufacturers, and the category is still wide open there. That's where you come in. You take the region and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates, and win the first customers and reference logos that everything else builds on. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows Benelux from there. A real greenfield, with the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market.

You're not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation. This is a highly strategic GTM role where you work hands-on to close the first deals and set the base for everything that comes afterwards. You're based with us in Munich and travel into your market.

Your Tasks

  • Open up Benelux end to end: sharpen the ICP for Dutch and Belgian manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the region's growth

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case, closing

  • Work hand in hand with the expansion team and develop the outbound playbook for your market: messaging, sequences, segments, channels

  • Coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline

  • Feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership, and shape how Tacto expands internationally

Your Profile

  • Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • An entrepreneurial mindset above all: you want to build and own a market result, explore what works, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn't exist yet

  • Hands-on and self-driven: you go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline. You've carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • You grasp complex products and sell value over features, translating technical depth into business impact

  • Fluent, business-level English. Dutch is a strong plus, French an advantage for the Belgian market. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

  • You're based in Munich or ready to relocate. This is an on-site role - you build Benelux from our Munich office and travel into the market

Who Thrives Here

You run your market like a founder runs a company. You're a hunter, hands-on to the core: you send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries, and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won. You go through the mud and build as you go, turning what works into a system the next person can run. And you think beyond the next deal. You're not just winning customers, you're laying Tacto's foundation in your region: externally through brand, network, and reference logos, and internally through the playbook and the case for the market.

Interview Process

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you'd be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Senior Software Engineer, 5G Physical Layer
description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!
 
E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of space-powered Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are fundamentally changing the design, economics, manufacturing, coverage limitations and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.
 
By building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system—with a unique antenna design, highly sustainable spacecraft system and low-cost, small portable end-user devices—we can extend global satellite coverage, capacity and connectivity beyond legacy space services to provide a new kind of IoT platform that lets users sense, track, connect and act on information gathered, anywhere.
 
We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to saving space, protecting our planet and turning connectivity into actionable intelligence.

As a Senior Software Engineer focused on the 5G Physical Layer, you will lead the design, implementation, optimization, and integration of 5G NR PHY software for 3GPP Release 15/16/17 and beyond-5G systems. Your work will focus on real-time, performance-critical PHY algorithms running on processor- and accelerator-based platforms, with close interaction with RF, DSP, and hardware teams.
This role emphasizes PHY algorithm implementation, real-time constraints, and RF/SoC integration, while supporting higher-layer interfaces as needed. The position is based in Duisburg, Germany.

What you will do
  • 5G PHY Software Design and Implementation
  • Design, implement, and optimize 5G NR PHY algorithms on processor-based and heterogeneous SoC platforms
  • Develop software for key PHY functions such as modulation/demodulation, channel estimation, equalization, synchronization, coding/decoding, and HARQ support
  • Implement PHY software compliant with 3GPP Rel 15/16/17 specifications
    •  
  • Hardware, RF, and Platform Integration
  • Integrate 5G PHY software with RF front-end hardware and digital baseband chains
  • Develop and maintain hardware control software using interfaces such as I2C and SPI
  • Work with complex SoC architectures, including ARM, DSPs, and hardware accelerators
  • Develop software interfaces toward embedded accelerators and DSP blocks
    •  
  • Real-Time and Embedded Systems
  • Design software within strict real-time constraints and low-latency requirements

description:

Engagement Management is a new and fast-growing practice at ClickUp, and it's quickly becoming central to how we serve our enterprise customers. Our EMs bring program leadership, service delivery and change management together in one role. As a ClickUp Senior Engagement Manager you will lead the formation and orchestration of post-sale strategy and execution for the company’s largest and most strategic clients. We're looking for someone hungry, who excels in building, and who takes genuine pride in the quality of their work.

Here, Engagement Managers are the single point of accountability for outcomes. You own everything between the contract being signed and the client seeing measurable results: what was sold gets delivered, on time and on margin, and we can prove it worked.

You'll lead enterprise SaaS implementations across the full engagement lifecycle, from shaping scope in pre-sales, mobilizing the team and delivery, go-live, stabilization and a clean handover to the account team. You'll run work-stream programs with Paid TAMs, AI specialists, Product and Engineering, and the client's own project team, and you'll be the trusted advisor to the client's executive sponsor.

 

Simply put: you are the single point of accountability for delivery, the client's partner in getting value from ClickUp, and a thought leader for how we deliver.

 

Your role

  • Stakeholder Management

    • Serve as the primary client contact for delivery

    • Build strong relationships with stakeholders while ensuring delivery remains aligned to client objectives and contractual commitments.

    • Build trusted relationships with client executive sponsors and program leads at VP and C-level, acting as their primary point of contact for delivery.

    • Navigate complex enterprise stakeholder environments and competing priorities across client functions (IT, PMO, business sponsors, procurement) and broker alignment when they conflict.

  • Project Delivery Oversight

    • Deliver engagements against agreed scope, schedule, hours budget and quality, using rigorous change control to protect timelines and delivery margin.

    • Translate customer business requirements into internal deliverables and milestones

    • Own engagement governance, including kickoffs, weekly working sessions, sponsor check-ins and SteerCos, and provide clear, concise status reporting to clients and internal stakeholders.

    • Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable and high-performing delivery culture while providing coaching, direction and support.

    • Proactively manage risks, issues and dependencies through the RAID log, and act as the primary escalation point.

    • Manage engagement financials, including hours burn, forecasting, utilisation and margin, flagging overrun risk early and agreeing recovery plans.

  • Drive AI adoption

    • Guide clients from manual workflows to AI-assisted and agent-driven operations, and own post-go-live adoption outcomes.

  • Drive Value and Business Outcomes

    • Identify expansion opportunities through delivery and co-sell with Account Executives, bringing the delivery credibility that secures follow-on work.

    • Establish a value baseline before configuration begins, track benefits through go-live, and produce the value assessment that underpins renewal and expansion.

  • Governance

    • Design and run governance mechanisms

    • Track delivery efficacy, timelines, value realization and customer experience

    • Create continuous-improvement mechanisms

  • Change Management & Communication

    • Own communications around delivery status, risks and outcomes

    • Manage escalation and communication across customer/internal teams

    • Assess change readiness and resistance across impacted teams; build sponsor and champion networks to carry the rollout.

    • Design the communications and enablement plan with the client, and sequence go-live to match the organization's capacity for change.

  • Role Development

    • Contribute to building the Engagement Management practice by iterating on templates, playbooks and AI workflows that make every engagement faster and more consistent.

 

Your skills and experience

  • 5+ years of software and/or services delivery experience, with at least 2 years as the accountable project, program or engagement lead.

  • Proven track record taking enterprise SaaS deployments from kickoff through go-live and into adoption, ideally in work management, PSA, CRM, ITSM or collaboration platforms.

  • Strong grasp of SaaS implementation fundamentals: workspace and data architecture, permissions and SSO, integrations, data migration, change management and enablement. No coding required, but you can challenge an unrealistic technical scope.

  • Comfortable with Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery, and knowing which one the client actually needs.

  • Commercial acumen: you've managed engagement budgets, SoWs, change requests and margin, and you know when to push for expansion vs when to stabilize.

  • Executive presence: you can run a SteerCo, deliver bad news early with a recovery plan, and hold a line on scope with a CIO in the room.

  • Experience leading cross-functional and distributed teams you don't directly manage, across client, partner and internal resources.

  • Strategic judgment to separate genuine product gaps from client process or training gaps.

  • Hands-on with AI: you already use AI to work faster, and you can credibly advise clients on where agents and automation fit.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Status reports people actually read.

 

Nice to have: Experience in work management or SaaS software, professional services firms, agencies or regulated industries. PMP Certification.

Prozesse digital weiterentwickeln. Du optimierst proaktiv Prozesse und erhöhst dabei den Digitalisierungsgrad.

Relevante Ausbildung und Erfahrung. Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung.

DATEV-Erfahrung. Du bringst Erfahrung mit der Buchhaltungssoftware DATEV mit.

Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”.   • Grundkenntnisse in probabilistischem Testen mit Testsets und Qualitätssicherung mit Metriken.
  • Du hast Spaß an der Interaktion mit Kunden (wie etwa bei der Beratung oder im Pre-Sales).
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch auf C1+ Niveau sowie konversationssicheres Englisch.
  • 1-2 Mal im Monat innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen, um Kunden und Kolleg:innen persönlich zu treffen, stellt kein Hindernis für dich dar.

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nachdem welche Erfahrungen und Kompetenzen du mitbringst, vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 65.000 € bis 75.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden.

  • Lass dich inspirieren: Arbeite mit einem der führenden Köpfe auf dem Gebiete der generative Artificial Intelligence - unserem CTO
  • Mache einen Unterschied: Du hast bei uns viel Verantwortung und einen großen Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir sind ein mittelständisches Unternehmen, in dem dein Beitrag unseren wirtschaftlichen Erfolg beeinflusst.
  • Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche stellen sicher, dass du dich stets weiterentwickelst.
  • Wir arbeiten selbtsorganisiert: Mit einem hohen Grad an Selbstorganisation und soziokratischen Strukturen hast du alle notwendigen Freiheitsgrade, um die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen. Wir schaffen den Rahmen, den du brauchst, um gut arbeiten zu können.
