  • High converting pages and proposals: whether an organizer publishes a trip for the world or sends a tailored proposal to one client, the result has to look professional, capture travelers' imaginations, and turn interest into a booking.

  • Mobile app for travelers: once they have booked, travelers carry the trip page in their pocket, with everything they need before and during it.

2/ The content and AI engine that turns hours of work into minutes

  • WeTravel Library: a curated library of properties, activities, and reusable content on its way to 20,000 properties, so organizers build with high quality content.

  • The organizer's own library: their photos, their descriptions, their reusable blocks, so a growing team sells in one voice instead of rewriting content from scratch.

  • AI-assisted building: Copilot that drafts and improves trips inside the builder, so organizers start from a strong draft rather than an empty page.

And the team behind it. Our content specialists will report to you, and you will own the content strategy, the regional prioritization, and the pipeline that keeps the library growing.

I'm looking for an experienced, generalist product manager to lead this domain end-to-end. You will deeply study travel organizers' needs, prioritize them, come up with solutions (or hypotheses to test), drive all necessary functions to build and launch the solutions, drive adoption, and ultimately grow our revenue and profit. You will also manage our content team, and you will have direct and continuous access to C-level executives to ideate and create products.

If you've ever wanted to empower businesses with innovative tech and have fun in a well-funded rocketship in the heart of Amsterdam, this is it.

An Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate would bring a track record of exceptional results and a well-rounded product management skill set, especially the ability to break down any problem and drive high-velocity execution.

Must-haves:

  • Deep product management experience owning real outcomes, not just execution.

    • 10+ years in product management is ideal (for staff level)

    • 7+ years is minimum (for senior level)

  • Travel industry knowledge.

  • Comfortable being accountable for product-led commercial outcomes, not just features shipped.

  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder leadership across sales / account management, engineering, design.

  • Growth and experimentation mindset, with the judgment to decide without perfect data. Willing to ship, learn, and iterate.

  • Data self-sufficient. You can pull your own numbers, find where a funnel leaks, and size the opportunity before asking for engineering time.

Things that will likely help you in this particular role:

  • You have owned a builder, editor or CMS-like product where the artifact your users create is what earns them money.

  • You have shipped AI features that people kept using, and you can tell the difference between a good demo and real adoption.

  • You have treated content as product, not as someone else's job, and have worked with or led a content operation.

  • Experience managing people, even a small team or a dotted line.

Interview process

Our process aims to be high-signal and help you learn about WeTravel and our people. Two interviews will be realistic working sessions. No take-home assignments. The whole process will take only a few weeks.

Our clients are entrepreneurs and artisans who pour their passion into creating bucket-list experiences. Helping them grow their businesses is what motivates us, and what would motivate the right PM for the Trips domain. If that resonates, I'd love to meet you.

title: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA
description:
Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA

 

Executive summary: A senior international key account role for a professional who excels in relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and strategic account development. In this position, you will be responsible for retaining, deepening, and further strengthening the partnership with one of SITA’s ( https://www.sita.aero/about-us/ )  most strategic clients.

Highlights: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics | SITA

·      End-to-end responsibility for a strategic international key account

·      Strong focus on relationship management, retention, and deepening the partnership with C-level, IT directors, Enterprise architects, both on the IT organization of the client as well the Business organization.

·      International sales and stakeholder management role with high visibility in the customer environment

·      Significant impact on client satisfaction, continuity and commercial development, including revenue management

·      Strong focus on managed IT and Connectivity services (infrastructure) and differentiated value propositions, based on the portfolio of SITA

·      Key position within an international team and complex IT enterprise and Business environment

·      Operational / dotted leadership of a highly skilled IT team of 6 FTE at client site

 

Purpose of the role

For SITA, we are looking for a Senior Account Director who will take international responsibility for the strategic international key account. In this role, the emphasis is on retaining, deepening, and future-proofing an existing client relationship with significant commercial and operational value. The focus is not on aggressive revenue growth, but on stability, continuity and additional commercial opportunities within an established international account.

 

About the role, building future proof relationships

As Senior Account Director, you will be responsible for managing and further developing the strategic international key account within SITA. You will operate in an international environment where relationship development focusing on account retention, you understand the complexity of enterprise. IT, data and connectivity sales and know how to create structural value within an existing client relationship.

 

The ideal candidate is an experienced sales professional with proven knowledge of strategic international key account as an organization, for example from a previous role as a supplier or strategic partner. IT knowledge and experience with managed services are important, but deep client knowledge, insight into decision-making structures, and an understanding of international stakeholder dynamics are even more critical in this position. You can build sustainable relationships at multiple levels, create internal and external alignment in a smart and distinctive way.

 

About SITA

SITA has been a leading technology partner for the international travel and transport sector since 1949. In its early years, the SITA company built one of the first large-scale communications networks for aviation and today continues to play a global role in making travel and logistics processes smarter, safer, and more efficient. SITA has since expanded this expertise into maritime services and managed services for logistics organizations

 

SITA supports organizations with contact center solutions, connectivity, digital collaboration, security, and managed services. Within this context, strategic international key account for whom SITA delivers services worldwide that directly contribute to customer contact, collaboration, and operational continuity.

Client context

The strategic international key account one of the world’s leading container shipping and logistics companies, with approximately 18.000 employees globally, 340 + offices in 120 + countries, and connections to more than 550 ports worldwide. The organization is known for its strong focus on quality, digitalization, customer centricity, and operational excellence.

For this role, insight into the international dynamics of a complex logistics organization is essential. You understand how technology, service delivery, and stakeholder management come together in an environment where continuity, reliability, and client satisfaction have a direct impact on the business.

The partnership between SITA and the strategic international key account is built on a strong foundation. Your assignment will be to further deepen this relationship, strengthen SITA’s position, and carefully and strategically develop new opportunities within the account.

 

Portfolio and services at the key account

·       Contact centre and voice solutions

·       Global connectivity solutions

·       Managed services for communication and office environments

·       Management of digital workplaces and office environments

·       Security solutions

 

What will you do?

·       You will have end-to-end responsibility for the international account management strategic key account within SITA.

·       You will build and deepen sustainable relationships with stakeholders at operational, tactical, and strategic levels.

·       You will safeguard the existing revenue base and drive maximum client retention in an environment where managed services are largely viewed as a commodity.

·       You will identify commercial opportunities and translate them into distinctive, relevant, and viable propositions.

·       You will clearly operate as a farmer rather than a hunter account retention, and strategic growth is the main focus.

·       You will position SITA as a partner that adds value more intelligently, effectively, and innovatively than the market expects.

·       You will work effectively with internal teams, senior stakeholders, and specialists to serve the client optimally.

·       You will provide day-to-day direction to a highly skilled IT delivery team of 6 FTE at the client (virtual and extended account team).

 

Terms of employment

This position offers a fixed gross monthly salary between €9.000,- and €11.000,- gross monthly, complemented by an attractive variable compensation model. The bonus structure consists of a sales incentive based on revenue, with approximately 40% of the variable compensation linked to renewals. In addition, you will receive commission on closed deals. With strong performance, a total package of up to approximately €160,000 OTE is achievable.

Procedure

Following a successful introductory phone call, you will have 2 face-to-face meetings with a SoundPeople senior consultant. If both sides see sufficient reason to move forward, we will introduce you to SITA. You will then go through three interview rounds with the client:

 

The first interview round will take place with a Account Executive of SITA (Central Europe) and an HR professional. The second round will be with the SVP of Central Europe and the current Account Director. In the final stage, the ultimate selection and terms of employment will be aligned with the President of Europe and the COO.

 

Interested?

 

This opportunity is designed for an accomplished enterprise account leader who understands that a mature strategic relationship still requires energy, precision and continuous development. If you can combine executive stakeholder management with commercial ownership and coordinated delivery, we would like to hear from you.

 

Contact Sven Fremeijer at Sound People BV, Executive Search

LinkedIn:  https://www.linkedin.com/in/svenfremeijer/


Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a senior sales professional with extensive experience in complex enterprise environments and a strong understanding of international client dynamics. Ideally, you know the strategic international key account from a supplier or partner perspective and understand the organization, its decision-making processes, and the interests at play. You combine commercial sharpness with high-level know how to create momentum based on trust, substance, and personal leadership.

 

·      Proven experience in MSP, IT, managed services and/or Telco environments

·      Deep client knowledge and preferably previous experience with strategic key account

·      Creative, innovative, and strategically strong in commercial positioning

·      Excellent networker and a credible sparring partner at C-level

·      Structured, results-driven, and operationally strong

·      Able to move organizations forward through relationships and trust, rather than hierarchy or pressure

·      Must: Excellent communication skills in an international environment.

About Heidi Systems

Heidi Systems builds the energy OS for real estate. We help property managers and owners get their heating, water and electricity meters online, see consumption in real time and run the yearly utility billing without paper, Excel and site visits.

Submetering in Germany is still mostly analog. Meters get read by hand, data sits in PDFs, and tenants see their consumption once a year. We change that end to end: we install the meters and gateways in the building, collect the data and build the web platform property managers work in.

We're a small team in Berlin. Product and engineering work directly with the founders, and what you ship lands with real customers fast.

The role

We're looking for a best-in-class frontend engineer. Someone whose code other engineers learn from.

You'll be our senior frontend engineer and own the web platform end to end: architecture, code quality and the day-to-day experience of the property managers using it.

The platform is a SvelteKit and TypeScript app. It shows consumption data per building and unit, flags anomalies, manages tenants and owners, and produces the documents for the yearly billing. A lot of it is data-heavy UI, and it has to be right, because the numbers end up on invoices.

You'll work closely with our backend engineers and the founders, and you'll help onboard and mentor junior developers and interns as the team grows.

What you'll do

  • Own the frontend architecture of our SvelteKit app: routing, load functions, SSR, state and how we talk to the backend via oRPC

  • Ship features end to end, from a rough idea with the founders to production, often before the design is final

  • Build the data-heavy parts of the product: consumption dashboards, notification rules, tenant and owner management, billing documents

  • Set up and maintain our component library on Tailwind and DaisyUI so the UI stays consistent as we add features

  • Raise the bar on quality: strict TypeScript, Vitest coverage, code reviews, a sane PR flow

  • Shape the API contract together with backend (types, Zod schemas, error handling) so frontend and backend stay in sync

  • Mentor juniors and interns through reviews and pairing

What you bring

  • 5+ years of professional frontend experience, ideally at startups or other fast-moving product teams

  • 2+ years building production apps with Svelte and SvelteKit, with a deep understanding of its reactivity model, stores, lifecycle, routing, load functions and SSR

  • Strong TypeScript: strict mode, generics, utility types, and the judgment to know when types help and when they get in the way

  • Hands-on with Tailwind CSS (DaisyUI is a plus)

  • Experience with RPC-style APIs (oRPC, tRPC or similar) and typed contracts between frontend and backend

  • Testing as a habit: Vitest, JSDom or comparable tooling

  • Comfortable in a Unix environment (Linux or macOS), with Git, branches and PRs

  • You've made architecture decisions on a real product and can explain the trade-offs

  • You work well with little oversight and ship in small, frequent steps

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

  • You're in Berlin or willing to move, and you're in our office 2 to 3 days a week

How we work

  • Hybrid in Berlin. You're in the office 2 to 3 days a week. That's fixed. The rest of the week you work from wherever you like.

  • Short paths. You talk to the founders directly, most decisions take one call.

  • Real ownership. The frontend is yours to shape, and you'll set many of the standards the team builds on.

  • Real impact. Your work runs in buildings across Germany and makes energy use visible where people live.

  • Room to grow with the company as the engineering team gets bigger.

Your next steps

If you match most of these requirements and are ready to help digitize the building sector, we encourage you to apply. You will join a growing team where your work directly shapes the future of energy management in real estate.

Mit Sustaind schaffen wir die erste global harmonisierte Gesetzesdatenbank. Unsere B2B-Kunden nutzen diese Daten, um Compliance-Risiken zu minimieren und Rechtspflichten weltweit zu managen. Als einer der ersten Anbieter im Rechtskataster-Monitoring bieten wir dazu, gemeinsam mit der Great Lakes Insurance SE (Munich-Re-Gruppe), eine Leistungsgarantie an. Dafür verarbeiten wir sensible Kundendaten und Dokumente und müssen jederzeit belegen können, worauf unsere Ergebnisse beruhen. Bei uns baust Du Produkt-Features, die genau das für unsere Kunden sichtbar, nachvollziehbar und vertrauenswürdig machen.

Deine Rolle

Du trägst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse, nicht nur für Tickets. In unserem kleinen Team verantwortest Du komplette Vertical Slices, vom UI über die API bis zur KI-Integration, und treibst einzelne Feature-Stränge maßgeblich voran. Ownership wird bei uns großgeschrieben: Du verstehst das Problem unserer Kunden, entscheidest über die technische Umsetzung und bringst Deine Features selbst in Produktion.

  • Vertical Slices umsetzen: Frontend mit React und TypeScript, Backend mit NestJS, Persistenz in Postgres

  • Feature-Stränge von der Idee über das Release hinaus bis in den Live-Betrieb verantworten, dort warten und weiterentwickeln, und gemeinsam mit Kunden und Team priorisieren

  • Asynchrone Verarbeitung und Hintergrundjobs mit BullMQ und Redis entwerfen, die auch bei hoher Last stabil laufen

  • Die Oberfläche unserer SaaS-App mit Gespür für gute B2B-UI/UX gestalten

  • Qualität sichern mit Tests, Code Reviews und Monitoring, damit unsere wöchentlichen Releases auf Production verlässlich bleiben

  • Unsere Agent Runtime (Eve) und KI-gestützte Funktionen so gestalten, dass Ergebnisse überprüfbar sind und unter die Leistungsgarantie fallen können

Was Du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung (+ 3 Jahre) als Fullstack- oder Product Engineer mit React und TypeScript

  • Erfahrung mit Backend-Entwicklung in NestJS und Postgres

  • Erfahrung mit Queues und asynchroner Verarbeitung, idealerweise BullMQ und Redis

  • Die Fähigkeit, Features als Vertical Slice zu denken und eigenständig vom Problem bis zur Produktion zu liefern

  • Produktdenken: Du fragst nach dem Warum und entscheidest pragmatisch + iterativ, was wirklich gebaut werden muss

  • Gespür für gute B2B-UI/UX in einer SaaS-App: Du baust Oberflächen, die auch bei komplexen Inhalten klar und effizient bedienbar sind

  • Erfahrung mit Agentic Coding und die Bereitschaft, solche Tools im Arbeitsalltag gezielt einzusetzen

  • DevOps- und Plattform-Erfahrung mit AWS, Terraform und Kubernetes sowie ISO-27001-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus aber kein Muss

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was Dich erwartet

Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, schlagkräftigen Teams, in dem jeder Verantwortung übernimmt und Ergebnisse erzielt:

  • Echte Ownership: Du verantwortest Vertical Slices und treibst einzelne Feature-Stränge maßgeblich voran

  • Remote-first Engineering-Team, mit Büro in Bielefeld.

  • Eine Infrastruktur, die schon heute als Code gepflegt wird, mit Audit-Logging und klar getrennten Rollen.

  • Wöchentliche Releases auf Production

  • Eine spannende Phase im Unternehmen: Du baust mit uns an einem System, das Agents das erste Mal mit einer Leistungsgarantie anbietet und gestaltest von Beginn an mit, wie Nachweisbarkeit und Vertrauen in einer neuen Produktkategorie technisch aussehen

  • 70+ Kunden vertrauen bereits auf unser Produkt

  • Stabile Finanzierung aus Umsatz und starken Investoren

  • Regelmäßige Offsites (bisher Lissabon, Porto, Fuerteventura)

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (m/w/d)
description:

We have two offices, one in Berlin Mitte and one in Potsdam-Babelsberg. You can work from either location.

About PLACED

PLACED is building the agentic sales OS to transform Europe's staffing industry. We help agencies place candidates radically faster and win more business. We have just closed our first institutional funding round and are growing fast with leading staffing firms in Germany. We're here to redefine how an entire industry operates. Join us now in building the next European tech champion.

Your role

We are seeking experienced Senior Full Stack Engineers to drive our product forward. You will own the full development lifecycle, from building responsive Next.js interfaces to architecting high-performance FastAPI and Hono backends. You will design robust PostgreSQL data models, deploy production-grade AI features, and lead our strategic backend migration from Python to TypeScript.

Our tech stack

  • Backend: Python 3.13, FastAPI (primary production API, 123+ endpoints); TypeScript 5, Hono, Bun (new backend in active development)

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js 16

  • Database: PostgreSQL 17 (pgvector for vector search), Redis (caching, async flags)

  • Infrastructure: AWS (ECS/Fargate, S3, SES, ECR, RDS), GCP (Vertex AI, Document AI, Cloud Translation), Docker

  • AI / LLM: OpenAI (embeddings, chat), Google Gemini / Vertex AI, Anthropic Claude, LiteLLM (multi-provider routing), Instructor (structured outputs), Langfuse (LLM observability)

  • Auth: WorkOS (AuthKit, JWT)

  • Observability: Sentry, Prometheus, Langfuse, structlog

  • Tooling: GitHub Actions CI/CD, UV (Python), Bun, Ruff, mypy, ESLint, pre-commit, pytest, Drizzle ORM, SQLAlchemy 2.0 (async)

What you'll do

  • Architect and implement responsive, high-performance user interfaces with Next.js 16 and React

  • Design and build secure, high-performance RESTful APIs in FastAPI (Python) and Hono (TypeScript/Bun)

  • Drive the active migration from our Python backend to the TypeScript/Hono architecture

  • Model and optimize relational schemas in PostgreSQL 17, including pgvector embeddings for semantic search

  • Build and maintain Redis-backed caching layers and async task patterns

  • Orchestrate multi-provider LLM calls via LiteLLM, integrating OpenAI, Gemini/Vertex AI, and Claude

  • Instrument LLM pipelines with Langfuse for observability, cost tracking, and quality evaluation

  • Containerize services with Docker and deploy to AWS ECS/Fargate and GCP (Vertex AI, Document AI)

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions with 100% diff-coverage enforcement

  • Research, design, and implement autonomous AI agents that orchestrate tasks and workflows using LLMs and custom policies

  • Ensure fault tolerance, high availability, and scalability across distributed systems; identify and mitigate bottlenecks

  • Partner with product, design, and QA to deliver end-to-end features

  • Conduct code reviews and champion best practices

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of professional experience in full-stack development

  • Proficiency with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, including SSR, app router, and server components

  • Deep experience building Python APIs with FastAPI (or equivalent async framework)

  • Strong TypeScript skills, with experience in Hono, Express, or similar server frameworks

  • Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including advanced features (partitioning, indexing, full-text search)

  • Experience with vector databases or pgvector for embedding storage and semantic search

  • Familiarity with Redis for caching and async coordination

  • Solid AWS expertise (ECS/Fargate, S3, SES, ECR, RDS); GCP exposure a plus

  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions)

  • Demonstrated knowledge of distributed systems principles (consistency models, backpressure, graceful degradation)

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work asynchronously

Bonus

  • Prior exposure to agentic AI frameworks or building autonomous agents

  • Experience with LiteLLM, Instructor, or other LLM orchestration libraries

  • Hands-on Langfuse or other LLM observability tooling (Helicone, Braintrust, etc.)

  • Familiarity with GCP services: Vertex AI, Document AI, Cloud Translation

  • Experience with WorkOS or similar auth platforms

  • Background in observability (Prometheus, Sentry, CloudWatch)

  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)

  • Contributions to open-source projects or technical communities

What you get

  • Competitive package: Salary + VSOP

  • Team: Work in a small, focused and experienced team with high talent density.

  • Room to grow: Own projects and take on more responsibility as you deliver.

  • Health & learning: Urban Sports Club membership and a €1,000 annual learning budget.

  • Late evenings: Dinner and an Uber home when you stay until 8pm or later.

  • Everyday support: Monthly budget for Uber or cleaning services.

  • Live close to the office: Extra gross salary for living within a 10 or 20 minute walk.

12-month fixed-term contract | Global Revenue Systems and AI Team |


About the Role

Our reps spend most of their day in Salesforce, and how it feels to use directly affects how much they sell. We're hiring a Salesforce Developer with a UI/UX focus to redesign the rep experience across our Sales and Revenue teams. You'll join the global Salesforce team for 12 months to make the CRM faster, clearer and more intuitive.

This is a hands-on build role. You'll design the experience and code it in Lightning Web Components, working with Sales, RevOps, Marketing and Data, and directly with the reps who use the result.


What You Will Do


Redesign the rep experience

  • Audit the current Lightning experience (record pages, console apps, list views, home pages) and find where reps lose time to clicks, clutter and missing context.

  • Turn what you find into a prioritised roadmap of UI improvements tied to rep productivity and adoption.

  • Design and prototype improved layouts, workflows and components, and validate them with reps before building.

Build with LWC

  • Develop custom Lightning Web Components (and supporting Apex where needed) that replace clunky standard layouts with focused, usable interfaces.

  • Configure and extend Lightning App Builder pages, Dynamic Forms, Dynamic Actions and console apps to deliver a consistent experience across teams and regions.

  • Build reusable components and follow SLDS conventions so the UI stays consistent and maintainable after your contract ends.

Make it stick

  • Run feedback sessions, usability tests and pilots with reps and managers, and iterate on the results.

  • Track adoption, page performance and user satisfaction to show what each release changed.

  • Create release notes, short walkthroughs and handover documentation so changes land well and the team can maintain what you build.

Work as part of the global team

  • Work within the global team's standards for source control, code review, sandboxes and release management.

  • Partner with admins, architects and data teams so UI changes fit the wider data model, security model and automation.

  • Pass on what you learn about Lightning UX patterns and LWC best practices to the wider team.


What You Will Need


Must have

  • Strong, demonstrable experience building Lightning Web Components in production.

  • Solid Apex, SOQL and Salesforce data model knowledge to support your components.

  • Deep knowledge of Lightning Experience customisation: App Builder, Dynamic Forms, page layouts, console apps and Flows.

  • Experience with Salesforce DX, Git and a CI/CD or deployment process.

  • A UX mindset: you start from user problems, can explain design decisions, and can take feedback from non-technical users.

  • Clear communication and the ability to work independently across time zones in a global team.

Nice to have

  • Portfolio or examples of Salesforce UI work you've shipped (screenshots or demos are ideal).

  • Experience with SLDS, Figma or similar prototyping tools, and accessibility (WCAG) principles.

  • Experience in Sales Cloud, especially rep-facing workflows such as opportunity management, account planning and pipeline views.

  • Jest testing for LWC, and Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, JavaScript Developer I, Platform App Builder).

  • Experience with performance profiling and optimisation in Lightning pages.


What Success Looks Like (12 Months)

  • Month 3: UX audit complete and a prioritised roadmap agreed with Sales leadership.

  • Month 6: First wave of redesigned pages and components live for a pilot group, with adoption and feedback baselined.

  • Month 12: Redesigned experience rolled out to target teams, a maintained component library in place, and full documentation handed to the global team.

What we offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Risk Operations Analyst
description:
About Ryft

 

Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms.

We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity.

 

We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform.

 

About the Role

We’re hiring a Risk Operations Analyst to sit within our first line fraud and risk function, reporting to the Fraud & Risk Manager. This role is the operational backbone of how Ryft manages its relationships with acquiring and banking partners, taking inbound queries from our acquires and bank partners and owning them through to resolution.

The core of this role is investigative. When a query comes in from a banking partner, we need someone who can trace a transaction end-to-end through our systems, understand what the bank is actually asking, produce a response that meets their expectations, and critically, question what they find along the way rather than closing the thread at the first plausible answer.

Alongside partner queries, you’ll carry out merchant risk monitoring as part of the broader fraud and risk operation; reviewing merchant behaviour, flagging anomalies, and feeding intelligence into the fraud detection and response process led by the Fraud & Risk Manager. If you’re someone who digs until they have the full picture, is comfortable navigating between internal systems and external expectations, and takes pride in the quality of what they send to a bank, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Acquirer & Banking Partner Query Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for inbound risk and compliance queries from Ryft’s

acquiring and banking partners — managing each query through to full resolution.

• Trace transactions end-to-end through Ryft’s systems in response to partner queries —

reconstructing the payment journey, identifying where issues occurred, and producing clear, accurate responses that meet the bank’s expectations.

• Understand what each banking partner needs to see in a response and tailor your output

accordingly — whether that’s a transaction trail, a merchant explanation, supporting documentation, or a combination.

• Question what you find — don’t close a query at the first plausible answer. If something looks unusual or doesn’t add up, dig further and escalate to the Fraud & Risk Manager where needed.

• Maintain a clear log of all partner queries, response timelines, and outcomes, ensuring

nothing falls through the cracks and that patterns across queries are surfaced proactively.

• Build a working knowledge of each partner’s reporting expectations, query formats, and

escalation preferences, reducing friction in ongoing communications.

Merchant Risk Monitoring

• Carry out day-to-day merchant risk monitoring across the Ryft portfolio — reviewing

transaction activity, volumes, and behavioural patterns to identify anomalies that may indicate fraud, policy breach, or elevated risk.

• Feed merchant risk intelligence into the fraud detection and response process, working

closely with the Fraud & Risk Manager to ensure monitoring activity informs rule tuning and threshold decisions.

• Flag merchants or sub-merchants exhibiting patterns of concern, documenting your findings clearly and escalating where a risk response is required.

• Support chargeback and dispute monitoring at the merchant level, identifying accounts with elevated dispute rates and feeding that data into the wider fraud analysis process.

• Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of monitoring activity and risk decisions in line with FCA expectations and internal policy.

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Work closely with the Fraud & Risk Manager to ensure partner query intelligence and merchant monitoring findings are connected — a query from an acquirer about a specific merchant should inform, and be informed by, what you’re seeing in monitoring.

• Liaise with the underwriting team where partner queries or merchant monitoring activity raises questions about how a merchant was onboarded or what their risk profile should be.

• Support the engineering and product teams with information requests related to transaction tracing, where system-level investigation requires cross-functional input.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of response templates, internal runbooks, and query management procedures.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

• Experience in a payments operations, risk operations, or financial crime role within a PSP,

acquirer, payment facilitator, or bank — with direct exposure to acquirer or banking partner

queries.

• Demonstrable ability to trace transactions through payment systems — you understand how a payment moves, where it can go wrong, and how to reconstruct what happened from system data.

• Strong written communication skills, with experience producing clear, structured responses to banking or regulatory counterparties who expect precision.

• An investigative mindset — you ask the next question, not just the obvious one. You’re not satisfied with a plausible explanation if the evidence doesn’t fully support it.

• Organised and reliable under query volume — able to manage multiple open cases

simultaneously without losing track of timelines or detail.

• Comfortable operating within a first line risk function with real accountability for the quality and timeliness of outputs.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with merchant risk monitoring in a PayFac or marketplace payments model.

• Experience with chargeback and dispute management, including TC40/SAFE data or scheme fraud reporting.

• Exposure to fraud tooling such as Fraud.net, Sift, SEON or equivalent platforms.

• SQL or data querying skills for self-serve transaction investigation.

Rattachement hiérarchique

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

description:

Our Support Analytics team's main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants & Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. 💡 

You'll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals.

Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the Workforce Management (WFM) team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

title: Business Development & Sales Intern (w/m/d)
description:
Über Valova

Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann.

Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben.

Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang. Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses, bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden.

Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin. Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Warum diese Rolle zählt

Als Praktikant:in im Business Development & Sales sorgst Du dafür, dass unser Vertriebsteam seine Zeit mit den richtigen Kliniken verbringt. Du findest und qualifizierst die Accounts, eröffnest die ersten Gespräche und buchst die Demos, die dann unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen wahrnehmen. Gleichzeitig baust Du den Motor dahinter mit auf: saubere Daten in unserem CRM Tool, Outreach-Sequenzen, die laufen, Dashboards, die zeigen, wo wir stehen, und KI-Automatisierungen, die unserem Team jede Woche Stunden sparen.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du direkt anhand der gebuchten Termine, einer aufgebauten Pipeline und Prozessen, die weiterlaufen, lange nachdem Du sie aufgesetzt hast.

Du sitzt nicht in der zweiten Reihe und schaust zu. Du baust den Vertriebsmotor mit auf, der Valova in Kliniken in ganz Deutschland bringt.

Deine Rolle im Team

Du berichtest an unseren VP Sales und arbeitest täglich mit unseren Regional Sales Manager:innen im Norden und Süden zusammen. Für viele Kliniken bist Du der erste Kontakt: Du recherchierst Accounts, gehst Inbound Leads nach, sprichst Entscheider:innen per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail an und übergibst qualifizierte Termine an die Regional Sales Manager:innen, die sie bis zur Unterschrift bringen. Deine Aufgaben

  • Türen zu Kliniken öffnen: Du identifizierst vielversprechende Kliniken, von privaten Klinikgruppen über kommunale und ländliche Häuser bis zu Unikliniken, recherchierst die richtigen Entscheider:innen in Geschäftsführung, Finanzen, Medizincontrolling und Kodierung und gehst Inbound Leads schnell nach.

  • Gespräche starten, die zählen: Du sprichst Kliniken per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail an, mit Sequenzen, die auf den jeweiligen Kliniktyp und seine Herausforderungen zugeschnitten sind.

  • Qualifizieren und Demos buchen: Du findest heraus, ob echter Bedarf besteht, wer entscheidet und wann und buchst Demos für unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen mit sauberer Übergabe.

  • Unsere Pipeline up-to-date halten: Du hältst unser CRM sauber, baust Dashboards und bereitest Pipeline- und Forecast-Reportings für unseren VP Sales vor.

  • Mit KI automatisieren: Du baust KI-gestützte Workflows und Automatisierungen für Recherche, Datenanreicherung und Outreach, damit unser Team weniger Zeit mit Routine und mehr Zeit mit Kliniken verbringt.

  • Unseren Vertrieb mitgestalten: Du schreibst SOPs, schärfst Sequenzen und Playbook, unterstützt den Deal Desk bei Angeboten und Business Cases und recherchierst den Klinikmarkt und unseren Wettbewerb.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Studium: Du studierst BWL, VWL, Gesundheitsmanagement, Gesundheitsökonomie, Medizin oder ein anderes relevantes Feld und suchst ein Vollzeitpraktikum über mindestens sechs Monate.

  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Du hast bereits durch ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudententätigkeit in Vertrieb, Business Development, Beratung oder einem Start-up praktische Erfahrung gesammelt.

  • Keine Scheu vorm Telefon: Du gehst gern auf Menschen zu, auch auf erfahrene Entscheider:innen, und bleibst nach einem „Nein“ freundlich und hartnäckig.

  • Strukturiert und datenaffin: Du bist sicher in Excel und hältst Daten gern sauber. CRM-Erfahrung, idealerweise mit Pipedrive, ist ein Plus.

  • KI-nativ: Du nutzt KI-Tools täglich und hast Lust, Automatisierungen zu bauen. Erfahrung mit Tools wie n8n, Make oder Zapier ist ein Plus.

  • Neugier aufs Gesundheitswesen: Du willst verstehen, wie Krankenhäuser funktionieren. Erste Kenntnisse in DRG-Systematik oder ICD/OPS-Kodierung sind ein Plus, kein Muss.

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst Deutsch verhandlungssicher oder als Muttersprache und Englisch fließend.

  • Arbeitsort: Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro in Berlin oder München

Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ownership ab Tag eins: Du verantwortest Deine eigene Pipeline und treibst den Erfolg von Valova in Deine Vertriebsregion maßgeblich voran.

  • Direkter Draht zur Vertriebsleitung. Du arbeitest täglich eng mit Stephan zusammen, unserem VP Sales und erfahrenen Scale-up-Executive. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben.

  • Lernen im Start-up-Tempo. Du erlebst hier in einem Jahr mehr als anderswo in drei.

  • Ein Team, mitten in der Stadt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort im WeWork am Odeonsplatz in München und im WeWork in Berlin-Mitte. Dich erwarten voll ausgestattete Büros mit Kaffee, Meetingräumen und Phone Booths, eine zentrale Lage und gute Lunch-Spots direkt um die Ecke.

  • Team-Events, die München und Berlin zusammenbringen, denn die Menschen, mit denen Du baust, sollten auch die sein, mit denen Du feierst.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Nach 1 Monat kennst Du unser Produkt, unsere Zielkliniken und Pipedrive in- und auswendig, und Deine ersten Outreach-Sequenzen laufen.

  • Nach 3 Monaten buchst Du regelmäßig qualifizierte Demos für unsere Regional Sales Manager:innen, unsere Pipedrive-Daten sind sauber und Deine ersten Dashboards und Automatisierungen sind live.

  • Zum Ende deines Praktikums hast Du eine messbare Pipeline aufgebaut, die SOPs und Sequenzen, die Du geschrieben hast, sind Teil unseres Playbooks und Deine Automatisierungen sparen dem Team jede Woche Zeit.

  • Die ganze Zeit über hat das, was Du in Gesprächen hörst, unsere Botschaften mitgeprägt und uns geholfen, den Markt besser zu verstehen.

So läuft Dein Bewerbungsprozess

Lade einfach deinen Lebenslauf samt Gehaltsvorstellung mit deiner Bewerbung hoch. Für die nächsten Schritte melden wir uns zeitnah bei dir:

  1. Kennenlernen (30 Min.): Wir lernen uns kennen, sprechen über deinen Werdegang und beantworten deine ersten Fragen.

  2. Gespräch mit unserem VP Sales (30 Min.): Wir sprechen über Deine bisherigen Erfahrungen und Deine Ideen für Valova und Deine Vorstellungen für das Praktikum.

  3. Case: Du führst mit uns ein kurzes Discovery-Gespräch oder einen Pitch anhand eines realistischen Klinikszenarios. Hier zeigst Du uns, wie du verkaufst.

  4. Referenzen: Wir sprechen mit zwei oder drei Personen, mit denen Du zusammengearbeitet hast, zum Beispiel ehemaligen Vorgesetzten, Kolleg:innen oder Kund:innen.

  5. Angebot: Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, hörst Du schnell von uns.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter oder sexueller Identität.

title: Software engineer, AI model supply chain and package security
description:
We build fast, modern developer tools in Rust, and a surprising amount of serious software runs on them. Pixi, rattler and rattler-build are open source and used by hundreds of thousands of developers: quant teams in finance, physicists at CERN, biotech labs, and humanoid robot companies you've probably seen videos of. We are also core maintainers of conda-forge, one of the largest open source package ecosystems, and we maintain RoboStack, which gets ROS running on any OS from a single lockfile.

When that much software flows through your tools, security stops being optional. Every package that ends up on a laptop, a server or a robot should be traceable back to the source and build that produced it. We're building that for conda today, and we want to extend it to AI models.

The engineering team is spread across Europe (Netherlands, Germany, UK, Moldova). This work is based in Berlin, and so is this role.

The work

Robots increasingly run learned models: vision transformers, RL policies, LLMs. Today those models are usually copied onto machines as large opaque files, with little record of where they came from or what changed. We think models should be shipped like packages: versioned, signed, verifiable, and updated efficiently.

You'll work on two related areas.

Package security. Signing and verification for conda packages with Sigstore, provenance from source to build to install, SBOMs, and mapping known vulnerabilities onto the packages people actually use. This work goes into Pixi, rattler and conda-forge, and is used by a lot of people.

AI models as packages. Taking the same ideas to model artifacts. That includes:

  • A provenance chain from training through packaging to deployment, with signatures that can be verified offline on air-gapped robots

  • A model SBOM format, building on CycloneDX's ML-BOM

  • Delta updates between model versions (full models, fine-tunes, LoRA adapters, quantized variants), so robots don't download gigabytes for a small change

  • Compression that combines model techniques (quantization, pruning, distillation) with what package managers already do well (zstd, content-addressable storage), tuned to the target hardware and network

  • Managing models that get fine-tuned on the robot itself: tracking where those variants came from, validating them, and syncing them back

  • Testing the whole pipeline end to end on real models and real hardware, and measuring latency, bandwidth and model quality

A lot of this is new. Part of the job is figuring out which approaches work, measuring them honestly, and writing up what you found.

What we're looking for

You don't need years of experience. You do need solid fundamentals, curiosity, and the patience to get security details right.

  • Rust, or a strong background in C++, Go or Python and the wish to switch

  • Interest in software supply chain security. Bonus if you've worked with Sigstore (Cosign, Rekor, Fulcio), TUF, in-toto, SLSA or SBOM formats

  • Familiarity with ML in practice: you've trained or fine-tuned a model, know what a LoRA adapter or a quantized model is, and have used PyTorch or similar

  • Basic understanding of cryptography as an engineer: signatures, hashes, certificates, and what they do and don't guarantee

  • You like measuring things and are honest about results that don't work out

  • You live in Berlin or are willing to move here

It's a plus if you know package managers from the inside, have worked on model compression or edge inference, have robotics experience, or have contributed to open source. None of this is required.

What we offer

You'll work on problems few people have solved yet, together with the people who created Mamba, Pixi, rattler and RoboStack. Most of your work will be open source and used by a large community from day one. We pay a competitive Berlin salary, with 30 days of vacation, the hardware you want, a conference budget, and time for upstream open source work. We help with relocation within the EU.

title: Data & Analytics Manager (f/m/x)
description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

We are looking for a Data & Analytics Manager to lead an international BI and Data Analytics team across EMEA. This hands-on role combines people management, technical leadership, stakeholder management, and end-to-end data project delivery.

You will translate business priorities into execution plans, guide technical decisions, unblock the team, and deliver reliable data products for BI, self-service analytics, and AI-enabled use cases.

  • Lead, coach, and develop an international BI and Data Analytics team.

  • Build a motivating, accountable, and change-oriented team environment.

  • Model clean, documented datasets in dbt, from staging through to marts.

  • Own tests, documentation, metric definitions, data contracts, and version control workflows.

  • Develop a semantic layer with governed metrics and dimensions.

  • Drive the ongoing adoption of dbt best practices, ensuring models and documentation are consistent, well-structured, and ready for AI-powered analytics.

  • Support data migration, ELT pipelines, and data platform consolidation.

  • Optimize Snowflake performance, data freshness, and data quality.

  • Own and continuously improve the processes that keep our data platform reliable.

  • Use Python for data checks, automation, and utilities.

  • Partner with BI and business teams to deliver certified datasets, self-service standards, and end-to-end reporting solutions.

  • Translate business needs into scalable data products and governed metrics.

  • Turn business priorities into project plans, identify risks and trade-offs, unblock the team, and drive delivery to completion.

  • Mentor the team on analytics engineering best practices, modern tooling, and AI-assisted development.

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering, BI Development, Data Engineering, or a related field, including 1+ years of people or team leadership.

  • Expert-level SQL and strong data modeling and architecture skills, including star schemas, semantic layers, governed metrics, data contracts, and ELT pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience building production-grade dbt projects, including staging-to-marts layering, tests, documentation, ownership, and version-control workflows.

  • Snowflake experience, including query performance optimization, data freshness, and quality monitoring.

  • Python skills for data checks, automation, and utilities.

  • Experience with data quality and operations, including testing, monitoring, source-data reconciliation, CI/CD, data cataloging, and cost/performance tuning.

  • Experience creating dbt models and documentation, AI-ready data products, and using AI-assisted development tools.

  • Experience delivering certified datasets, self-service standards, and BI/reporting solutions end-to-end.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with a hands-on, entrepreneurial, and problem-solving mindset.

  • A motivational leadership style, positive drive for change, and confidence to challenge assumptions and make decisions.

Nice to have

  • Experience with semantic layer tools such as dbt MetricFlow or Snowflake Semantic Views.

  • Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.

  • Experience leading distributed or international teams.

  • German language skills. German is a strong plus but not mandatory.

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

 

What we offer

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

Real-time decision-support data architecture

Replacing point-to-point integration across a multi-vendor estate with a microservices architecture and a common data layer, so that operational data flows in near real time instead of over days. The work includes target-state architecture and decision records, change-data-capture ingest pipelines from upstream data services, ontology and mapping-layer design across suppliers with competing data models, separation of system, reference and insight data classes including time-series, and deployment topologies spanning cloud-hosted services down to constrained edge hardware.

Legacy-to-document-model migration at national scale

Migrating hundreds of millions of records and tens of terabytes of XML out of a legacy relational platform into a sharded document store, in support of a COBOL-to-Java microservices rewrite. The work includes a configuration-driven XML-to-JSON transformation framework backed by a versioned schema registry — twenty years of history, multiple record types and continual schema and semantic drift; CDC and streaming pipelines, or a checkpointed parallel bulk-extract alternative; a field-level mapping validation and reconciliation framework robust enough to stand up to audit; a replay and failure-diagnostics harness with dead-letter routing and idempotent re-runs; and repeated dress rehearsals toward a single cutover window with no dual running.

Monolith decomposition and data-ownership migration

Breaking a distributed monolith of well over a hundred Java services sharing a handful of database clusters into domain-owned services — moving from borrowed data to owned data without reintroducing hidden coupling. The work includes bounded-context analysis to establish which domain genuinely owns which collections, in-place data remodelling ahead of any physical move, a data-access facade with feature-flagged per-request routing between old and new stores, dual-write / backfill / reconcile / read-switch cutover lifecycles with a defined rollback at every step, cluster-to-cluster streaming and live migration tooling, and automated parallel-run and diff-on-read testing.

•      Design and prove cutover mechanisms — dual-write, backfill, reconcile, read-switch, rollback — for systems where a failed migration is not an acceptable outcome

title: Scientific Product Director, Clinical Prediction
description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

Our clinical-prediction offer gives pharma partners the evidence to guide decisions before and during clinical development. We are looking for a Scientific Product Director to turn this science into sellable products: decide what gets developed and when, define what each capability can claim and output, and shape how results are delivered to partners.

You will report to Gustave Ronteix, CTO and co-founder, and work daily with a tight-knit interdisciplinary team composed of Computational Biology, Data Science, R&D, Platform Strategy & Operations, BD and Pharma Partnerships.

What you'll do

1. Own the product roadmap

  • Design and build a scalable product capable of derisking and accelerating clinical development of drug candidates based on Orakl’s scientific capabilities

  • Turn signals from BD, Pharma Partnerships and R&D into capability definitions: specs, target metrics, validation plan, in- vs out-of-scope definition, cost to deliver

  • Set priorities and dates with Engineering and Data Science; flag slippage early and make the trade-offs

  • Identify productization-gaps from delivery audits and analysis, and feed recurring ones back into the roadmap

2. Oversee product maturity and decide what we sell

  • Maintain the capability catalog: what is available now, in beta or on the roadmap, and what each can and cannot claim

  • Contribute to the final decision of when a capability is ready to sell (based on Data Science’s validation evidence) versus what is not-yet sellable in the pipeline, and communicate it internally

  • Oversee the scientific case for each capability: white papers, application notes, posters

3. Design how results reach partners

  • Design the reports, data packages and dashboards partners receive, and direct the engineers who build them

  • Own the deliverable contents: figures, statistical summaries, methods, limitations

  • Embed the approved claims and the QC checklist in every template, so Pharma Partnerships can produce a correct deliverable at scale

  • Keep templates current as the validated envelope changes, and pull or revise one when it no longer applies

What we're looking for

Must have

  • PhD or equivalent in cancer biology, pharmacology, biostatistics or computational biology

  • 8+ years in translational oncology, biomarker or diagnostics development, computational-biology platforms or preclinical CRO services, including 2+ owning a product roadmap

  • Technical depth: you read and understand production code, and can brief and review the work of engineers who build our reports and dashboards

  • You judge evidence: from a validation pack - back-tests, calibration, biomarker cutoffs -, you can state a claim the data supports and refuse the one it doesn't

  • You have experience working at the intersection of scientific and business departments within fast-growing companies

  • You know how pharma decides: you have seen proposals, SOWs and due-diligence questions, and know what a go/no-go decision needs from a prediction

  • Fluent in English

Nice to have

  • You have seen bespoke research work turned into something repeatable and sellable

  • Scientific authorship: Posters, talks, papers or white papers; a presence at AACR, ASCO, ESMO or SITC

  • Regulatory: exposure to regulated or quality-managed environments

  • Therapeutic or preclinical knowledge: ADC, immuno-oncology or targeted therapy; organoid or in-vitro pharmacology

  • Clinical-trial design or Trial statistics: adaptive designs, sample size, endpoints

  • Templated reporting: report-generation frameworks or web front-end

What we offer

  • Mission: work on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Ownership: a product function to build from the ground up.

  • Impact: pharma teams make real portfolio decisions with what you define.

  • Team: an exceptional crew of clinicians, biologists, engineers and data scientists, most with a PhD.

title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) Freelance
description:
Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) 

Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

À propos de l'opportunité

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

  • Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.

  • Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.

  • Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.

  • Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.

  • Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.

  • Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.

  • Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.

  • Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.

  • Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

  • Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.

  • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.

  • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

  • Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.

  • La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.

  • Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.

  • La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.

  • Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.

  • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

  • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.

  • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

  • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.

  • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.

  • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.

  • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.

  • Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.

  • Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

Notre mission

 

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation.

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation. Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement”

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux !

 

Le mot de la CEO

“Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon

 

Et ce poste alors ?

 

Le rôle

En première ligne de notre développement commercial, tu travailleras main dans la main avec le Sales Manager et les Account Executives au sein d'une équipe outillée et ambitieuse, sur un cycle de vente court.

  • Prospection intensive et ciblée (Outbound) : Identifier et qualifier des comptes clés dans le secteur de l'installation solaire.
